items.title: FRCC: Towards Provably Fair and Robust Congestion Control.
items.abstract:
Congestion control algorithms (CCAs) play a critical role in network bandwidth allocation. Recent work (from SIGCOMM 2022) showed that a large class of CCAs, including BBR, Copa, and Reno, starve flows in the presence of network jitter. Starvation occurs because CCAs coordinate fairness by encoding fair rates into congestion signals. For example, Reno's throughput scales as 1/√loss rate. Even a small amount of noise in these signals leads to large errors in inferring fair rates.

We present FRCC (Fair and Robust Congestion Controller), the first CCA that provably bounds unfairness (avoids starvation) even under network jitter. Our key insight is to encode only the flow count (or equivalently, the fair link fraction) into the congestion signals, and independently estimate the link capacity to calculate the fair rate. In this way, we bound jitter's impact on fairness. We implement FRCC in the Linux kernel and evaluate it in a variety of network conditions, including synthetic jitter, heterogeneous RTTs, and multi-bottleneck settings. FRCC closely matches the bounds predicted by our theoretical analysis, and consistently achieves fairness, even when state-of-the-art CCAs exhibit starvation.
items.abstract_zh:
拥塞控制算法（CCA）在网络带宽分配中发挥着至关重要的作用。 Recent work (from SIGCOMM 2022) showed that a large class of CCAs, including BBR, Copa, and Reno, starve flows in the presence of network jitter.饥饿的发生是因为 CCA 通过将公平费率编码到拥塞信号中来协调公平性。例如，Reno 的吞吐量按 1/√ 丢失率缩放。即使这些信号中存在少量噪声，也会导致推断公平利率时出现较大错误。

We present FRCC (Fair and Robust Congestion Controller), the first CCA that provably bounds unfairness (avoids starvation) even under network jitter. Our key insight is to encode only the flow count (or equivalently, the fair link fraction) into the congestion signals, and independently estimate the link capacity to calculate the fair rate.通过这种方式，我们限制了抖动对公平性的影响。 We implement FRCC in the Linux kernel and evaluate it in a variety of network conditions, including synthetic jitter, heterogeneous RTTs, and multi-bottleneck settings. FRCC closely matches the bounds predicted by our theoretical analysis, and consistently achieves fairness, even when state-of-the-art CCAs exhibit starvation.

items.title: SYMPHONY: Enabling Compute-Memory Disaggregation in LLM Serving Systems.
items.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) power AI applications such as chatbots and agents, which maintain conversational state across multiple turns. Serving these workloads is inherently stateful: each request generates a KV cache storing token-level state. Existing systems either recompute caches or offload them to host memory—both approaches incur high latency, cause load imbalance, and limit scalability. We present SYMPHONY, a disaggregated memory management layer that decouples compute from KV cache storage while meeting strict latency requirements. To enable disaggregation, SYMPHONY employs advisory requests—prefetching hints derived from user interactions or workload structure—to move caches off the critical path and enable fine-grained, request-level load balancing. Since these predictive signals are often unreliable, SYMPHONY introduces two key techniques: priority-based KV cache management, which allocates memory based on neural network structure and request priority, and cooperative memory management, which dynamically coordinates GPU memory with the serving framework. Evaluations on LLaMA models with ShareGPT and Burst-GPT workloads show that SYMPHONY reduces end-to-end latency by 2.4× over vLLM and serves 4× more requests with minimal latency increase.
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 为聊天机器人和代理等人工智能应用程序提供支持，这些应用程序可以在多个回合中保持对话状态。为这些工作负载提供服务本质上是有状态的：每个请求都会生成一个存储令牌级状态的 KV 缓存。现有系统要么重新计算缓存，要么将它们卸载到主机内存，这两种方法都会导致高延迟，导致负载不平衡，并限制可扩展性。我们推出了 SYMPHONY，这是一个分解的内存管理层，可将计算与 KV 缓存存储解耦，同时满足严格的延迟要求。为了实现分解，SYMPHONY 采用咨询请求（从用户交互或工作负载结构中派生的预取提示）将缓存移出关键路径，并实现细粒度的请求级负载平衡。由于这些预测信号通常不可靠，SYMPHONY 引入了两项关键技术：基于优先级的 KV 缓存管理（根据神经网络结构和请求优先级分配内存）和协作内存管理（动态协调 GPU 内存与服务框架）。对具有 ShareGPT 和 Burst-GPT 工作负载的 LLaMA 模型的评估表明，SYMPHONY 比 vLLM 将端到端延迟减少了 2.4 倍，并以最小的延迟增加服务了 4 倍的请求。

items.title: Over-Threshold Multiparty Private Set Intersection for Collaborative Network Intrusion Detection.
items.abstract: An important function of collaborative network intrusion detection is to analyze the network logs of the collaborators for joint IP addresses. However, sharing IP addresses in plain is sensitive and may be even subject to privacy legislation as it is personally identifiable information. In this paper, we present the privacy-preserving collection of IP addresses. We propose a single collector, over-threshold private set intersection protocol. In this protocol N participants identify the IP addresses that appear in at least t participant's sets without revealing any information about other IP addresses. Using a novel hashing scheme, we reduce the computational complexity of the previous state-of-the-art solution from O(M(N logM/t) 2t ) to O(t 2 M(binomNt)), where M denotes the dataset size. This reduction makes it practically feasible to apply our protocol to real network logs. We test our protocol using joint networks logs of multiple institutions. Additionally, we present two deployment options: a collusion-safe deployment, which provides stronger security guarantees at the cost of increased communication overhead, and a non-interactive deployment, which assumes a non-colluding collector but offers significantly lower communication costs and applicable to many use cases of collaborative network intrusion detection similar to ours.
items.abstract_zh: 协作网络入侵检测的一个重要功能是分析协作者的网络日志以获取联合IP地址。然而，以普通方式共享 IP 地址是敏感的，甚至可能受到隐私立法的约束，因为它是个人身份信息。在本文中，我们提出了 IP 地址的隐私保护集合。我们提出了一个单一收集器、超阈值私有集交叉协议。在此协议中，N 个参与者识别出现在至少 t 个参与者集合中的 IP 地址，而不泄露有关其他 IP 地址的任何信息。使用新颖的哈希方案，我们将之前最先进解决方案的计算复杂度从 O(M(N logM/t) 2t ) 降低到 O(t 2 M(binomNt))，其中 M 表示数据集大小。这种减少使得将我们的协议应用于真实的网络日志实际上是可行的。我们使用多个机构的联合网络日志来测试我们的协议。此外，我们还提供了两种部署选项：防共谋部署，以增加通信开销为代价提供更强的安全保证；非交互式部署，假设非共谋收集器，但通信成本显着降低，适用于与我们类似的协作网络入侵检测的许多用例。

items.title: Uber's Failover Architecture: Reconciling Reliability and Efficiency in Hyperscale Microservice Infrastructure.
items.abstract: Operating a global, real-time platform at Uber’s scale requires infrastructure that is both resilient and cost-efficient. Historically, reliability was ensured through a costly 2× capacity model—each service provisioned to handle global traffic independently across two regions—leaving half the fleet idle. We present Uber’s Failover Architecture (UFA), which replaces the uniform 2× model with a differentiated architecture aligned to business criticality. Critical services retain failover guarantees, while non-critical services opportunistically use failover buffer capacity reserved for critical services during steady state. During rare “full-peak” failovers, non-critical services are selectively preempted and rapidly restored, with differentiated Service-Level Agreements (SLAs) using on-demand capacity. Automated safeguards, including dependency analysis and regression gates, ensure critical services continue to function even while non-critical services are unavailable. The quantitative impact is significant: UFA reduces steady-state provisioning from 2× to 1.3×, raising utilization from 20% toward 30% while sustaining 99.97% availability. To date, UFA has hardened over 4,000 unsafe dependencies, eliminated 575K CPU cores, and projected to reduce over one million cores from a baseline of about 4 million cores.
items.abstract_zh: 运营 Uber 规模的全球实时平台需要既具有弹性又具有成本效益的基础设施。从历史上看，可靠性是通过昂贵的 2 倍容量模型来确保的——每项服务都配置为跨两个区域独立处理全球流量——导致一半的机队闲置。我们介绍 Uber 的故障转移架构 (UFA)，它用与业务关键性相一致的差异化架构取代了统一的 2× 模型。关键服务保留故障转移保证，而非关键服务则机会性地使用在稳定状态期间为关键服务保留的故障转移缓冲区容量。在罕见的“全峰值”故障转移期间，非关键服务会被选择性抢占并快速恢复，并使用按需容量提供差异化​​的服务级别协议 (SLA)。自动化保护措施（包括依赖性分析和回归门）可确保关键服务即使在非关键服务不可用时也能继续运行。定量影响是显着的：UFA 将稳态配置从 2 倍减少到 1.3 倍，将利用率从 20% 提高到 30%，同时维持 99.97% 的可用性。迄今为止，UFA 已强化了 4,000 多个不安全依赖项，消除了 575K 个 CPU 核心，并预计从约 400 万个核心的基准上减少超过 100 万个核心。

items.title: Hierarchical Integration of WebAssembly in Serverless for Efficiency and Interoperability.
items.abstract: Modern serverless systems suffer from low resource efficiency, which maps to high per-unit costs. This comes from the high isolation overhead (e.g., low resource sharing, slow startup, etc.), as well as resource wastage incurred by conservative resource scaling (e.g., keep-alive). Language runtimes such as WebAssembly (Wasm) can reduce isolation overhead without compromising security. Existing Wasm-based serverless approaches fall into one of these categories: supporting only Wasm workloads, failing to leverage existing capabilities of modern serverless and cloud platforms, or falling short of leveraging Wasm’s true potential. This work introduces a dense hierarchical architecture to securely co-locate Wasm-based applications from different customers within the same container sandbox. We show how this design preserves the container-based serving model, which allows leveraging existing platform capabilities and supporting non-Wasm-based workloads. Our system, Wasabi, leverages this architecture alongside resource-aware scaling, queuing, and overbooking to offer much higher density than state-of-the-art serverless systems with similar or better performance.
items.abstract_zh: 现代无服务器系统面临资源效率低下的问题，这对应着单位成本高。这是由于高隔离开销（例如，低资源共享、缓慢启动等），以及保守的资源扩展（例如，保持活动）造成的资源浪费。 WebAssembly (Wasm) 等语言运行时可以在不影响安全性的情况下减少隔离开销。现有的基于 Wasm 的无服务器方法属于以下类别之一：仅支持 Wasm 工作负载，无法利用现代无服务器和云平台的现有功能，或者未能充分利用 Wasm 的真正潜力。这项工作引入了密集的分层架构，可以将来自不同客户的基于 Wasm 的应用程序安全地共置在同一容器沙箱中。我们展示了此设计如何保留基于容器的服务模型，该模型允许利用现有平台功能并支持非基于 Wasm 的工作负载。我们的系统 Wasabi 利用这种架构以及资源感知扩展、排队和超额预订，提供比具有相似或更好性能的最先进的无服务器系统更高的密度。

items.title: Checkmate: Zero Performance Overhead Model Checkpointing via Network Gradient Replication.
items.abstract: This paper presents Checkmate, a system that enables per-iteration checkpointing in DNN training without any training slowdown. The traditional approach to checkpointing requires a pause in training to copy model states to a separate location, allowing the state to be restored in the event of failure. This approach fundamentally has a tradeoff between the frequency of checkpoints and the cost of a failure. We avoid this tradeoff; our key insight is that in data-parallel training, all information necessary to create a checkpoint already exists in the network as gradients. Our core contribution is a new multicast abstraction that simultaneously delivers gradients to a separate CPU-based shadow cluster. The shadow maintains a checkpoint by applying those gradients to a copy of the model. Our evaluation shows that Checkmate performs per-iteration checkpointing with training throughput comparable to an ideal no-checkpoint baseline. Checkmate achieves 5 to 34.5× more frequent checkpointing compared to state-of-the-art checkpointing systems, resulting in 80% to 97.1% reduction in repeated work per failure. At the same checkpointing frequency, Checkmate delivers 1.3× to 6.5× throughput compared to other systems.
items.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 Checkmate，这是一个在 DNN 训练中实现每次迭代检查点的系统，而不会导致任何训练速度减慢。传统的检查点方法需要暂停训练，将模型状态复制到单独的位置，以便在发生故障时恢复状态。这种方法从根本上在检查点频率和故障成本之间进行权衡。我们避免这种权衡；我们的主要见解是，在数据并行训练中，创建检查点所需的所有信息已经作为梯度存在于网络中。我们的核心贡献是一种新的多播抽象，它同时将梯度传递到基于 CPU 的单独影子集群。阴影通过将这些渐变应用于模型的副本来维护检查点。我们的评估表明，Checkmate 执行每次迭代检查点的训练吞吐量与理想的无检查点基线相当。与最先进的检查点系统相比，Checkmate 的检查点频率提高了 5 至 34.5 倍，从而将每次故障的重复工作量减少了 80% 至 97.1%。在相同的检查点频率下，Checkmate 与其他系统相比可提供 1.3 倍至 6.5 倍的吞吐量。

items.title: Secure Vickrey Auctions for Online Advertising.
items.abstract:
Online advertising is an essential part of the web ecosystem. When a user’s browser lands on a webpage, advertisers bid for the ad space. An auction algorithm (e.g., Vickrey/second-price auction) is executed to determine the winner and the price; ideally, only this information is revealed, and everything else (i.e., the losing bids and the bidder identities) is kept private. However, achieving these privacy goals under a malicious security model, while operating under stringent performance requirements for online advertising, is challenging.

Obsidian enables secure Vickrey auctions for online advertising with three ideas: a new Multiparty Computation (MPC)-friendly encoding scheme that decouples bid values from bidders’ identities; a novel use of function secret sharing to shift the cost of encoding validation to an offline phase; and a lightweight ring signature scheme to anonymously verify bidders. Obsidian outperforms generic MPC and homomorphic encryption approaches by orders of magnitude. Moreover, it also surpasses the state-of-the-art system, Addax, which is tailored to ad auctions under a weaker (covert) threat model and leaks more information.
items.abstract_zh:
在线广告是网络生态系统的重要组成部分。当用户的浏览器登陆网页时，广告商会对广告空间进行出价。执行拍卖算法（例如，Vickrey/二价拍卖）来确定获胜者和价格；理想情况下，仅披露此信息，而其他所有信息（即失败的投标和投标人身份）均保密。然而，在恶意安全模型下实现这些隐私目标，同时在严格的在线广告性能要求下运行，是具有挑战性的。

Obsidian 通过三个想法实现在线广告的安全 Vickrey 拍卖：一种新的多方计算 (MPC) 友好编码方案，可将投标价值与投标人身份分离；函数秘密共享的新颖使用将编码验证的成本转移到离线阶段；以及用于匿名验证投标人的轻量级环签名方案。 Obsidian 的性能优于通用 MPC 和同态加密方法几个数量级。此外，它还超越了最先进的系统 Addax，该系统专为较弱（隐蔽）威胁模型下的广告拍卖而定制，并泄露了更多信息。

items.title: Matryoshka: Realizing Hyperscale Data Center Network Design for the AI Era.
items.abstract:
Over the past decade, data center networking (DCN) has undergone substantial transformation in terms of both scale and complexity. Developing a DCN entails multiple intricate steps, such as establishing physical connections, configuring logical network addressing, and defining high-level routing policies. While extensive work has focused on logical DCN design and physical deployment, a critical gap remains: materializing these designs into concrete switch configurations—a necessary step to realize the development procedure. This problem is especially acute in the AI era, as hyperscale, rapidly evolving, and highly heterogeneous AI-driven clusters place unprecedented demands on DCN design and implementation.

This paper presents Matryoshka, Meta’s production-scale DCN design system that bridges this gap. Matryoshka employs an intent-based, model-driven approach to systematically compile high-level DCN design intents into working switch configurations. Operational for over six years, Matryoshka has supported orders-of-magnitude growth in Meta’s DCN infrastructure, guiding the design nearly 900 DCNs across 18 distinct types, including the latest 100K-GPU supercluster for AI training. We share our experience in building and operating Matryoshka, highlighting how it empowers the rapid design and evolution of AI clusters nowadays.
items.abstract_zh:
在过去的十年中，数据中心网络 (DCN) 在规模和复杂性方面都经历了巨大的转变。开发DCN需要多个复杂的步骤，例如建立物理连接、配置逻辑网络寻址以及定义高级路由策略。虽然大量工作集中在逻辑 DCN 设计和物理部署上，但仍然存在一个关键差距：将这些设计具体化为具体的交换机配置——这是实现开发过程的必要步骤。这个问题在人工智能时代尤其严重，因为超大规模、快速发展和高度异构的人工智能驱动集群对DCN设计和实施提出了前所未有的要求。

本文介绍了 Matryoshka，Meta 的生产规模 DCN 设计系统弥补了这一差距。 Matryoshka 采用基于意图的模型驱动方法，系统地将高级 DCN 设计意图编译为工作交换机配置。 Matryoshka 运行六年多来，支持 Meta DCN 基础设施的数量级增长，指导设计 18 种不同类型的近 900 个 DCN，包括用于 AI 训练的最新 100K-GPU 超级集群。我们分享我们在构建和运营俄罗斯套娃方面的经验，重点介绍它如何支持当今人工智能集群的快速设计和演进。

items.title: Themis: Detecting Distributed Concurrency Bugs through RPC-Driven Race-Directed Test Generation and Fuzzing.
items.abstract: Distributed concurrency bugs occur when concurrent execution flows, at least one of which is triggered by inter-node communication such as remote procedure calls (RPCs), access the same shared variable or object in conflicting ways, causing incorrect behavior under certain interleavings. Existing work for detecting distributed concurrency bugs focuses on dynamic approaches, thus suffering from limited coverage. This paper proposes Themis, a novel approach that uses static analysis to detect potential races, applies LLM-based test generation, and employs directed fuzzing to refine input parameters for detecting distributed concurrency bugs. We have implemented a prototype of Themis and evaluated it on eight real-world distributed systems. Themis detects 198 new violations corresponding to 52 new bugs.
items.abstract_zh: 当并发执行流（至少其中之一是由远程过程调用 (RPC) 等节点间通信触发）以冲突方式访问同一共享变量或对象时，就会出现分布式并发错误，从而导致在某些交错下出现不正确的行为。现有的分布式并发错误检测工作主要集中在动态方法上，因此覆盖范围有限。本文提出了 Themis，这是一种新颖的方法，它使用静态分析来检测潜在的竞争，应用基于 LLM 的测试生成，并采用定向模糊测试来细化输入参数以检测分布式并发错误。我们已经实现了 Themis 的原型，并在八个现实世界的分布式系统上对其进行了评估。 Themis 检测到 198 个新违规，对应 52 个新错误。

items.title: Unleashing The Potential of Datacenter SSDs by Taming Performance Variability.
items.abstract: Storage disaggregation is widely adopted in today's datacenters to improve disk utilization. However, efficiently disaggregating SSDs remains a challenge because of their high performance variability. This is due to differences in flash characteristics, such as wear and model version; read/write interference; and SSD-internal operations like garbage collection. Existing systems can only manage these types of variability in isolation. We propose Sandook, a rack-scale block storage system that instead holistically manages them together to unlock higher performance. Sandook achieves this through a logically centralized architecture that can integrate multiple scheduling policies and respond effectively at both short and long timescales. It adaptively steers I/O to the best available SSDs, using techniques that enable greater routing flexibility for both reads and writes. Sandook does not require any special storage or network hardware. Our evaluation demonstrates that Sandook is capable of delivering the full performance potential of SSDs. It achieves a 30%–82% raw I/O throughput improvement over existing systems that tackle a single source of performance variability while maintaining sub-millisecond tail latency. For unmodified applications sharing a pool of SSDs, Sandook achieves a 12–94% improvement in end-to-end performance.
items.abstract_zh: 当今的数据中心广泛采用存储分解来提高磁盘利用率。然而，由于 SSD 的性能变化很大，有效分解 SSD 仍然是一个挑战。这是由于闪存特性存在差异，例如磨损情况和型号版本；读/写干扰；以及 SSD 内部操作，例如垃圾收集。现有系统只能单独管理这些类型的可变性。我们提出了 Sandook，这是一种机架级块存储系统，可以对它们进行整体管理以释放更高的性能。 Sandook 通过逻辑集中的架构实现了这一目标，该架构可以集成多种调度策略，并在短期和长期范围内有效响应。它使用为读取和写入提供更大路由灵活性的技术，自适应地将 I/O 引导至最佳可用 SSD。 Sandook 不需要任何特殊的存储或网络硬件。我们的评估表明 Sandook 能够发挥 SSD 的全部性能潜力。与现有系统相比，它的原始 I/O 吞吐量提高了 30%–82%，解决了性能变化的单一来源，同时保持了亚毫秒级尾部延迟。对于共享 SSD 池的未经修改的应用程序，Sandook 的端到端性能提高了 12-94%。

items.title: Net-P4ct: Enhanced WAN Bandwidth Fair Sharing Using P4 Programmable Switches.
items.abstract: At growing internet companies like ByteDance, Wide Area Network (WAN) bandwidth sharing across diverse services with varying SLO requirements is a fundamental challenge. Conventional host-based enforcement systems, where agents identify and throttle traffic at the server end, face practical challenges such as "blind spot" traffic, kernel-dependent operational complexity, and significant server resource overhead. To address these issues, we present Net-P4ct, an in-network bandwidth enforcement system using P4 programmable switches. Net-P4ct improves both bandwidth guarantees and fair sharing by shifting dynamic QoS control into the switch data plane. Specifically, it achieves broader traffic coverage by combining host-side traffic tagging with a P4-switch pipeline, where service classification and QoS class assignment are performed. Based on observed traffic metrics, a centralized control plane determines real-time policy updates according to the max-min fair bandwidth allocation. We demonstrate the system's benefits including improved bandwidth utilization, reduced operational complexity, and lower per-byte processing cost. Net-P4ct has been deployed in ByteDance's production WAN for nearly a year, and we hope to share our experience with the community.
items.abstract_zh: 对于像字节跳动这样的成长型互联网公司来说，在具有不同 SLO 要求的不同服务之间共享广域网 (WAN) 带宽是一项根本挑战。传统的基于主机的执行系统，其中代理在服务器端识别并限制流量，面临着实际挑战，例如“盲点”流量、依赖于内核的操作复杂性以及显着的服务器资源开销。为了解决这些问题，我们推出了 Net-P4ct，这是一种使用 P4 可编程交换机的网络内带宽强制系统。 Net-P4ct 通过将动态 QoS 控制转移到交换机数据平面来提高带宽保证和公平共享。具体来说，它通过将主机端流量标记与 P4 交换机管道相结合来实现更广泛的流量覆盖，在 P4 交换机管道中执行服务分类和 QoS 类分配。根据观察到的流量指标，集中控制平面根据最大-最小公平带宽分配确定实时策略更新。我们展示了该系统的优势，包括提高带宽利用率、降低操作复杂性以及降低每字节处理成本。 Net-P4ct已经在字节跳动的生产广域网中部署了近一年的时间，我们希望与社区分享我们的经验。

items.title: From Bits to Tokens: Knowledge-Driven Generative Communication of Multimodal Data.
items.abstract: Classical communication systems strive for bit-by-bit reconstruction, yet this objective often misaligns with downstream application tasks, such as perception and decision-making with sensor data. Strict bit-fidelity is especially problematic in wireless settings, where packet losses and channel dynamics undermine both efficiency and resilience. In this paper, we introduce Knowledge-Driven Communication (KDC), a framework that transmits semantic knowledge rather than raw bits by leveraging pretrained knowledge bases. KDC features a task-aware transmitter, which uses multimodal foundation models to abstract source data into tokenized embeddings and prioritize semantically critical content, enabling zero-shot adaptation without task-specific retraining. On the receiver side, KDC employs pretrained knowledge bases and incrementally updated context to reconstruct task-relevant information, enabling graceful degradation even under data loss. We implement a full KDC prototype and evaluate it over diverse data modalities and wireless networks. Experiments show that KDC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art codecs and learned baselines, achieving high task accuracy with a fraction of the transmitted data, while maintaining robustness under challenging wireless conditions.
items.abstract_zh: 经典通信系统致力于逐位重建，但这一目标常常与下游应用任务不一致，例如利用传感器数据进行感知和决策。严格的位保真度在无线设置中尤其成问题，其中数据包丢失和信道动态会破坏效率和弹性。在本文中，我们介绍了知识驱动通信（KDC），这是一个通过利用预训练的知识库来传输语义知识而不是原始位的框架。 KDC 具有任务感知发射器，它使用多模态基础模型将源数据抽象为标记化嵌入，并对语义关键内容进行优先级排序，从而无需特定于任务的重新训练即可实现零样本适应。在接收端，KDC 使用预训练的知识库和增量更新的上下文来重建任务相关信息，即使在数据丢失的情况下也能实现优雅的降级。我们实现了完整的 KDC 原型，并通过不同的数据模式和无线网络对其进行评估。实验表明，KDC 的性能始终优于最先进的编解码器和学习基线，利用一小部分传输数据即可实现较高的任务准确性，同时在具有挑战性的无线条件下保持鲁棒性。

items.title: UNUM: A New Framework for Network Control.
items.abstract:
Modern network control tasks, such as congestion control and adaptive bitrate streaming, require accurate state estimation to adapt to heterogeneous and dynamic network conditions. Current approaches, whether manually engineered or machine learning (ML)-based, often rely on instantaneous or running-average metrics, resulting in imprecise approximations of the true network state. This hinders their ability to capture latent factors, such as application workloads or path dynamics, and adapt to non-stationary environments.

We present Unum, a new framework powered by a unified network state embedder leveraging Transformers' self-attention mechanism and diverse training datasets to learn rich, latent state representations. Unum processes historical RTT-timescale network statistics, models complete current state, and predicts future states using pre-trained embeddings from diverse network scenarios. We develop techniques to augment state-of-the-art controllers with Unum embeddings. Through experiments over real and synthetic settings, we show that using Unum state embeddings improves control performance across tasks, including congestion control and adaptive bitrate streaming.
items.abstract_zh:
现代网络控制任务，例如拥塞控制和自适应比特率流，需要精确的状态估计以适应异构和动态的网络条件。当前的方法，无论是手动设计的还是基于机器学习 (ML) 的，通常依赖于瞬时或运行平均指标，导致对真实网络状态的近似不精确。这阻碍了它们捕获潜在因素（例如应用程序工作负载或路径动态）以及适应非静态环境的能力。

我们提出了 Unum，这是一个由统一网络状态嵌入器提供支持的新框架，利用 Transformer 的自注意力机制和多样化的训练数据集来学习丰富的潜在状态表示。 Unum 处理历史 RTT 时间尺度网络统计数据，对完整的当前状态进行建模，并使用来自不同网络场景的预训练嵌入来预测未来状态。我们开发技术来通过 Unum 嵌入来增强最先进的控制器。通过对真实和合成设置的实验，我们表明使用 Unum 状态嵌入可以提高跨任务的控制性能，包括拥塞控制和自适应比特率流。

items.title: SketchPipe: Toward Accurate Sketch-based Network Measurement on Multi-Pipeline Switches with Splitless Sketch Placement.
items.abstract: Sketches compactly measure traffic statistics with limited resource usage and are compatible with high-speed multi-pipeline switches. Existing solutions place sketches on multi-pipeline switches via array-split placement that splits each sketch array into several identical slices and places each slice on a specific pipeline. However, they incur two issues that drop measurement accuracy: (1) Different slices in different pipelines redundantly measure the same flows, wasting scarce switch resources. (2) Some slices receive much higher traffic loads than other slices. Hence, the data of different slices are highly varied, making their analysis inaccurate. We propose SketchPipe, a framework that offers accurate sketch-based measurement for multi-pipeline switches. The key ideas are two-fold. First, SketchPipe places each sketch array exclusively on a pipeline. Second, it caches the flow keys of normal packets while using synthetic state packets to asynchronously transfer cached keys to sketch arrays. As such, it avoids splitting arrays to enable accurate measurement while avoiding affecting normal packet processing. Our experiments on 12.8 Tbps Tofino2 switches show that SketchPipe improves accuracy by up to two orders of magnitude for various sketches and network monitoring applications.
items.abstract_zh: 草图可以在有限的资源使用情况下紧凑地测量流量统计数据，并且与高速多管道交换机兼容。现有的解决方案通过阵列分割放置将草图放置在多管道交换机上，将每个草图阵列分割成多个相同的片，并将每个片放置在特定的管道上。然而，它们会带来两个降低测量精度的问题：（1）不同管道中的不同切片冗余地测量相同的流，浪费稀有的交换机资源。 (2) 某些切片比其他切片承受更高的流量负载。因此，不同切片的数据差异很大，导致分析不准确。我们提出了 SketchPipe，这是一个为多管道开关提供基于草图的精确测量的框架。关键思想有两个方面。首先，SketchPipe 将每个草图数组专门放置在管道上。其次，它缓存普通数据包的流密钥，同时使用合成状态数据包将缓存的密钥异步传输到草图数组。这样，它可以避免分裂阵列以实现精确测量，同时避免影响正常的数据包处理。我们在 12.8 Tbps Tofino2 交换机上进行的实验表明，SketchPipe 将各种草图和网络监控应用程序的准确性提高了两个数量级。

items.title: BBC: Enabling BLE to Support Bluetooth Classic.
items.abstract:
Bluetooth Classic has been the technology used by the overwhelming majority of wireless headphones. However, Bluetooth Classic is incompatible with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), and hence cannot directly communicate with BLE devices. With the recent shift toward BLE, this incompatibility prevents using simple, energy-efficient BLE chips with Bluetooth headphones, and requires using more complex dual-mode chips to support both Bluetooth Classic and BLE.

To overcome this incompatibility, we present BBC, which enables Bluetooth-Classic connectivity on BLE chips. BBC sends and receives raw FSK bits using BLE hardware while emulating all other Bluetooth-Classic operations in the driver. By eliminating the need for Bluetooth-Classic hardware, BBC enables future devices to use BLE-only chips while maintaining the Bluetooth-Classic compatibility via emulation. It also enables new connectivity for current BLE devices to directly stream audio to Bluetooth-Classic headphones. BBC achieves a throughput of 557kbps and a packet error rate (PER) of 4.86% at the distance of 10m, and provides the same audio quality as off-the-shelf Bluetooth-Classic chips.
items.abstract_zh:
经典蓝牙是绝大多数无线耳机使用的技术。然而，经典蓝牙与低功耗蓝牙 (BLE) 不兼容，因此无法直接与 BLE 设备通信。随着最近向 BLE 的转变，这种不兼容性阻碍了蓝牙耳机使用简单、节能的 BLE 芯片，并且需要使用更复杂的双模芯片来支持经典蓝牙和 BLE。

为了克服这种不兼容性，我们推出了 BBC，它可以在 BLE 芯片上实现经典蓝牙连接。 BBC 使用 BLE 硬件发送和接收原始 FSK 位，同时模拟驱动程序中的所有其他经典蓝牙操作。通过消除对经典蓝牙硬件的需求，BBC 使未来的设备能够使用纯 BLE 芯片，同时通过仿真保持蓝牙经典兼容性。它还为当前的 BLE 设备提供了新的连接，可以将音频直接传输到经典蓝牙耳机。 BBC 在 10m 距离内实现了 557kbps 的吞吐量和 4.86% 的数据包错误率 (PER)，并提供与现成的蓝牙经典芯片相同的音频质量。

items.title: Observability Is Eating Your Cores: Fine-Grained Analysis of Microservice Metrics with IPU-Hosted Sketches.
items.abstract: Observability has become mission-critical for troubleshooting cloud-native technology. However, today's observability fails to meet the demands of cloud-native environments, either resulting in crippling complexity and high costs for collecting and storing huge data volumes, or sacrificing events coverage by sampling at coarse time granularity. We present μView, which stands out from conventional cloud monitors by incorporating a lightweight observability data-plane on Infrastructure Processing Units (IPUs). Our novel architecture leverages the proximity of IPUs to the monitored services to tackle observability bloat. Crucially, μView's data-plane applies streaming data sketching techniques to continuously process and analyze microservice's metrics at fine time resolution, without hurting application performance. We show for several use cases that by anticipating SLO violations μView can help (i) narrow the focus on informative observability data, and (ii) trigger useful signals about service performance, thus enabling timely proactive actions. Our code and artifacts are available at: https://github.com/sands-lab/uview .
items.abstract_zh: 可观察性已成为云原生技术故障排除的关键任务。然而，当今的可观测性无法满足云原生环境的需求，要么导致收集和存储大量数据的复杂性和高昂成本，要么通过粗时间粒度采样而牺牲事件覆盖率。我们推出 μView，它通过在基础设施处理单元 (IPU) 上集成轻量级可观测数据平面，从传统云监视器中脱颖而出。我们新颖的架构利用 IPU 与受监控服务的接近性来解决可观测性膨胀问题。至关重要的是，μView 的数据平面应用流数据草图技术以精细的时间分辨率连续处理和分析微服务的指标，而不会损害应用程序性能。我们通过几个用例证明，通过预测 SLO 违规，μView 可以帮助 (i) 缩小对信息性可观测性数据的关注范围，以及 (ii) 触发有关服务性能的有用信号，从而实现及时的主动行动。我们的代码和工件可在以下位置获取：https://github.com/sands-lab/uview。

items.title: FLARE: Anomaly Diagnostics for Divergent LLM Training in GPU Clusters of Thousand-Plus Scale.
items.abstract: The rapid proliferation of large language models has driven the need for efficient GPU training clusters. However, it is challenging due to the frequent occurrence of training anomalies. Since existing diagnostic tools are narrowly tailored to specific issues, there are gaps in their ability to address anomalies spanning the entire training stack. In response, we introduce FLARE, a diagnostic framework designed for distributed LLM training at scale. FLARE first integrates a lightweight tracing daemon for full-stack and backend-extensible tracing. Additionally, it features a diagnostic engine that automatically diagnoses anomalies, with a focus on performance regressions. The deployment of FLARE across 6,000 GPUs has demonstrated significant improvements in pinpointing deficiencies in real-world scenarios, with continuous operation for over eight months.
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型的快速增长推动了对高效 GPU 训练集群的需求。然而，由于训练异常的频繁发生，这具有挑战性。由于现有的诊断工具针对特定问题进行了狭隘的定制，因此它们解决整个训练堆栈异常的能力存在差距。为此，我们推出了 FLARE，这是一种专为大规模分布式 LLM 培训而设计的诊断框架。 FLARE 首先集成了一个轻量级跟踪守护程序，用于全堆栈和后端可扩展的跟踪。此外，它还具有自动诊断异常的诊断引擎，重点关注性能回归。在 6,000 个 GPU 上部署 FLARE 在查明现实场景中的缺陷方面取得了显着改进，并且连续运行了八个多月。

items.title: Mitigating CPU Frontend for Complex Data Plane Applications.
items.abstract: The functionality and requirement of modern networks are becoming increasingly complex, giving rise to Complex Data Plane Applications (CDPA) with rich semantics but often limited performance. However, many existing optimizations fail to improve the performance of CDPAs. This is because CDPAs usually come with excessively large code size, which is often two orders of magnitude larger than today's L1 instruction cache (I-cache) size, causing the CPU to frequently stall on accessing instructions, thus presenting a distinct performance profile that bounds on CPU frontend. This paper proposes NanoPL, an I-cache-friendly new execution model that shuffles the packet processing logic to efficiently mitigate CPU frontend for CDPAs. Stemming from the common execution pattern of CDPAs, NanoPL analyzes its code to ensure semantic consistency after shuffling. By collecting performance profile of CDPAs over underlying traffic, NanoPL partitions CDPAs into execution stages and conducts I-cache-friendly shuffling policy. Experiments show that NanoPL can achieve 17.2%~30.2% higher throughput over real world CDPAs due to the reduction of I-cache misses by up to 86.4%.
items.abstract_zh: 现代网络的功能和要求变得越来越复杂，从而产生了具有丰富语义但性能往往有限的复杂数据平面应用程序（CDPA）。然而，许多现有的优化无法提高 CDPA 的性能。这是因为 CDPA 通常具有过大的代码大小，通常比当今的 L1 指令缓存 (I-cache) 大小大两个数量级，导致 CPU 在访问指令时频繁停滞，从而呈现出限制 CPU 前端的独特性能特征。本文提出了 NanoPL，这是一种 I-cache 友好的新执行模型，它对数据包处理逻辑进行重组，以有效减轻 CDPA 的 CPU 前端问题。源于 CDPA 的常见执行模式，NanoPL 分析其代码以确保改组后的语义一致性。通过收集 CDPA 在底层流量上的性能概况，NanoPL 将 CDPA 划分为执行阶段并执行 I-cache 友好的混洗策略。实验表明，NanoPL 的吞吐量比实际 CDPA 高出 17.2%~30.2%，因为 I-cache 未命中减少了高达 86.4%。

items.title: HEDGE: Traffic Engineering with Probabilistic Link Capacities.
items.abstract: Cloud providers have adopted higher modulation formats to achieve higher data-rate wavelengths in their optical wide-area networks. However, higher modulation formats reduce signal quality margins, making wavelengths more susceptible to wavelength-specific faults (WSFs)—temporary faults that selectively affect certain wavelengths while others remain unaffected, even though they all share the same optical fiber and equipment. WSFs cause the capacity of inter-datacenter links to fluctuate, frequently disrupting traffic engineering systems. We propose HEDGE, a system that mitigates the effects of WSFs by implementing link-local resilience and global network-wide resilience against WSFs. For local resilience, HEDGE provisions inter-datacenter links with a guaranteed minimum capacity and availability target, in spite of WSFs, while using the fewest possible constituent wavelengths. For global resilience, HEDGE optimally balances throughput and availability while allocating flows on a stochastic wide-area network with fluctuating link capacities. HEDGE sustains equivalent throughput with state-of-the-art traffic engineering systems, while dropping 12.2× less network flow in worst-case scenarios and reducing disruptions to tunnel allocations by 622× in spite of a rapidly changing topology.
items.abstract_zh: 云提供商已采用更高的调制格式，以在其光广域网中实现更高的数据速率波长。然而，更高的调制格式会降低信号质量裕度，使波长更容易受到波长特定故障 (WSF) 的影响，即选择性影响某些波长而其他波长不受影响的临时故障，即使它们都共享相同的光纤和设备。 WSF 会导致数据中心间链路的容量波动，经常扰乱流量工程系统。我们提出 HEDGE，这是一个通过实施链路本地弹性和全球网络范围内针对 WSF 的弹性来减轻 WSF 影响的系统。为了实现本地弹性，HEDGE 为数据中心间链路提供保证的最小容量和可用性目标，尽管存在 WSF，但同时使用尽可能少的组成波长。为了实现全球弹性，HEDGE 可以在吞吐量和可用性之间实现最佳平衡，同时在链路容量波动的随机广域网上分配流量。 HEDGE 与最先进的流量工程系统保持相同的吞吐量，同时在最坏情况下减少 12.2 倍的网络流量，并将隧道分配的中断减少 622 倍，尽管拓扑结构快速变化。

items.title: A Systematic Threat Analysis and Practical Attacks on Automated Frequency Coordination Systems.
items.abstract: The 6 GHz band, traditionally reserved for mission-critical incumbent systems such as public safety communications, utility infrastructure, and fixed satellite services, has recently been opened for Wi-Fi devices. This expansion introduces a critical coexistence challenge of ensuring that unlicensed Wi-Fi Access Points (APs) do not interfere with incumbent operations. To manage this risk, regulators mandated the use of Automated Frequency Coordination (AFC) systems that assign spectrum access to Wi-Fi APs based on their locations. In this work, we present the first systematic security analysis of AFC systems. In particular, we analyze the trust assumptions of AFC systems and uncover design lapses and deployment mishaps in this model. Our analysis reveals that the AFC's dependence on unauthenticated data sources, including GNSS/GPS and Wi-Fi-based localization (for location), DNS (for service discovery), and NTP (for time synchronization), creates practical off-path attack vectors that allow adversaries to manipulate control-plane parameters without breaking cryptographic protections between APs and AFC servers. For example, using inexpensive, off-the-shelf software-defined radios, an off-path adversary can spoof the GPS signals received by an AP, falsifying its reported location to either disable 6 GHz transmissions or cause harmful interference with incumbent services. We validate these vectors empirically on commercial APs from four major vendors and evaluate four commercial and one open-source AFC servers to measure real-world impact. We also propose potential mitigations and analyze the trade-offs between usability and security to formulate our recommendations to harden AFC deployments and 6 GHz APs.
items.abstract_zh: 6 GHz 频段传统上保留给公共安全通信、公用事业基础设施和固定卫星服务等关键任务现有系统，最近已向 Wi-Fi 设备开放。这种扩展带来了关键的共存挑战，即确保未经许可的 Wi-Fi 接入点 (AP) 不会干扰现有运营。为了管理这一风险，监管机构强制使用自动频率协调 (AFC) 系统，该系统根据 Wi-Fi AP 的位置为其分配频谱访问权限。在这项工作中，我们首次对 AFC 系统进行系统的安全分析。特别是，我们分析了 AFC 系统的信任假设，并发现了该模型中的设计失误和部署事故。我们的分析表明，AFC 对未经身份验证的数据源的依赖，包括 GNSS/GPS 和基于 Wi-Fi 的定位（用于位置）、DNS（用于服务发现）和 NTP（用于时间同步），创建了实用的偏离路径攻击向量，允许对手在不破坏 AP 和 AFC 服务器之间的加密保护的情况下操纵控制平面参数。例如，使用廉价、现成的软件定义无线电，偏离路径的对手可以欺骗 AP 接收的 GPS 信号，伪造其报告的位置，从而禁用 6 GHz 传输或对现有服务造成有害干扰。我们在四家主要供应商的商业 AP 上凭经验验证了这些向量，并评估了四台商业服务器和一台开源 AFC 服务器以衡量现实世界的影响。我们还提出了潜在的缓解措施，并分析了可用性和安全性之间的权衡，以制定强化 AFC 部署和 6 GHz AP 的建议。

items.title: Bifrost: Alibaba's Next-Generation VPC Network with High-Performance Multipath Reliable Transport.
items.abstract: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) has become an increasingly important infrastructure-level service that provides isolated virtual networking environments for cloud tenants. In Alibaba Cloud, over 80% of tenant applications require reliable data transport, which is currently implemented in VPC networks through guest-side TCP. However, TCP often suffers significant performance degradation when facing network instabilities in production clouds, especially for tail-latency sensitive applications such as Redis and Nginx. In this paper, we present Bifrost, the next-generation VPC network in Alibaba Cloud that provides high-performance multipath reliable transport. Bifrost employs RTT-aware multipath packet spraying to bypass failures and mitigate elephant flows, ensures in-order delivery via in-place guest reordering, achieves end-to-end reliability with delayed bitmap ACKs, and performs efficient reliability state management to support large-scale deployment. Extensive evaluation shows that Bifrost reduces tail latency by up to 307× for Redis and 66× for Nginx, achieves millisecond-level failure recovery, and supports O(100k) concurrent connections per SmartNIC.
items.abstract_zh: 虚拟私有云（VPC）已成为越来越重要的基础设施级服务，为云租户提供隔离的虚拟网络环境。在阿里云中，超过80%的租户应用需要可靠的数据传输，目前在VPC网络中通过访客侧TCP实现。然而，当生产云中面临网络不稳定时，TCP 常常会遭受显着的性能下降，特别是对于 Redis 和 Nginx 等尾延迟敏感的应用程序。在本文中，我们介绍了阿里云中的下一代 VPC 网络 Bifrost，它提供高性能多路径可靠传输。 Bifrost 采用 RTT 感知多路径数据包喷射来绕过故障并减轻大象流量，通过就地访客重新排序确保按顺序交付，通过延迟位图 ACK 实现端到端可靠性，并执行高效的可靠性状态管理以支持大规模部署。广泛评估表明，Bifrost 可为 Redis 降低高达 307 倍的尾部延迟，为 Nginx 降低高达 66 倍的尾部延迟，实现毫秒级故障恢复，并支持每个 SmartNIC 的 O(100k) 并发连接。

items.title: PlanetServe: A Decentralized, Scalable, and Privacy-Preserving Overlay for Democratizing Large Language Model Serving.
items.abstract: While significant progress has been made in research and development on open-source and cost-efficient large-language models (LLMs), serving scalability remains a critical challenge, particularly for small organizations and individuals seeking to deploy and test their LLM innovations. Inspired by peer-to-peer networks that leverage decentralized overlay nodes to increase throughput and availability, we propose PlanetServe, an LLM serving overlay that harnesses computing resources from decentralized contributors. We identify four key research problems inherent to enabling such a decentralized infrastructure: 1) overlay network organization; 2) LLM communication privacy; 3) overlay forwarding for resource efficiency; and 4) verification of serving quality. This work presents the first systematic study of these fundamental problems in the context of decentralized LLM serving. Evaluation results from a prototype implemented on a set of decentralized nodes demonstrate that PlanetServe achieves a latency reduction of over 50% compared to the baseline design without overlay forwarding. Furthermore, the security features introduce minimal overhead to serving latency and throughput. We believe this work pioneers a new direction for democratizing and scaling future AI serving capabilities.
items.abstract_zh: 虽然开源和经济高效的大语言模型 (LLM) 的研究和开发取得了重大进展，但服务可扩展性仍然是一个严峻的挑战，特别是对于寻求部署和测试其 LLM 创新的小型组织和个人而言。受到利用分散式覆盖节点来提高吞吐量和可用性的点对点网络的启发，我们提出了 PlanetServe，这是一种 LLM 服务覆盖层，可利用分散式贡献者的计算资源。我们确定了实现这种去中心化基础设施所固有的四个关键研究问题：1）覆盖网络组织； 2）LLM通讯隐私； 3）覆盖转发以提高资源效率； 4) 服务质量验证。这项工作首次在分散的法学硕士服务背景下系统地研究了这些基本问题。在一组去中心化节点上实施的原型的评估结果表明，与没有覆盖转发的基准设计相比，PlanetServe 实现了超过 50% 的延迟减少。此外，安全功能将服务延迟和吞吐量的开销降至最低。我们相信这项工作为未来人工智能服务能力的民主化和扩展开辟了新方向。

items.title: Sparse Checkpointing for Fast and Reliable MoE Training.
items.abstract:
As large language models scale, training them requires thousands of GPUs over extended durations—making frequent failures an inevitable reality. While checkpointing remains the primary fault-tolerance mechanism, existing methods fall short when applied to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. Due to their substantially larger training state, MoE models exacerbate checkpointing overheads, often causing costly stalls or prolonged recovery that severely degrade training efficiency.

We present MoEvement, a distributed, in-memory checkpointing system tailored for MoE models. MoEvement is built on three key ideas: (1) sparse checkpointing , which incrementally snapshots subsets of experts across iterations to reduce overhead; (2) a sparse-to-dense checkpoint conversion mechanism that incrementally reconstructs consistent dense checkpoints from sparse snapshots; and (3) upstream logging of activations and gradients at pipeline-stage boundaries, enabling localized recovery without re-executing unaffected workers. Evaluations across diverse MoE models with up to 64 experts show that MoEvement reduces checkpointing overhead by up to 4× and recovery overhead by up to 31× compared to state-of-the-art approaches, sustaining ETTR ≥ 0.94 even under frequent failures (MTBF as low as 10 minutes) and delivering up to 8× overall training speedup, all without compromising synchronous training semantics. Overall, MoEvement offers a scalable, practical fault-tolerance solution for the next generation of sparsely activated models.
items.abstract_zh:
随着大型语言模型规模的扩大，训练它们需要在较长时间内使用数千个 GPU，这使得频繁失败成为不可避免的现实。虽然检查点仍然是主要的容错机制，但现有方法在应用于专家混合 (MoE) 模型时存在不足。由于其训练状态要大得多，MoE 模型会加剧检查点开销，通常会导致代价高昂的停顿或长时间的恢复，从而严重降低训练效率。

我们推出了 MoEvement，这是一种专为 MoE 模型量身定制的分布式内存检查点系统。 MoEvement 建立在三个关键思想之上：(1) 稀疏检查点，它在迭代中增量快照专家子集以减少开销； （2）稀疏到密集检查点转换机制，从稀疏快照增量重建一致的密集检查点； (3) 上游记录管道阶段边界处的激活和梯度，从而实现局部恢复，而无需重新执行未受影响的工作程序。对多达 64 名专家的不同 MoE 模型进行的评估表明，与最先进的方法相比，MoEvement 将检查点开销减少了高达 4 倍，将恢复开销减少了高达 31 倍，即使在频繁故障的情况下也能维持 ETTR ≥ 0.94（MTBF 低至 10 分钟），并提供高达 8 倍的整体训练加速，所有这些都不会影响同步训练语义。总体而言，MoEvement 为下一代稀疏激活模型提供了可扩展、实用的容错解决方案。

items.title: FENIX: Enabling In-Network DNN Inference with FPGA-Enhanced Programmable Switches.
items.abstract: Machine learning (ML) is increasingly used in network data planes for advanced traffic analysis, but existing solutions (such as FlowLens, N3IC, BoS) still struggle to simultaneously achieve low latency, high throughput, and high accuracy. To address these challenges, we present FENIX, a hybrid in-network ML system that performs feature extraction on programmable switch ASICs and deep neural network inference on FPGAs. FENIX introduces a Data Engine that leverages a probabilistic token bucket algorithm to control the sending rate of feature streams, effectively addressing the throughput gap between programmable switch ASICs and FPGAs. In addition, FENIX designs a Model Engine to enable high-accuracy deep neural network inference in the network, overcoming the difficulty of deploying complex models on resource-constrained switch chips. We implement FENIX on a programmable switch platform that integrates a Tofino ASIC and a ZU19EG FPGA directly, and evaluate it on real-world network traffic datasets. Our results show that FENIX achieves microsecond-level inference latency and multi-terabit throughput with low hardware overhead, and delivers over 90% accuracy on mainstream network traffic classification tasks, outperforming the state of the art.
items.abstract_zh: 机器学习 (ML) 越来越多地用于网络数据平面中以进行高级流量分析，但现有解决方案（例如 FlowLens、N3IC、BoS）仍然难以同时实现低延迟、高吞吐量和高精度。为了应对这些挑战，我们推出了 FENIX，这是一种混合网络内 ML 系统，可在可编程交换机 ASIC 上执行特征提取，并在 FPGA 上执行深度神经网络推理。 FENIX引入了数据引擎，利用概率令牌桶算法来控制特征流的发送速率，有效解决可编程交换机ASIC和FPGA之间的吞吐量差距。此外，FENIX还设计了模型引擎，可在网络中实现高精度深度神经网络推理，克服了在资源受限的交换芯片上部署复杂模型的困难。我们在直接集成 Tofino ASIC 和 ZU19EG FPGA 的可编程交换机平台上实现 FENIX，并在真实网络流量数据集上对其进行评估。我们的结果表明，FENIX 以较低的硬件开销实现了微秒级的推理延迟和多太比特的吞吐量，并在主流网络流量分类任务上提供了超过 90% 的准确率，超越了现有技术。

items.title: RollPacker: Taming Long-Tail Rollouts for RL Post-Training with Tail Batching.
items.abstract:
Reinforcement Learning (RL) is a pivotal post-training technique for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, synchronous RL post‑training frequently suffers from significant GPU underutilization—often referred to as pipeline "bubbles"—caused by imbalanced response lengths within rollout steps. Many RL systems attempt to alleviate this problem by relaxing synchronization, but this can compromise training accuracy.

In this paper, we introduce tail batching, a novel rollout scheduling strategy for synchronous RL. Tail batching systematically consolidates prompts leading to long-tail responses into a few designated "long rounds", ensuring that the majority of rollout steps ("short rounds") contain only balanced, short responses. By strategically reordering execution, this approach dramatically reduces GPU idle time and accelerates RL training without sacrificing on-policy accuracy. We present RollPacker, a system that fully harnesses the benefits of tail batching through holistic optimizations across all three RL stages: elastic parallelism adaptation for rollout, dynamic resource allocation and scheduling for reward, and stream-based training. Cluster deployment on up to 128 H800 GPUs demonstrates that RollPacker achieves an end-to-end training speedup of 2.03× to 2.56× over veRL, and up to 2.24× speedup compared to RLHFuse across the Qwen2.5 family of LLMs. The code is available at https://github.com/Farrrrland/RollPacker .
items.abstract_zh:
强化学习（RL）是增强大型语言模型（LLM）推理能力的关键后训练技术。然而，同步强化学习后训练经常会遇到 GPU 利用率严重不足的问题（通常称为管道“气泡”），这是由于推出步骤中的响应长度不平衡造成的。许多强化学习系统试图通过放松同步来缓解这个问题，但这可能会影响训练的准确性。

在本文中，我们介绍了尾批处理，这是一种新颖的同步强化学习调度策略。尾批处理系统地将导致长尾响应的提示合并到几个指定的“长轮”中，确保大多数推出步骤（“短轮”）仅包含平衡的短响应。通过策略性地重新排序执行，这种方法可显着减少 GPU 空闲时间并加速 RL 训练，而不会牺牲策略准确性。我们推出了 RollPacker，这是一个通过所有三个 RL 阶段的整体优化来充分利用尾批处理优势的系统：用于推出的弹性并行自适应、动态资源分配和奖励调度以及基于流的训练。在多达 128 个 H800 GPU 上的集群部署表明，RollPacker 在 Qwen2.5 系列 LLM 中实现了比 veRL 2.03 倍到 2.56 倍的端到端训练加速，与 RLHFuse 相比高达 2.24 倍的加速。代码可在 https://github.com/Farrrrland/RollPacker 获取。

items.title: Morphe: High-Fidelity Generative Video Streaming with Vision Foundation Model.
items.abstract:
Video streaming is a fundamental Internet service, while the quality still cannot be guaranteed especially in poor network conditions such as bandwidth-constrained and remote areas. Existing works mainly work towards two directions: traditional pixel-codec streaming nearly approaches its limit and is hard to step further in compression; the emerging neural-enhanced or generative streaming usually fall short in latency and visual fidelity, hindering their practical deployment.

Inspired by the recent success of vision foundation model (VFM), we strive to harness the powerful video understanding and processing capacities of VFM to achieve generalization, high fidelity and loss resilience for real-time video streaming with even higher compression rate. We present Morphe, the first revolutionized paradigm that enables VFM-based end-to-end generative video streaming towards this goal. Specifically, Morphe employs joint training of visual tokenizers and variable-resolution spatiotemporal optimization under simulated network constraints. Additionally, a robust streaming system is constructed that leverages intelligent packet dropping to resist real-world network perturbations. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that Morphe achieves comparable visual quality while saving 62.5% bandwidth compared to H.265, and accomplishes real-time, loss-resilient video delivery in challenging network environments, representing a milestone in VFM-enabled multimedia streaming solutions.
items.abstract_zh:
视频流是互联网的基础服务，但在带宽受限、偏远地区等网络条件较差的情况下，视频质量仍难以保证。现有的工作主要致力于两个方向：传统的像素编解码器流几乎接近其极限，在压缩方面难以进一步发展；新兴的神经增强或生成流通常在延迟和视觉保真度方面不足，阻碍了它们的实际部署。

受视觉基础模型（VFM）最近成功的启发，我们努力利用 VFM 强大的视频理解和处理能力，以更高的压缩率实现实时视频流的泛化、高保真度和抗损失能力。我们推出了 Morphe，这是第一个革命性的范例，它使基于 VFM 的端到端生成视频流能够实现这一目标。具体来说，Morphe 在模拟网络约束下采用视觉分词器和可变分辨率时空优化的联合训练。此外，还构建了一个强大的流媒体系统，利用智能丢包来抵御现实世界的网络扰动。广泛的评估表明，与 H.265 相比，Morphe 实现了可比的视觉质量，同时节省了 62.5% 的带宽，并在具有挑战性的网络环境中实现了实时、防丢包的视频传输，这是支持 VFM 的多媒体流解决方案的一个里程碑。

items.title: Who Watches the Watchers? On the Reliability of Softwarizing Cloud Application Management.
items.abstract: Modern cloud applications are increasingly managed by software programs, often named “operators,” which automate laborious, human-based operations. While operator programs largely prevent human mistakes, their own reliability has unprecedented impact on managed applications. This paper discusses the emerging challenges of operator program reliability on cloud-native platforms like Kubernetes. Our work is grounded in a rigorous analysis of 412 real-world failures of thirteen Kubernetes operators. We find that challenges of operator reliability come from the multifold complexity of an operator’s interactions with its managed applications, environment, and user interface. Among these, operators’ interactions with managed applications are the largest contributor to real-world operator failures, but they are largely overlooked—these interactions are often ad hoc and lack well-defined interfaces. We advocate to rethink the management interface of cloud applications and demonstrate this urgent need by showing the prevalence of defects in existing operators. Specifically, we develop a simple testing tool to exercise interactions between operators and the managed cloud applications, which discovered 86 new bugs in six popular Kubernetes operators.
items.abstract_zh: 现代云应用程序越来越多地由软件程序进行管理，这些软件程序通常被称为“操作员”，这些软件程序可以自动执行繁重的、基于人的操作。虽然操作员程序在很大程度上可以防止人为错误，但其自身的可靠性对托管应用程序具有前所未有的影响。本文讨论了 Kubernetes 等云原生平台上操作程序可靠性的新挑战。我们的工作基于对 13 个 Kubernetes 操作员的 412 次实际故障的严格分析。我们发现运营商可靠性的挑战来自于运营商与其托管应用程序、环境和用户界面交互的多重复杂性。其中，操作员与托管应用程序的交互是导致现实操作失败的最大因素，但它们在很大程度上被忽视了——这些交互通常是临时的，并且缺乏明确定义的接口。我们主张重新思考云应用的管理界面，并通过展示现有运营商普遍存在的缺陷来展示这一迫切需求。具体来说，我们开发了一个简单的测试工具来练习 Operator 和托管云应用程序之间的交互，该工具在 6 个流行的 Kubernetes Operator 中发现了 86 个新错误。

items.title: ZOC: Elastic and Cost-Efficient Virtual SmartNIC Architecture for Cloud Physical Machines.
items.abstract: DPU-based SmartNICs are reshaping cloud infrastructure by offloading core I/O functions, enabling cloud physical machines that support both bare-metal and virtualized environments. However, large-scale deployments face practical challenges—including operational inconsistency across heterogeneous fleets, limited resource elasticity, and performance bottlenecks caused by slow-path processing. We present ZOC, a software-defined virtual SmartNIC architecture that transforms general-purpose servers equipped with commodity NICs into full-featured cloud physical machines. ZOC delivers compatibility with existing infrastructure and provides a user experience on par with DPU-based nodes—without requiring any specialized hardware. At its core, ZOC integrates a passthrough NIC and dynamically provisioned host resources into a dedicated service VM, forming an elastic and programmable acceleration platform. Built upon this foundation, it introduces an efficient cross-domain device abstraction that exposes standardized I/O devices to the host, enabling seamless access to cloud storage and VPC networks. Extensive evaluation shows that ZOC achieves superior cost efficiency, eliminates slow-path bottlenecks, and provides high maintainability. Deployed in a major cloud, ZOC serves diverse public and private cloud services as a production-ready complement to existing DPU-based solutions.
items.abstract_zh: 基于 DPU 的 SmartNIC 正在通过卸载核心 I/O 功能来重塑云基础设施，使云物理机能够同时支持裸机和虚拟化环境。然而，大规模部署面临实际挑战，包括异构队列之间的操作不一致、资源弹性有限以及慢路径处理造成的性能瓶颈。我们推出了 ZOC，一种软件定义的虚拟 SmartNIC 架构，可将配备商用 NIC 的通用服务器转变为功能齐全的云物理机。 ZOC 提供与现有基础设施的兼容性，并提供与基于 DPU 的节点同等的用户体验，而无需任何专门的硬件。 ZOC的核心是将直通网卡和动态配置的主机资源集成到专用服务虚拟机中，形成弹性、可编程的加速平台。在此基础上，它引入了高效的跨域设备抽象，将标准化的 I/O 设备暴露给主机，从而实现对云存储和 VPC 网络的无缝访问。广泛的评估表明，ZOC实现了卓越的成本效率，消除了慢路径瓶颈，并提供了高可维护性。 ZOC 部署在主要云中，提供多种公共和私有云服务，作为对现有基于 DPU 的解决方案的生产就绪补充。

items.title: BayWatch: Practical Internet-Scale Topology Monitoring with Dynamic Bayesian Estimation.
items.abstract:
Internet topology monitoring is important for understanding topology dynamics. While a few commercial services have been provided to monitor the specified topology, academic research on Internet-scale topology monitoring still lags behind with two key limitations: 1) topology incompleteness caused by simplified assumption of uniform load-balancing responses (LBR) distribution; 2) low probing efficiency due to the lack of temporal awareness.

In this paper, we introduce BayWatch, a practical Internet-scale topology monitoring system that overcomes these limitations based on a Dynamic Bayesian Network (DBN). Leveraging the Markov property of packet forwarding, BayWatch models it as a sequence of state transitions over time within the DBN, so as to estimate the true LBR distribution and predict its temporal evolution. Internet-wide measurement results demonstrate that benefiting from the estimated LBR distribution, BayWatch can discover 2.4×/2.8× more nodes/links than the state-of-the-art algorithm, D-Miner, while the temporal awareness reduces the number of probes by 6.3× with negligible topology completeness loss. Moreover, we demonstrate that BayWatch can help detect anomalies using a real-world network outage event.
items.abstract_zh:
互联网拓扑监控对于理解拓扑动态非常重要。虽然已经提供了一些商业服务来监控指定的拓扑，但互联网规模的拓扑监控的学术研究仍然落后，存在两个关键限制：1）由于统一负载均衡响应（LBR）分布的简化假设而导致拓扑不完整性； 2）由于缺乏时间意识导致探测效率低。

在本文中，我们介绍了 BayWatch，这是一种实用的互联网规模的拓扑监控系统，它基于动态贝叶斯网络（DBN）克服了这些限制。利用数据包转发的马尔可夫特性，BayWatch 将其建模为 DBN 内随时间推移的状态转换序列，从而估计真实的 LBR 分布并预测其时间演化。全互联网测量结果表明，受益于估计的 LBR 分布，BayWatch 可以比最先进的算法 D-Miner 发现多 2.4 倍/2.8 倍的节点/链路，而时间感知将探测数量减少 6.3 倍，拓扑完整性损失可以忽略不计。此外，我们还证明 BayWatch 可以通过真实世界的网络中断事件来帮助检测异常情况。

items.title: EROICA: Online Performance Troubleshooting for Large-scale Model Training.
items.abstract: Troubleshooting performance problems of large model training (LMT) is immensely challenging, due to unprecedented scales of modern GPU clusters, the complexity of software-hardware interactions, and the data intensity of the training process. Existing troubleshooting approaches designed for traditional distributed systems or datacenter networks fall short and can hardly apply to real-world training systems. In this paper, we present EROICA, the first online troubleshooting system that provides both fine-grained observation based on profiling, and coverage of all machines in GPU clusters, to diagnose performance issues in production, including both hardware and software problems (or the mixture of both). EROICA effectively summarizes runtime behavior patterns of LMT function executions via online profiling, and leverages differential observability to localize the root cause with minimal production impact. EROICA has been deployed as a production service for large-scale GPU clusters of ~100,000 GPUs for 1.5 years. It has diagnosed a variety of difficult performance issues with 97.5% success.
items.abstract_zh: 由于现代 GPU 集群规模空前、软硬件交互的复杂性以及训练过程的数据强度，解决大型模型训练 (LMT) 的性能问题极具挑战性。现有的针对传统分布式系统或数据中心网络设计的故障排除方法存在缺陷，很难应用于现实世界的训练系统。在本文中，我们介绍了 EROICA，这是第一个在线故障排除系统，它既提供基于分析的细粒度观察，又覆盖 GPU 集群中的所有机器，以诊断生产中的性能问题，包括硬件和软件问题（或两者的混合）。 EROICA 通过在线分析有效总结 LMT 函数执行的运行时行为模式，并利用差异可观测性以最小的生产影响来定位根本原因。 EROICA 已作为约 100,000 个 GPU 的大规模 GPU 集群的生产服务部署了 1.5 年。它以 97.5% 的成功率诊断了各种困难的性能问题。

items.title: Skyline: A Cloud Centric Internet Monitoring Engine.
items.abstract: Cloud providers depend on the public Internet to connect tenants and their clients, yet Internet faults are a leading cause of cloud outages: in our organization, more than 60% of network incidents happen in the Internet and account for close to 80% of user-impacting events. Effectively monitoring the Internet is challenging for cloud providers because they lack direct control and visibility into Internet internals. Our key insight is to treat coverage as a first-class goal and decompose the monitoring requirements into three coverage dimensions — traffic direction , incident lifecycle , and tenant granularity —then resolve each independently. We present Skyline, a cloud-centric Internet monitoring system that addresses all coverage dimensions at scale by combining purpose-built dataplane hooks with lightweight software control to minimize resource overhead, shorten reaction time, and preserve non-intrusiveness. Skyline has been deployed for more than two years. In 2025, it identified over 2,000 incidents with very high precision and recall over confirmed issues, thereby significantly improving the reliability of our cloud network.
items.abstract_zh: 云提供商依靠公共互联网来连接租户及其客户，但互联网故障是云中断的主要原因：在我们的组织中，超过 60% 的网络事件发生在互联网上，并占影响用户事件的近 80%。有效监控互联网对于云提供商来说是一项挑战，因为他们缺乏对互联网内部结构的直接控制和可见性。我们的主要见解是将覆盖范围视为首要目标，并将监控需求分解为三个覆盖维度——流量方向、事件生命周期和租户粒度——然后独立解决每个维度。我们推出了 Skyline，这是一种以云为中心的互联网监控系统，通过将专用数据平面挂钩与轻量级软件控制相结合，可大规模解决所有覆盖范围问题，从而最大程度地减少资源开销、缩短反应时间并保持非侵入性。 Skyline 已经部署两年多了。到 2025 年，它以非常高的精度识别了 2,000 多个事件，并对已确认的问题进行了召回，从而显着提高了我们云网络的可靠性。

items.title: Building A CSFQ-Inspired Transport for Switched CXL Memory Pooling.
items.abstract:
Emerging switched CXL memory pooling systems, albeit promising, suffer from significant performance interference due to the shared but performance-uncontrolled data path among concurrent memory streams between a host core and a remote DIMM. We systematically characterize a memory pooling appliance based on the XConn’s Apollo CXL switch, and identify three issues: intra-host contention, in-fabric congestion, and unmanaged host-remote DIMM interaction.

This paper presents a new transport layer, MemChannel , which provides the mchannel abstraction to manage end-to-end fabric bandwidth among competing memory flows and enable application-specific traffic for switched CXL memory pooling. Under the hood, our key idea is to build a Sender-Driven Fabric-Informed transport protocol—inspired by Core-Stateless Fair Queueing (CSFQ)—that admits just the right amount of CXL requests to each mchannel based on the estimated Core ↔ DIMM CXL bandwidth availability. To grapple with the ramifications of CXL-induced idiosyncrasies, MemChannel introduces a couple of techniques: time-based rate control, host-side admission control, cross-host bookkeeping, new congestion signals, rate estimation based on the fluid model, and delay-based link capacity adjustment. We build MemChannel from scratch and support unmodified applications. Our evaluations over switched memory pooling demonstrate the effectiveness of MemChannel from performance isolation, scalability, and multi-tenancy perspectives.
items.abstract_zh:
新兴的交换式 CXL 内存池系统尽管前景广阔，但由于主机核心和远程 DIMM 之间的并发内存流之间存在共享但性能不受控制的数据路径，因此会遭受严重的性能干扰。我们系统地描述了基于 XConn 的 Apollo CXL 交换机的内存池设备的特征，并确定了三个问题：主机内争用、结构内拥塞和非托管主机远程 DIMM 交互。

本文提出了一个新的传输层 MemChannel ，它提供了 mchannel 抽象来管理竞争内存流之间的端到端结构带宽，并为交换 CXL 内存池启用特定于应用程序的流量。在幕后，我们的关键想法是构建一个发送者驱动的 Fabric-Informed 传输协议（受 Core-Stateless Fair Queuing (CSFQ) 的启发），该协议根据估计的 Core ↔ DIMM CXL 带宽可用性，允许每个 mchannel 接收适量的 CXL 请求。为了应对 CXL 引起的特性的影响，MemChannel 引入了多种技术：基于时间的速率控制、主机端准入控制、跨主机簿记、新的拥塞信号、基于流体模型的速率估计以及基于延迟的链路容量调整。我们从头开始构建 MemChannel 并支持未经修改的应用程序。我们对交换内存池的评估从性能隔离、可扩展性和多租户角度证明了 MemChannel 的有效性。

items.title: BLADE: Adaptive Wi-Fi Contention Control for Next-Generation Real-Time Communication.
items.abstract: Next-generation real-time communication (NGRTC) applications, such as cloud gaming and XR, demand consistently ultra-low latency. However, through our first large-scale measurement, we find that despite the deployment of edge servers, dedicated congestion control, and loss recovery mechanisms, cloud gaming users still experience long-tail latency in Wi-Fi networks. We further identify that Wi-Fi last-mile access points (APs) serve as the primary latency bottleneck. Specifically, short-term packet delivery droughts, caused by fundamental limitations in Wi-Fi contention control standards, are the root cause. To address this issue, we propose BLADE, an adaptive contention control algorithm that dynamically adjusts the contention windows (CW) of all Wi-Fi transmitters based on the channel contention level in a fully distributed manner. Our NS3 simulations and real-world evaluations with commercial Wi-Fi APs demonstrate that, compared to standard contention control, BLADE reduces Wi-Fi packet transmission tail latency by over 5× under heavy channel contention and significantly stabilizes MAC throughput while ensuring fast and fair convergence. Consequently, BLADE reduces the video stall rate in cloud gaming by over 90%.
items.abstract_zh: 云游戏和 XR 等下一代实时通信 (NGRTC) 应用程序需要始终如一的超低延迟。然而，通过我们的第一次大规模测量，我们发现尽管部署了边缘服务器、专用拥塞控制和丢失恢复机制，云游戏用户仍然会在Wi-Fi网络中遇到长尾延迟。我们进一步发现 Wi-Fi 最后一英里接入点 (AP) 是主要的延迟瓶颈。具体来说，根本原因是 Wi-Fi 争用控制标准的根本限制所导致的短期数据包传输干旱。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 BLADE，这是一种自适应竞争控制算法，可以根据信道竞争级别以完全分布式的方式动态调整所有 Wi-Fi 发射器的竞争窗口 (CW)。我们的 NS3 模拟和商用 Wi-Fi AP 的实际评估表明，与标准争用控制相比，BLADE 在信道争用严重的情况下将 Wi-Fi 数据包传输尾部延迟减少了 5 倍以上，并显着稳定了 MAC 吞吐量，同时确保快速和公平的收敛。因此，BLADE将云游戏的视频卡顿率降低了90%以上。

items.title: Harvesting Spare CPU Resources in Container Systems.
items.abstract: Platforms like Kubernetes are widely adopted for deploying latency-sensitive cloud services in containers, and CPU resources for these containers are over-provisioned to ensure low 99th percentile tail latency under peak load. At the same time, cloud services exhibit bursty traffic patterns resulting in CPU usage variability that creates opportunity to harvest ephemerally unused CPU cores to run latency-tolerant containers. However, existing resource controls do not allow latency-sensitive containers to share unused cores without compromising their low tail latency objectives. Prior research on performance isolation is inadequate for container systems because it requires modifying applications and system software, employs offline profiling, and does not account for interference from processing container networking interrupts. We present HarvestContainers , a system that protects latency-sensitive containers from all sources of interference while harvesting their spare CPU cores to run latency-tolerant containers. Our solution dynamically determines the safe number of CPU cores to harvest and does not require rewriting applications or OS. We implement HarvestContainers integrated with Kubernetes and evaluate it experimentally. Our evaluation shows that latency-sensitive containers with microsecond-scale service level objectives can share up to 75% of their unused CPU cores while maintaining tail latency within 4% of standalone operation.
items.abstract_zh: 像 Kubernetes 这样的平台被广泛用于在容器中部署延迟敏感的云服务，并且这些容器的 CPU 资源被过度配置，以确保峰值负载下的 99% 尾部延迟较低。与此同时，云服务呈现出突发流量模式，导致 CPU 使用率变化，从而创造了收集暂时未使用的 CPU 核心来运行延迟容忍容器的机会。然而，现有的资源控制不允许对延迟敏感的容器共享未使用的核心，而不影响其低尾延迟目标。先前对性能隔离的研究对于容器系统来说是不够的，因为它需要修改应用程序和系统软件，采用离线分析，并且没有考虑处理容器网络中断的干扰。我们推出了 HarvestContainers，这是一个系统，可以保护延迟敏感的容器免受所有干扰源的影响，同时收集其备用 CPU 核心来运行延迟容忍的容器。我们的解决方案动态确定要获取的 CPU 核心的安全数量，并且不需要重写应用程序或操作系统。我们实现了与 Kubernetes 集成的 HarvestContainers 并进行了实验评估。我们的评估表明，具有微秒级服务级别目标的延迟敏感型容器可以共享高达 75% 的未使用 CPU 内核，同时将独立操作的尾部延迟保持在 4% 以内。

items.title: UpFuzz: Detecting Data Format Incompatibility Bugs during Distributed Storage System Upgrade.
items.abstract:
Data format incompatibility is a significant cause of cloud incidents during distributed system upgrades, often resulting in severe consequences such as data corruption and service unavailability. A majority of such bugs are only discovered post-release, largely due to the lack of automated testing techniques tailored specifically for the upgrade process. Traditional automated test generation methods face a unique challenge when applied to upgrade testing: the high cost associated with upgrading distributed storage systems due to system initialization. Therefore, the accurate selection of potential failure-inducing tests from the extensive pool of automatically generated tests becomes critical.

In this work, we address this problem by proposing a novel approach to prioritize upgrade tests through analyzing data format properties over transitively persisted states : program states that are persisted to disk, directly or indirectly, through chains of memory copies by the old version, and eventually read by the new version after upgrade. Because data format incompatibility bugs happen due to translation errors of such states across versions, transitively persisted states satisfying unique data format properties related to changed data formats are particularly essential for testing.

We build a likely invariant analysis engine that captures such properties as feedback for seed test selection in UPFUZZ, the automated testing engine for the distributed storage system upgrade procedure. UPFUZZ has detected 15 previously unknown upgrade failures caused by data format incompatibilities in the latest stable versions of Cassandra, HBase, and HDFS; developers have confirmed 8 of them. 7 are triggered exclusively with UPFUZZ’s data format analysis. The detected bugs have severe consequences, with 6 crashing the cluster and 4 causing data loss or corruption.
items.abstract_zh:
数据格式不兼容是分布式系统升级过程中发生云事件的重要原因，往往会导致数据损坏、服务不可用等严重后果。大多数此类错误只是在发布后才发现，很大程度上是由于缺乏专门针对升级过程定制的自动化测试技术。传统的自动化测试生成方法在应用于升级测试时面临着独特的挑战：由于系统初始化而升级分布式存储系统的相关成本很高。因此，从大量自动生成的测试中准确选择潜在的引发故障的测试变得至关重要。

在这项工作中，我们通过提出一种新颖的方法来解决这个问题，通过分析数据格式属性而不是传递持久状态来确定升级测试的优先级：程序状态通过旧版本的内存副本链直接或间接地持久保存到磁盘，并最终在升级后由新版本读取。由于数据格式不兼容错误是由于跨版本的此类状态的转换错误而发生的，因此满足与更改的数据格式相关的唯一数据格式属性的传递持久状态对于测试尤为重要。

我们构建了一个可能不变的分析引擎，它捕获诸如 UPFUZZ 中种子测试选择的反馈等属性，UPFUZZ 是分布式存储系统升级过程的自动测试引擎。 UPFUZZ 在 Cassandra、HBase 和 HDFS 的最新稳定版本中检测到了 15 个以前未知的因数据格式不兼容而导致的升级失败；开发商已确认其中8个。 7 是通过 UPFUZZ 的数据格式分析专门触发的。检测到的错误会造成严重后果，其中 6 个导致集群崩溃，4 个导致数据丢失或损坏。

items.title: MoCE: A Mixture-of-Context Aware Experts Framework for Troubleshooting Internet-scale Services.
items.abstract:
Modern Internet-scale services need to rapidly identify root causes of customer impacting incidents and remediate them. While there are many algorithms (including LLM-assisted solutions) for root cause analysis, these have significant limitations in terms of coverage , extensibility , and scalability due to the diversity of incidents that can occur at Internet-scale and the complexity of telemetry analysis. We argue the need for a paradigm shift in root cause analysis to depart from algorithm development to a systems approach.

To this end, we introduce a mixture of context-aware experts framework where each “expert” represents a root-cause hypothesis exploration. To enable rapid development of new experts and allow computational reuse across the ensemble for scalability, we design an abstraction that allows us to express an expert as a dataflow DAG combining relational, stateful and statistical operations. To ensure scalability and extensibility, we develop a lazy DAG runtime system that lazily schedules execution of DAG nodes. We implement this idea in MoCE and demonstrate its value using a mix of real-world incident data from four large application analytics providers and synthetically generated incidents. We show many existing and novel approaches can be expressed succinctly in our framework. We find that MoCE achieves high RCA accuracy (>95%) across diverse incidents compared to 34% for the closest single expert (including prior works) achieving high coverage. We also show the value of the mixture paradigm and the lazy DAG runtime using controlled experiments.
items.abstract_zh:
现代互联网规模的服务需要快速识别影响客户的事件的根本原因并进行补救。虽然有许多用于根本原因分析的算法（包括法学硕士辅助解决方案），但由于互联网规模上可能发生的事件的多样性以及遥测分析的复杂性，这些算法在覆盖范围、可扩展性和可伸缩性方面具有显着的局限性。我们认为根本原因分析需要进行范式转变，从算法开发转向系统方法。

为此，我们引入了上下文感知专家混合框架，其中每个“专家”代表了根本原因假设探索。为了实现新专家的快速开发并允许跨整体的计算重用以实现可扩展性，我们设计了一个抽象，允许我们将专家表示为结合关系、状态和统计操作的数据流 DAG。为了确保可扩展性和可扩展性，我们开发了一个惰性 DAG 运行时系统，可以延迟调度 DAG 节点的执行。我们在 MoCE 中实现了这一想法，并使用来自四个大型应用程序分析提供商的真实事件数据和综合生成的事件的组合来证明其价值。我们展示了许多现有的和新颖的方法可以在我们的框架中简洁地表达。我们发现 MoCE 在不同事件中实现了较高的 RCA 准确度 (>95%)，而最接近的单个专家（包括之前的工作）实现高覆盖率的准确度为 34%。我们还使用受控实验展示了混合范例和惰性 DAG 运行时的价值。

items.title: Making Logic a First-Class Citizen in Generative ML for Networking.
items.abstract:
Generative ML models are increasingly popular in networking for tasks such as telemetry imputation, prediction, and synthetic trace generation. Despite their capabilities, they suffer from two shortcomings: (i) their output is often visibly violating well-known networking rules, which undermines their trustworthiness; and (ii) they are difficult to control, frequently requiring retraining even for minor changes.

To address these limitations and unlock the benefits of generative models for networking, we propose a new paradigm for integrating explicit network knowledge, in the form of first-order logic rules, into ML models used for networking tasks. Rules capture well-known relationships among observed signals, e.g., that increased latency precedes packet loss. While the idea is conceptually straightforward, its realization is challenging: networking knowledge is rarely formalized into rules, and naively injecting rules into ML models often hampers their effectiveness. This paper introduces NetNomos, a multi-stage framework that (i) learns rules directly from data (e.g., measurements); (ii) filters them to select semantically meaningful ones; and (iii) enforces them through collaborative generation between an ML model and a Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) solver.

We show that NetNomos learns diverse, meaningful rules from four real-world datasets and is 1.6–6.5× more scalable than DuoAI, a state-of-the-art (SOTA) rule-learning method. By enforcing these rules on a generic GPT-2 model, NetNomos achieves performance on par with or even surpassing specialized SOTA systems such as Zoom2Net and NetShare across three networking tasks: telemetry imputation, traffic forecasting, and synthetic data generation.
items.abstract_zh:
生成式机器学习模型在遥测插补、预测和合成轨迹生成等任务的网络中越来越受欢迎。尽管它们的能力很强，但它们仍然存在两个缺点：（i）它们的输出经常明显违反众所周知的网络规则，这损害了它们的可信度； (ii) 它们难以控制，即使是微小的变化也经常需要重新培训。

为了解决这些限制并释放网络生成模型的优势，我们提出了一种新的范式，以一阶逻辑规则的形式将显式网络知识集成到用于网络任务的机器学习模型中。规则捕获观察到的信号之间众所周知的关系，例如，延迟增加先于数据包丢失。虽然这个想法在概念上很简单，但其实现具有挑战性：网络知识很少被形式化为规则，并且天真地将规则注入机器学习模型通常会妨碍其有效性。本文介绍了 NetNomos，这是一个多阶段框架，它 (i) 直接从数据（例如测量）中学习规则； (ii) 过滤它们以选择语义上有意义的； (iii) 通过 ML 模型和可满足性模理论 (SMT) 求解器之间的协作生成来强制执行它们。

我们证明，NetNomos 从四个现实世界的数据集中学习多样化、有意义的规则，并且比 DuoAI（一种最先进的 (SOTA) 规则学习方法）的可扩展性高 1.6-6.5 倍。通过在通用 GPT-2 模型上执行这些规则，NetNomos 在遥测估算、流量预测和合成数据生成这三个网络任务中实现了与 Zoom2Net 和 NetShare 等专业 SOTA 系统相当甚至超越的性能。

items.title: HeteCCL: Synthesizing Near-Optimal Collective Communication Schedules for Heterogeneous GPU Clusters.
items.abstract: Training large language models demands massive computing and networking resources. However, existing clusters often face shortages of homogeneous resources and vendor lock-in, forcing the use of heterogeneous hardware, which makes synchronizing training across nodes highly challenging. Current solutions to cluster heterogeneity suffer from low collective communication efficiency, with suboptimal scheduling and slow algorithm synthesis. We present HeteCCL, a unified method for generating near-optimal collective communication schedules on heterogeneous clusters. HeteCCL models the cluster topology and link bandwidth in detail, quantizes data chunks at the schedule-step level, and formulates the scheduling problem as a maximum parallel transfer problem on a weighted directed graph. To accelerate synthesis, HeteCCL encodes bandwidth and routing constraints as SMT formulas and applies counterexample-guided inductive synthesis to refine constraints and prune the search space iteratively. Experiments on heterogeneous testbeds, each consisting of 32 H20 and V100 GPUs, show that HeteCCL outperforms NCCL, TACCL, and TE-CCL, achieving up to 2.8×, 4.4×, and 2.6× higher bandwidth. It also accelerates synthesis by up to 2 orders of magnitude compared to state-of-the-art efforts, and improves end-to-end training efficiency by 23%–37%.
items.abstract_zh: 训练大型语言模型需要大量的计算和网络资源。然而，现有集群经常面临同质资源短缺和供应商锁定，迫使使用异构硬件，这使得跨节点同步训练变得极具挑战性。当前的集群异构解决方案存在集体通信效率低、调度次优和算法合成缓慢的问题。我们提出了 HeteCCL，一种在异构集群上生成接近最优集体通信调度的统一方法。 HeteCCL 对集群拓扑和链路带宽进行详细建模，在调度步骤级别量化数据块，并将调度问题表述为加权有向图上的最大并行传输问题。为了加速综合，HeteCCL 将带宽和路由约束编码为 SMT 公式，并应用反例引导的归纳综合来细化约束并迭代地修剪搜索空间。在异构测试台（每个测试台由 32 个 H20 和 V100 GPU 组成）上进行的实验表明，HeteCCL 的性能优于 NCCL、TACCL 和 TE-CCL，带宽分别提高了 2.8 倍、4.4 倍和 2.6 倍。与最先进的技术相比，它还能将合成速度提高多达 2 个数量级，并将端到端训练效率提高 23%–37%。

items.title: Stimpack: An Adaptive Rendering Optimization System for Scalable Cloud Gaming.
items.abstract: In distributed multimedia applications, content is often delivered to users in a degraded form due to network-induced lossy compression. Real-time and interactive use cases like cloud gaming, which render content on the fly, require low latency and are hosted at resource-constrained edge servers. We present a new insight: when rendered content is delivered over a network with lossy compression, high-quality rendering can be ineffective in improving user-perceived quality, leading to a poor return on computing resources. Leveraging this observation, we built Stimpack, a novel system that adaptively optimizes game rendering quality by balancing server-side rendering costs against user-perceived quality. The system uses a mechanism that quantifies the efficiency of resource usage to maximize overall system utility in multi-user scenarios. Our open-sourced implementation and extensive evaluations show that Stimpack achieves up to 24% higher service quality and serves twice as many users with the same resources compared to baselines. A user study further validates that Stimpack provides a measurably better user experience.
items.abstract_zh: 在分布式多媒体应用中，由于网络引起的有损压缩，内容通常以降级形式交付给用户。实时和交互式用例（例如云游戏）可以动态呈现内容，需要低延迟，并且托管在资源有限的边缘服务器上。我们提出了一个新的见解：当渲染内容通过有损压缩的网络交付时，高质量渲染可能无法有效提高用户感知的质量，从而导致计算资源回报率较低。利用这一观察结果，我们构建了 Stimpack，这是一种新颖的系统，可通过平衡服务器端渲染成本与用户感知的质量来自适应优化游戏渲染质量。该系统使用一种量化资源使用效率的机制，以最大限度地提高多用户场景中的整体系统效用。我们的开源实施和广泛的评估表明，与基线相比，Stimpack 的服务质量提高了 24%，并且在相同资源下服务的用户数量是原来的两倍。用户研究进一步证实 Stimpack 提供了明显更好的用户体验。

items.title: CacheCatalyst: Enhancing Web Caching for the Latency-Constrained Internet.
items.abstract: Caching is a fundamental technique for improving web performance, particularly by reducing page load time through the reuse of previously fetched resources. In this paper, we highlight the drawbacks of the current caching approach, especially in the context of high-speed networks where latency, rather than bandwidth, has become the main bottleneck for web performance. We discuss how the current design of web caching suffers from inefficiencies, particularly due to the latency involved in re-validation requests, which diminishes the potential benefits of caching. To address this inefficiency, we present CacheCatalyst, a novel solution that introduces an early cache validation procedure during the initial step of page loading. This updates the state of cached resources, enabling browsers to utilize unchanged cached content without unnecessary round trips. In addition, our approach enables an optimized form of Server Push that avoids the typical drawbacks of this mechanism. Our evaluations demonstrate that this method improves key performance metrics of page loading by an average of 40%.
items.abstract_zh: 缓存是提高 Web 性能的一项基本技术，特别是通过重用先前获取的资源来减少页面加载时间。在本文中，我们强调了当前缓存方法的缺点，特别是在高速网络的背景下，其中延迟（而不是带宽）已成为 Web 性能的主要瓶颈。我们讨论了当前的 Web 缓存设计如何因效率低下而受到影响，特别是由于重新验证请求中涉及的延迟，这削弱了缓存的潜在优势。为了解决这种低效率问题，我们提出了 CacheCatalyst，这是一种新颖的解决方案，它在页面加载的初始步骤中引入了早期缓存验证过程。这会更新缓存资源的状态，使浏览器能够利用未更改的缓存内容，而无需不必要的往返。此外，我们的方法实现了服务器推送的优化形式，避免了该机制的典型缺点。我们的评估表明，此方法将页面加载的关键性能指标平均提高了 40%。

items.title: Harp: Improving VPC Network Availability via Efficient Failure Detection and Rerouting in Tencent Cloud.
items.abstract: We present Harp, a mechanism for efficient and robust failure detection and recovery for VPC networks. Unlike previous approaches, Harp does not rely on specific hardware features or transport protocols. Instead, Harp is a lightweight software implementation that identifies feasible physical paths between each pair of communicating hosts and monitors their health states. When network failures occur, Harp can swiftly switch influenced flows from a failed path to a healthy path within a short interval. Harp has been deployed in Tencent Cloud for more than two years and has proven its effectiveness in handling network failures. According to the results from production systems, Harp can significantly reduce the VPC network's outage time by 78.71%-99.97% and essentially bypass failed paths on a sub-second timescale. We also share our experiences of how Harp efficiently detects and handles network failures when deployed in Tencent Cloud.
items.abstract_zh: 我们推出 Harp，一种用于 VPC 网络高效、稳健的故障检测和恢复的机制。与以前的方法不同，Harp 不依赖于特定的硬件功能或传输协议。相反，Harp 是一种轻量级软件实现，可识别每对通信主机之间的可行物理路径并监视其健康状态。当网络发生故障时，Harp可以在短时间内将受影响的流量从故障路径快速切换到健康路径。 Harp已经在腾讯云部署了两年多，并证明了其在处理网络故障方面的有效性。根据生产系统的结果，Harp 可以将 VPC 网络的中断时间显着减少 78.71%-99.97%，并在亚秒级时间尺度上基本上绕过故障路径。我们还分享了Harp部署在腾讯云时如何高效检测和处理网络故障的经验。

items.title: Come Hell or Still Water: Alleviating Tail Latency in Cloud Block Store.
items.abstract:
Maintaining low tail latency is crucial for cloud storage services. In ALIBABA CLOUD, our Elastic Block Storage (EBS), like many others, adopts layers of load balancing to avoid hot-spot I/Os, a dominant contributor to tail latency.

However, in the field, EBS has still been suffering from tail latency spikes. Through extensive analysis of production workloads, we have identified the root cause: the workload bursts caused by a small group of Virtual Disks (VDs), which fundamentally influence the tail latency of the entire cluster. We hence propose a lightweight dual-bucket throttling mechanism to effectively mitigate the issue while maintaining fairness. In addition, we discover that, even under underloaded scenarios, the tail latency remains suboptimal due to the event-loop thread model. We propose a priority-based scheduling mechanism to separate I/O-related tasks from I/O-unrelated ones. Our evaluation shows that the proposed mechanisms can reduce the tail latency by up to 97% in burst and 43% in underloaded scenarios. Our mechanisms have been deployed across dozens of clusters for more than three months, and have served hundreds of trillions of I/O requests. They reduce the P99999 tail latency of steady segments by 59.7% under burst scenarios and of all I/Os by 22% in underloaded scenarios.
items.abstract_zh:
保持低尾部延迟对于云存储服务至关重要。在阿里巴巴云中，我们的弹性块存储（EBS）与许多其他存储一样，采用负载均衡层来避免热点 I/O，而热点 I/O 是造成尾部延迟的主要因素。

然而，在现场，EBS 仍然遭受尾部延迟峰值的困扰。通过对生产负载的大量分析，我们找到了根本原因：一小部分虚拟磁盘（VD）导致的负载爆发，从根本上影响了整个集群的尾部延迟。因此，我们提出了一种轻量级的双桶节流机制，以有效缓解该问题，同时保持公平性。此外，我们发现，即使在负载不足的情况下，由于事件循环线程模型，尾部延迟仍然不是最佳的。我们提出了一种基于优先级的调度机制，将与 I/O 相关的任务与与 I/O 无关的任务分开。我们的评估表明，所提出的机制可以在突发情况下将尾部延迟减少高达 97%，在负载不足的情况下减少 43%。我们的机制已经在数十个集群上部署了三个多月，并服务了数百万亿个 I/O 请求。它们在突发场景下将稳定段的 P99999 尾部延迟降低了 59.7%，在负载不足的情况下将所有 I/O 的尾部延迟降低了 22%。

items.title: Lemonshark: Asynchronous DAG-BFT With Early Finality.
items.abstract:
DAG-Rider popularized a new paradigm of DAG-BFT protocols, separating dissemination from consensus: all nodes disseminate transactions as blocks that reference previously known blocks, while consensus is reached by electing certain blocks as leaders. This design yields high throughput but confers optimal latency only to leader blocks; non-leader blocks cannot be committed independently.

We present Lemonshark, an asynchronous DAG-BFT protocol that reinterprets the DAG at a transactional level and identifies conditions where commitment is sufficient—but not necessary—for safe results, enabling nodes to finalize transactions before official commitment, without compromising correctness. Compared to the state-of-the-art asynchronous BFT protocol, Lemonshark reduces latency by up to 65%.
items.abstract_zh:
DAG-Rider 推广了 DAG-BFT 协议的新范式，将传播与共识分开：所有节点将交易作为引用先前已知区块的区块进行传播，而共识则通过选举某些区块作为领导者来达成。这种设计可产生高吞吐量，但仅为领导块提供最佳延迟；非领导者区块不能独立提交。

我们推出了 Lemonshark，一种异步 DAG-BFT 协议，它在交易级别重新解释 DAG，并识别承诺对于安全结果来说是充分但不是必要的条件，使节点能够在正式承诺之前完成交易，而不会影响正确性。与最先进的异步 BFT 协议相比，Lemonshark 可将延迟降低高达 65%。

items.title: Fractal: Fault-Tolerant Shell-Script Distribution.
items.abstract: This paper presents FRACTAL, a new system that offers fault tolerant distributed shell script execution for unmodified scripts. FRACTAL first distinguishes recoverable regions from side-effectful ones, and augments them with additional runtime support aimed at fault recovery. It employs precise dependency and progress tracking at the subgraph level to offer sound and efficient fault recovery.
