It minimizes the number of upstream regions that are re-executed during recovery and ensures exactly-once semantics upon recovery for downstream regions. Evaluation on 4- and 30-node clusters indicates average fault-free speedups of (1) >9.6x over Bash, a single-node shell-interpreter baseline, (2) >5.5x over Hadoop Streaming, a MapReduce system that supports language-agnostic third-party components, and (3) 17% over DiSh, a state-of-the-art fault-intolerant shell-script distribution system—all while recovering 7.8–16.4x faster than Hadoop Streaming in cases of faults.
items.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 FRACTAL，这是一个新系统，可为未修改的脚本提供容错分布式 shell 脚本执行。 FRACTAL 首先区分可恢复区域和副作用区域，并通过旨在故障恢复的额外运行时支持来增强它们。它在子图级别采用精确的依赖性和进度跟踪，以提供健全且高效的故障恢复。它最大限度地减少了恢复期间重新执行的上游区域的数量，并确保下游区域恢复时的恰好一次语义。对 4 节点和 30 节点集群的评估表明，平均无故障加速比 Bash（单节点 shell 解释器基线）高出 9.6 倍；(2) 比 Hadoop Streaming（支持与语言无关的第三方组件的 MapReduce 系统）高出 5.5 倍；(3) 比 DiSh（最先进的容错 shell 脚本分发系统）高出 17%——所有这些都在恢复的同时进行。出现故障时比 Hadoop Streaming 快 7.8–16.4 倍。

items.title: Express Lane to Efficiency and Reliability: Multi-Dimensional Control in Meta's Express Backbone Network.
items.abstract: Meta’s Express Backbone (EBB) network interconnects data centers across the globe. As such, it is one of the largest WANs in terms of capacity, traffic and global reach. EBB’s unique multi-plane Software Defined Network (SDN) architecture has passed the test of time with its flexibility, reliability and performance. Nonetheless, in parallel to its success, it has also seen an unprecedented growth in traffic demand and capacity footprint. Along with the rapid rise of AI workloads, challenges in resource utilization and failure recovery started to emerge, driving us to enhance and evolve EBB’s control design to increase its efficiency and resiliency. From our operational experiences, we realize that while foundational per-plane Traffic Engineering (TE) control offers simplicity, there still exists a gap to support the above two goals. We propose to introduce control in two additional dimensions: globally across planes and locally at individual device. Specifically, Unequal Cost Multi-Path (UCMP) enables control across planes for efficient load balancing, and Fast Re-Route (FRR) provides control across time slices for facilitating rapid detection and recovery from failures. We present the design, implementation, and production results of UCMP and FRR, demonstrating how EBB can adapt to AI-era demands rapidly without fundamental architectural changes.
items.abstract_zh: Meta 的 Express Backbone (EBB) 网络互连全球的数据中心。因此，就容量、流量和全球覆盖范围而言，它是最大的广域网之一。 EBB独特的多平面软件定义网络（SDN）架构以其灵活性、可靠性和性能经受了时间的考验。尽管如此，在取得成功的同时，交通需求和运力足迹也出现了前所未有的增长。随着人工智能工作负载的快速增长，资源利用和故障恢复方面的挑战开始出现，促使我们增强和发展 EBB 的控制设计，以提高其效率和弹性。根据我们的运营经验，我们意识到，虽然基础的每平面流量工程 (TE) 控制提供了简单性，但在支持上述两个目标方面仍然存在差距。我们建议在两个额外的维度上引入控制：跨平面的全局控制和单个设备的本地控制。具体来说，不等成本多路径（UCMP）可以实现跨平面的控制，以实现高效的负载平衡，快速重路由（FRR）可以提供跨时间片的控制，以便于快速检测和从故障中恢复。我们展示了 UCMP 和 FRR 的设计、实现和生产结果，展示了 EBB 如何在不进行根本架构更改的情况下快速适应 AI 时代的需求。

items.title: CCC: Re-architecting Delay-based Congestion Control in Datacenter Networks.
items.abstract: In datacenter networks, delay-based congestion control (CC) algorithms are popular and protocols such as TIMELY and SWIFT are employed in production. However, even if delay signals are precisely measured, the congestion information deduction (CiD) may be incorrect under certain conditions, degrading the performance of CC. To address this problem, we re-architect the delay-based CC to make rate adjustments based not only on the congestion states but also the CiD trustworthiness. Based on this architecture, the CiD-sensitive congestion control (CCC) is developed. Specifically, CCC demarcates the regions, where the CiD from delay signals is untrustworthy, with the assistance of well-designed congestion criteria and inherent system inertia. When the CiD is untrustworthy, CCC constructs the probing rate adjustment rules for both the rapid response to congestion and the subsequent trustworthy CiD. Otherwise, CCC conducts the analytical rate adjustment to both reach the expected congestion state and keep the trustworthy CiD, fully leveraging the abundant information in delay signals. DPDK-based experiments and large-scale simulations confirm that CCC achieves similar good performance as INT-based CCs, including HPCC and PowerTCP, by using only delay signals, outperforming DCQCN, TIMELY, and SWIFT.
items.abstract_zh: 在数据中心网络中，基于延迟的拥塞控制 (CC) 算法很流行，并且在生产中采用了 TIMELY 和 SWIFT 等协议。然而，即使延迟信号被精确测量，拥塞信息推导（CiD）在某些条件下也可能不正确，从而降低CC的性能。为了解决这个问题，我们重新构建了基于延迟的 CC，不仅根据拥塞状态，还根据 CiD 可信度进行速率调整。基于该架构，开发了CiD敏感拥塞控制（CCC）。具体来说，CCC 借助精心设计的拥塞标准和固有的系统惯性来划分延迟信号 CiD 不可信的区域。当CiD不可信时，CCC构建探测速率调整规则，既可以快速响应拥塞，又可以保证后续的可信CiD。否则，CCC 充分利用延迟信号中的丰富信息，进行分析速率调整，以达到预期的拥塞状态并保持可信的 CiD。基于 DPDK 的实验和大规模仿真证实，CCC 仅使用延迟信号即可实现与基于 INT 的 CC（包括 HPCC 和 PowerTCP）类似的良好性能，优于 DCQCN、TIMELY 和 SWIFT。

items.title: RASC: Enhancing Observability & Programmability in Smart Spaces.
items.abstract: While RPCs form the bedrock of systems stacks, we posit that IoT device collections in smart spaces like homes, warehouses, and office buildings—which are all “user-facing”—require a more expressive abstraction. Orthogonal to prior work, which improved the reliability of IoT communication, our work focuses on improving the observability and programmability of IoT actions. We present the RASC (Request-Acknowledge-Start-Complete) abstraction, which provides acknowledgments at critical points after an IoT device action is initiated. RASC is a better fit for IoT actions, which naturally vary in length spatially (across devices) and temporally (across time, for a given device). RASC also enables the design of several new features: predicting action completion times accurately, detecting failures of actions faster, allowing fine-grained dependencies in programming, and scheduling. RASC is intended to be implemented atop today’s available RPC mechanisms, rather than as a replacement. We integrated RASC into a popular and open-source IoT framework called Home Assistant. Our trace-driven evaluation finds that RASC meets latency SLOs, especially for long actions that last O(mins), which are common in smart spaces. Our scheduling policies for home automations (e.g., routines) outperform state-of-the-art counterparts by 10%-55%.
items.abstract_zh: 虽然 RPC 构成了系统堆栈的基石，但我们认为家庭、仓库和办公楼等智能空间中的物联网设备集合（这些都是“面向用户的”）需要更具表现力的抽象。与之前提高物联网通信可靠性的工作正交，我们的工作重点是提高物联网操作的可观察性和可编程性。我们提出了 RASC（请求-确认-开始-完成）抽象，它在物联网设备操作启动后的关键点提供确认。 RASC 更适合 IoT 操作，其长度自然会在空间（跨设备）和时间（对于给定设备，跨时间）发生变化。 RASC 还支持多种新功能的设计：准确预测操作完成时间、更快地检测操作失败、允许编程和调度中的细粒度依赖关系。 RASC 旨在在当今可用的 RPC 机制之上实现，而不是作为替代品。我们将 RASC 集成到一个名为 Home Assistant 的流行开源物联网框架中。我们的跟踪驱动评估发现，RASC 满足延迟 SLO，尤其是持续 O（分钟）的长操作，这在智能空间中很常见。我们的家庭自动化调度策略（例如例程）比最先进的同类策略高出 10%-55%。

items.title: Heuristic Analysis from Source Code via Symbolic-Guided Optimization.
items.abstract:
Large-scale systems rely on heuristics to tackle NP-hard problems such as traffic engineering, virtual machine placement, and packet scheduling. While these heuristics are efficient, they can exhibit severe performance gaps under certain workloads, which leads to outages or costly over-provisioning. This risk has motivated tools that attempt to find inputs that cause worst-case underperformance. But, to use these tools in practice, heuristic developers need to rewrite heuristics as formal mathematical models—a process that is time-consuming, error-prone, and excludes many real-world algorithms.

We introduce MetaEase, a practical general-domain analyzer that directly analyzes a heuristic’s source code and eliminates the need for formal modeling. MetaEase combines code-aware input generation with guided search to uncover worst-case scenarios efficiently, even for heuristics with randomness (e.g., various traffic engineering schemes) or non-convex behavior (e.g., bin packing for virtual machine placement).

In most cases, across five problem domains, and eight heuristics, MetaEase matched or exceeded MetaOpt, a state-of-the-art optimization-based heuristic analyzer; in the remainder, it remained competitive and often ran faster. Against black-box optimization baselines, it won in 88% of settings and ranked in the top two otherwise. MetaEase analyzed Arrow, a recent networking heuristic that none of the state-of-the-art heuristic analyzers can analyze. We revealed previously unknown performance gaps in Arrow.
items.abstract_zh:
大型系统依靠启发式方法来解决 NP 难题，例如流量工程、虚拟机放置和数据包调度。虽然这些启发式方法很有效，但它们在某些工作负载下可能会表现出严重的性能差距，从而导致中断或代价高昂的过度配置。这种风险促使工具试图寻找导致最坏情况表现不佳的输入。但是，为了在实践中使用这些工具，启发式开发人员需要将启发式重写为正式的数学模型，这个过程非常耗时、容易出错，并且排除了许多现实世界的算法。

我们介绍 MetaEase，这是一种实用的通用领域分析器，可以直接分析启发式源代码并消除形式建模的需要。 MetaEase 将代码感知输入生成与引导搜索相结合，可以有效地发现最坏情况，甚至对于具有随机性的启发式（例如，各种流量工程方案）或非凸行为（例如，用于虚拟机放置的装箱）也是如此。

在大多数情况下，在五个问题领域和八个启发式分析中，MetaEase 匹配或超过了 MetaOpt（一种最先进的基于优化的启发式分析器）；在剩下的时间里，它仍然保持竞争力并且通常跑得更快。相对于黑盒优化基准，它在 88% 的设置中获胜，并在其他方面排名前两名。 MetaEase 分析了 Arrow，这是一种最新的网络启发式算法，没有任何最先进的启发式分析器可以对其进行分析。我们揭示了 Arrow 中以前未知的性能差距。

items.title: Learning to Tune Optical WANs: A Field Deployment of Noise Models in Optical Networks.
items.abstract: Accurately modeling optical signal transmission is critical for optimizing network performance, particularly in large-scale fiber optic networks operated by Internet Service Providers. In this work, we develop a Gaussian Noise model for a New York state ISP's optical backbone. Our model accounts for all major network components, including amplifiers, fiber spans, reconfigurable optical add-drop multiplexers, and transceivers. By accurately predicting end-to-end signal-to-noise ratio, our model provides a foundation for network performance analysis and optimization. Then, we leverage hyperparameter search techniques—commonly used in machine learning—to identify amplifier gain settings that improve signal quality. By treating the model as an opaque box, we systematically search for amplifier configurations that maximize the predicted end-to-end SNR while maintaining practical network constraints. We validate our approach through a field deployment by applying optimized amplifier gain settings in a live ISP network. Our results show a significant improvement in optical signal quality, achieving a 2 dB increase in SNR on a single wavelength.
items.abstract_zh: 准确建模光信号传输对于优化网络性能至关重要，特别是在互联网服务提供商运营的大规模光纤网络中。在这项工作中，我们为纽约州 ISP 的光骨干网开发了高斯噪声模型。我们的模型考虑了所有主要网络组件，包括放大器、光纤跨度、可重新配置的光分插复用器和收发器。通过准确预测端到端信噪比，我们的模型为网络性能分析和优化提供了基础。然后，我们利用机器学习中常用的超参数搜索技术来识别可提高信号质量的放大器增益设置。通过将模型视为不透明的盒子，我们系统地搜索放大器配置，以最大化预测的端到端 SNR，同时保持实际的网络约束。我们通过在实时 ISP 网络中应用优化的放大器增益设置来验证我们的方法。我们的结果表明光信号质量显着提高，单个波长的 SNR 提高了 2 dB。

items.title: Latency-Aware Caching with Delayed Hits: From Bursty Traffic to Pipeline Architectures.
items.abstract:
Modern computing systems rely on caching to reduce access latency and optimize resource utilization. However, in heterogeneous storage and cloud environments, non-uniform access latencies across storage tiers, network locations, and intermediary caches undermine traditional caching. Moreover, modern cache algorithms that attempt to capture multiple access patterns, recency, frequency, and burstiness, often become complex and difficult to maintain.

As a key contribution, we propose an adaptive caching architecture that treats caching strategies as a pipeline of simple, orthogonal policies, each focused on a distinct access bias. This modular design is easier to expand, debug, and integrate, and it self-adjusts the memory resources allocated to each stage to optimize overall workload performance. New heuristics can be introduced dynamically without disrupting existing behaviors.

In addition, in latency-aware caching, one often encounters the phenomenon of delayed hits, where items not yet available in the cache are requested repeatedly. We introduce the Least Bursty Used (LBU) heuristic, which retains items exhibiting high burstiness even when they are neither recent nor frequent, thereby mitigating delayed hits that degrade request latency. We embed LBU within our pipeline and derive the Recency–Frequency–Burstiness (RFB) policy, which balances resources among recency, frequency, and burstiness. Evaluations on thirteen real-world storage traces from IBM, Twitter and Meta using latencies drawn from real-life deployments show that RFB reduces average request latency by 10% compared to the best state-of-the-art alternative, while maintaining consistent performance, with a low standard deviation across bursty and non-bursty workloads.
items.abstract_zh:
现代计算系统依靠缓存来减少访问延迟并优化资源利用率。然而，在异构存储和云环境中，跨存储层、网络位置和中间缓存的不一致访问延迟会破坏传统缓存。此外，试图捕获多种访问模式、新近度、频率和突发性的现代缓存算法通常变得复杂且难以维护。

作为一个关键贡献，我们提出了一种自适应缓存架构，它将缓存策略视为简单、正交策略的管道，每个策略都专注于不同的访问偏差。这种模块化设计更易于扩展、调试和集成，并且可以自我调整分配给每个阶段的内存资源，以优化整体工作负载性能。可以动态地引入新的启发式方法，而不会破坏现有的行为。

此外，在延迟感知缓存中，经常会遇到延迟命中的现象，即重复请求缓存中尚未可用的项目。我们引入了最少突发使用（LBU）启发式，它保留表现出高突发性的项目，即使它们既不是最近的也不频繁，从而减轻了降低请求延迟的延迟命中。我们将 LBU 嵌入到我们的管道中，并导出新近度-频率-突发性 (RFB) 策略，该策略在新近度、频率和突发性之间平衡资源。使用从实际部署中提取的延迟对来自 IBM、Twitter 和 Meta 的 13 个实际存储跟踪进行的评估表明，与最先进的替代方案相比，RFB 将平均请求延迟降低了 10%，同时保持一致的性能，并且在突发和非突发工作负载中具有较低的标准偏差。

items.title: CrossCheck: Input Validation for WAN Control Systems.
items.abstract:
We present CrossCheck, a system that validates inputs to the Software-Defined Networking (SDN) controller in a Wide Area Network (WAN). By detecting incorrect inputs—often stemming from bugs in the SDN control infrastructure—CrossCheck alerts operators before they trigger network outages.

Our analysis at a large-scale WAN operator identifies invalid inputs as a leading cause of major outages, and we show how CrossCheck would have prevented those incidents. We deployed CrossCheck as a shadow validation system for four weeks in a production WAN, during which it accurately detected the single incident of invalid inputs that occurred while sustaining a 0% false positive rate under normal operation, hence imposing little additional burden on operators. In addition, we show through simulation that CrossCheck reliably detects a wide range of invalid inputs (e.g., detecting demand perturbations as small as 5% with 100% accuracy) and maintains a near-zero false positive rate for realistic levels of noisy, missing, or buggy telemetry data (e.g., sustaining zero false positives with up to 30% of corrupted telemetry data).
items.abstract_zh:
我们推出 CrossCheck，这是一个验证广域网 (WAN) 中软件定义网络 (SDN) 控制器输入的系统。通过检测不正确的输入（通常源于 SDN 控制基础设施中的错误），CrossCheck 可以在操作员触发网络中断之前发出警报。

我们对大型 WAN 运营商的分析表明，无效输入是导致重大中断的主要原因，并且我们展示了 CrossCheck 如何防止这些事件。我们在生产广域网中将 CrossCheck 作为影子验证系统部署了四个星期，在此期间，它准确地检测到发生的单个无效输入事件，同时在正常操作下保持 0% 的误报率，因此对操作员几乎没有造成额外的负担。此外，我们通过模拟表明，CrossCheck 能够可靠地检测到各种无效输入（例如，以 100% 的准确度检测小至 5% 的需求扰动），并且对于真实水平的噪声、缺失或有缺陷的遥测数据保持接近于零的误报率（例如，对高达 30% 的损坏遥测数据保持零误报）。

items.title: QCON: Seamless QoE-Aware 5G Streaming via Multi-Connectivity.
items.abstract: Mobile real-time video streaming (RTS) applications—cloud gaming and AR/VR—require consistent high throughput and low latency to satisfy user Quality of Experience (QoE), yet today’s wireless links fluctuate wildly. While multi-path solutions seem promising to tackle such single-link fluctuations, existing transport-level solutions require multiple cellular subscriptions, which most users don’t have. In this paper, we leverage 5G multi-connectivity, which allows simultaneous connection to multiple base stations (e.g., 5G and 4G) and is already deployed in commercial networks. However, our measurements show RTS applications still suffer from single-link fluctuations due to operators’ deliberate policies restricting multi-connectivity to conserve 4G backup links regardless of application demands. To optimize application QoE while respecting operator policies, we present QCON, a QoE-driven multi-connectivity solution that efficiently utilizes backup links based on precise application QoE. For practical deployment, we design QoE Monitor to infer application QoE within the RAN and develop multi-link scheduling to optimize both QoE and radio resource efficiency. We also design priority-based re-injection utilizing RAN link recovery mechanism to prevent video stalls. Our prototype implementation of QCON on a RAN intelligent controller within an Open-RAN testbed demonstrates 2.1× improvements of bitrates, enhancing tail frame rates by 4-5× with efficient backup link use compared to existing multi-link scheduling schemes.
items.abstract_zh: 移动实时视频流 (RTS) 应用（云游戏和 AR/VR）需要一致的高吞吐量和低延迟来满足用户体验质量 (QoE)，但当今的无线链路波动很大。虽然多路径解决方案似乎有望解决此类单链路波动问题，但现有的传输级解决方案需要多个蜂窝订阅，而大多数用户都没有。在本文中，我们利用 5G 多重连接，它允许同时连接到多个基站（例如 5G 和 4G），并且已经在商业网络中部署。然而，我们的测量显示，RTS 应用程序仍然遭受单链路波动的影响，因为运营商有意限制多连接以保留 4G 备份链路，而不管应用程序需求如何。为了在尊重运营商策略的同时优化应用程序 QoE，我们推出了 QCON，这是一种 QoE 驱动的多连接解决方​​案，可基于精确的应用程序 QoE 高效利用备份链路。对于实际部署，我们设计了 QoE 监视器来推断 RAN 内的应用 QoE，并开发多链路调度来优化 QoE 和无线资源效率。我们还利用 RAN 链路恢复机制设计基于优先级的重新注入，以防止视频停顿。与现有的多链路调度方案相比，我们在 Open-RAN 测试台内的 RAN 智能控制器上实现的 QCON 原型实现表明，比特率提高了 2.1 倍，尾部帧速率提高了 4-5 倍，并且有效使用了备份链路。

items.title: SyncWise: Error-Aware Time Synchronization for Reconfigurable Data Center Networks.
items.abstract: Time synchronization is critical for emerging reconfigurable data center networks (RDCNs) built on optical circuit switches (OCSes), where accurate identification of dynamic optical circuits is required for reliable data transmission. As circuit durations shrink to the microsecond and sub-microsecond range, sync accuracy demands become increasingly stringent. Yet, this problem has been largely overlooked, both practically and theoretically, with no general, easily integrable solutions or established accuracy limits. We present SyncWise, the first sync protocol customized for RDCNs that closes these gaps. SyncWise formalizes the synchronization problem for RDCNs, models errors through an RDCN-specific analysis of error sources, and leverages this error model to guide the “wise” selection of optimal sync parents. SyncWise achieves provably optimal performance and is prototyped on a testbed with an OCS and Intel Tofino2 switches. Large-scale simulations demonstrate that SyncWise is the first protocol to attain sub-10 ns maximum sync error, ensuring reliable RDCN fabrics and outperforming the most accurate protocols in traditional DCNs by a large margin.
items.abstract_zh: 时间同步对于基于光路交换机 (OCS) 的新兴可重构数据中心网络 (RDCN) 至关重要，其中需要准确识别动态光路以实现可靠的数据传输。随着电路持续时间缩小到微秒和亚微秒范围，同步精度要求变得越来越严格。然而，这个问题在实践和理论上都被很大程度上忽视了，没有通用的、易于积分的解决方案或既定的精度限制。我们推出了 SyncWise，这是第一个为 RDCN 定制的同步协议，可以弥补这些差距。 SyncWise 形式化了 RDCN 的同步问题，通过特定于 RDCN 的错误源分析对错误进行建模，并利用此错误模型来指导“明智”选择最佳同步父级。 SyncWise 实现了经过验证的最佳性能，并在使用 OCS 和 Intel Tofino2 交换机的测试台上进行了原型设计。大规模仿真表明，SyncWise 是第一个达到低于 10 ns 最大同步误差的协议，确保了可靠的 RDCN 结构，并大幅优于传统 DCN 中最准确的协议。

items.title: FAST: An Efficient Scheduler for All-to-All GPU Communication.
items.abstract:
All-to-All(v) communication is a critical primitive in modern machine learning workloads, particularly mixture-of-experts (MoE) models. Unfortunately, efficient scheduling is challenging due to workload skew, heterogeneous two-tier fabrics, and incast congestion, compounded by the dynamic nature of MoE workloads, where traffic shifts every few hundred milliseconds. Existing schedulers are hardly scalable, incurring seconds to hours of synthesis time, making them impractical.

We present FAST, an efficient All-to-All(v) scheduler. FAST addresses skew through intra-server rebalancing and enforces balanced, one-to-one scale-out transfers that avoid incast. Evaluated extensively on both NVIDIA H200 and AMD MI300X clusters, FAST consistently outperforms state-of-the-art solutions on skewed workloads while reducing synthesis time by orders of magnitude.
items.abstract_zh:
All-to-All(v) 通信是现代机器学习工作负载中的关键原语，尤其是专家混合 (MoE) 模型。不幸的是，由于工作负载偏差、异构两层结构和组播拥塞，再加上 MoE 工作负载的动态特性（流量每隔几百毫秒就会发生变化），高效调度面临挑战。现有的调度程序很难扩展，需要几秒到几小时的综合时间，这使得它们不切实际。

我们推出了 FAST，一种高效的 All-to-All(v) 调度程序。 FAST 通过服务器内重新平衡解决偏差，并强制执行平衡的一对一横向扩展传输，以避免 incast。在 NVIDIA H200 和 AMD MI300X 集群上进行了广泛评估，FAST 在倾斜工作负载方面始终优于最先进的解决方案，同时将综合时间缩短了几个数量级。

items.title: OpenOptics: Enabling Open Research and Implementation of Optical Data Center Networks.
items.abstract: Optical data center networks (DCNs) are emerging as a promising design for cloud infrastructure. However, existing optical DCN architectures operate as closed ecosystems, tying software solutions to specific optical hardware. We introduce OpenOptics, an open research and development framework that decouples software from hardware, allowing them to evolve independently. OpenOptics features: (1) a time-flow table abstraction as a common interface between optical hardware and software, (2) a unified workflow and user-friendly API for implementing various optical DCNs with simple Python scripts, and (3) a backend system that re-architects queue management to support the time-flow tables and provides rich infrastructure services for diverse applications. Built on programmable switches, OpenOptics achieves a record-breaking minimum optical circuit duration of 2 µs using commodity devices. We validate OpenOptics’ generality by implementing six optical architectures and seven routing schemes on an optical testbed and conducting benchmarks on a 108-ToR setup, showcasing its efficiency. Additionally, case studies highlight novel research opportunities enabled by OpenOptics.
items.abstract_zh: 光数据中心网络 (DCN) 正在成为一种很有前景的云基础设施设计。然而，现有的光学 DCN 架构作为封闭的生态系统运行，将软件解决方案与特定的光学硬件绑定在一起。我们推出 OpenOptics，这是一个开放式研发框架，可将软件与硬件解耦，使它们能够独立发展。 OpenOptics 具有以下特点：(1) 时间流表抽象作为光学硬件和软件之间的通用接口；(2) 统一的工作流程和用户友好的 API，用于通过简单的 Python 脚本实现各种光学 DCN；(3) 后端系统重新架构队列管理以支持时间流表，并为不同的应用程序提供丰富的基础设施服务。 OpenOptics 基于可编程开关构建，使用商用设备实现了 2 µs 的破纪录的最短光路持续时间。我们通过在光学测试台上实施六种光学架构和七种路由方案并在 108-ToR 设置上进行基准测试来验证 OpenOptics 的通用性，展示其效率。此外，案例研究强调了 OpenOptics 带来的新颖研究机会。

items.title: Remote TCP Connection Offload and Applications.
items.abstract:
Layer 7 load balancers (L7LBs) play an important role in per-request server selection within long-lived connections and transport- or application-layer protocol translation. However, L7LBs introduce substantial CPU and network overhead.

We present XO, which enables an L7LB to offload transport-layer and application request processing to backend servers at request granularity. XO outperforms conventional L7LBs by 27–365% in throughput through efficient utilization of server CPU and network resources. We apply XO to two real-world applications, Ceph and nginx, improving throughput by up to 135% and 300%, respectively.
items.abstract_zh:
第 7 层负载均衡器 (L7LB) 在​​长期连接和传输层或应用程序层协议转换中的每个请求服务器选择中发挥着重要作用。然而，L7LB 引入了大量的 CPU 和网络开销。

我们提出了 XO，它使 L7LB 能够按请求粒度将传输层和应用程序请求处理卸载到后端服务器。通过有效利用服务器 CPU 和网络资源，XO 的吞吐量比传统 L7LB 高出 27-365%。我们将 XO 应用于两个实际应用程序：Ceph 和 nginx，分别将吞吐量提高了 135% 和 300%。

items.title: Pilot Execution: Simulating Failure Recovery In Situ for Production Distributed Systems.
items.abstract:
Modern distributed systems rely on failure recovery to ensure availability and correctness—ironically, recovery itself often introduces severe and irreversible failures. In this paper, we first study 75 real-world recovery failures to understand common pitfalls in the recovery mechanisms. We find that the challenges primarily arise from cross-component interactions, which are difficult to expose in traditional approaches.

To address this gap, we introduce pilot execution, a new execution model that simulates dry-runs of recovery actions in production distributed systems to enable safe and predictable failure recovery. It enables systems and operators to observe recovery action effects before applying them, reducing the risk of cascading failures and unintended side effects.

We realize pilot execution with PILOT, an analysis framework with a runtime library that makes pilot execution easy to adopt. We evaluate PILOT on five large-scale distributed systems and show that PILOT uncovers 17 out of 20 recovery failures with modest overhead. Our use of PILOT also exposes an unknown recovery bug in the latest version of HBase.
items.abstract_zh:
现代分布式系统依靠故障恢复来确保可用性和正确性——讽刺的是，恢复本身常常会带来严重且不可逆转的故障。在本文中，我们首先研究了 75 个现实世界的恢复失败，以了解恢复机制中的常见陷阱。我们发现挑战主要来自跨组件交互，这在传统方法中很难暴露。

为了解决这一差距，我们引入了试点执行，这是一种新的执行模型，可以模拟生产分布式系统中恢复操作的空运行，以实现安全且可预测的故障恢复。它使系统和操作员能够在应用恢复操作之前观察其效果，从而降低级联故障和意外副作用的风险。

我们使用 PILOT 来实现试点执行，PILOT 是一个带有运行时库的分析框架，使试点执行易于采用。我们在五个大型分布式系统上评估 PILOT，结果表明 PILOT 以适度的开销发现了 20 个恢复故障中的 17 个。我们对 PILOT 的使用还暴露了最新版本 HBase 中的未知恢复错误。

items.title: Di-PS: System-Algorithm Co-Design for Asynchronous and Heterogeneous Cross-cluster LLM Training at Scale.
items.abstract:
Large language models (LLMs) have revolutionized artificial intelligence, exhibiting remarkable performance in various tasks. Training these models demands extensive computational resources, which are often economically and physically prohibitive. Cross-cluster training can balance infrastructure costs, alleviate physical and resource constraints, better match workload demands, and sustain higher efficiency through geo-distributed deployment. However, challenges arise from network variability, heterogeneous computational resources, and intrinsic training instability.

To address these issues, we present Di-PS, a novel framework for cross-cluster LLM training at scale. The core of Di-PS is the system-algorithm co-design of a parameter server paradigm, to achieve heterogeneous, asynchronous, and resilient training across decentralized clusters. We make several innovative contributions in Di-PS, including (i) an efficient parameter server design for cross-cluster communication of LLM parameters, (ii) a pseudo-gradient penalty strategy for convergence stability enhancement of asynchronous two-stage optimization, and (iii) a resilience mechanism for fault tolerance in cross-cluster training. Results from the controlled experimental setting demonstrate that Di-PS improves training efficiency by up to 4.67× over synchronous cross-cluster approaches while maintaining model quality, and achieving near-linear scalability in heterogeneous training resources. Di-PS has been deployed in the production environment, involving dynamic training scales with up to 9 clusters and more than 10,000 NPUs. At this scale, Di-PS enables successful cross-cluster training of a 100B-parameter LLM with only 6% overhead compared to single-cluster training, and effectively handles frequent failures and resource changes.
items.abstract_zh:
大型语言模型（LLM）彻底改变了人工智能，在各种任务中表现出了卓越的性能。训练这些模型需要大量的计算资源，这在经济和物理上往往是令人望而却步的。跨集群训练可以平衡基础设施成本，缓解物理和资源限制，更好地匹配工作负载需求，并通过地理分布式部署维持更高的效率。然而，网络可变性、异构计算资源和内在训练不稳定性带来了挑战。

为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 Di-PS，这是一种用于大规模跨集群 LLM 培训的新颖框架。 Di-PS的核心是参数服务器范式的系统算法协同设计，以实现跨去中心化集群的异构、异步和弹性训练。我们在 Di-PS 中做出了多项创新贡献，包括（i）用于 LLM 参数跨集群通信的高效参数服务器设计，（ii）用于增强异步两阶段优化收敛稳定性的伪梯度惩罚策略，以及（iii）跨集群训练容错的弹性机制。受控实验设置的结果表明，Di-PS 比同步跨集群方法将训练效率提高了 4.67 倍，同时保持了模型质量，并在异构训练资源中实现了近线性可扩展性。 Di-PS已部署在生产环境中，涉及多达9个集群和超过10,000个NPU的动态训练规模。在这种规模下，Di-PS 能够成功实现 100B 参数 LLM 的跨集群训练，与单集群训练相比，开销仅为 6%，并有效处理频繁的故障和资源变更。

items.title: Feedback-guided Adaptive Testing of Distributed Systems Designs.
items.abstract:
Validating distributed systems for correctness poses significant challenges. Practitioners often rely on formal models of core system designs, which are then tested by exploring possible component interactions. Unfortunately, standard testing approaches based on random sampling of the state space are inefficient and prone to missing subtle bugs, as they lack guidance from the system's behavior.

To address this, we present Fest, a new testing system for formal models of distributed systems. Fest incorporates feedback-guided adaptive schedule generation, drawing inspiration from grey-box fuzzing, to steer exploration towards maximizing behavioral coverage and uncovering bugs more effectively. Our implementation in the P programming framework demonstrates significant improvements across 94 distributed system model configurations: up to 41× (1.5× average) improvement in behavioral coverage, 278× (15× average) improvement in scenario coverage, and 33% more bugs detected compared to existing methods. These results highlight Fest's effectiveness in ensuring the robustness of distributed systems through improved testing efficiency.
items.abstract_zh:
验证分布式系统的正确性提出了重大挑战。从业者通常依赖核心系统设计的正式模型，然后通过探索可能的组件交互来测试这些模型。不幸的是，基于状态空间随机采样的标准测试方法效率低下，并且容易丢失细微的错误，因为它们缺乏系统行为的指导。

为了解决这个问题，我们推出了 Fest，一个用于分布式系统正式模型的新测试系统。 Fest 结合了反馈引导的自适应计划生成，从灰盒模糊测试中汲取灵感，引导探索最大化行为覆盖范围并更有效地发现错误。我们在 P 编程框架中的实现展示了 94 个分布式系统模型配置的显着改进：与现有方法相比，行为覆盖率提高了 41 倍（平均 1.5 倍），场景覆盖率提高了 278 倍（平均 15 倍），检测到的错误增加了 33%。这些结果凸显了 Fest 通过提高测试效率确保分布式系统稳健性的有效性。

items.title: SwiftEP: Accelerating MoE Inference with Buffer Fusion and TMA Offloading.
items.abstract:
Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures to scale computation efficiently. Expert Parallelism (EP), which distributes experts across GPUs, introduces all-to-all communication overhead during the dispatch and combine phases, especially in the prefill stage, which dominates the inference performance. Existing communication libraries, such as DeepEP, suffer from excessive GPU SM utilization and underutilized interconnect bandwidth, limiting prefill performance.

In this paper, we identify two root causes: redundant buffer copies and inefficient intra-server transfers over NVLink. To address these, we propose SwiftEP, an all-to-all communication library tailored for MoE prefill, combining buffer fusion and Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA) offloading . Buffer fusion eliminates redundant staging copies, enabling true zero-copy communication, while TMA offloading maximizes NVLink utilization and supports efficient multicast/reduce operations. SwiftEP further incorporates RDMA scatter-gather lists, QP transmission parallelization, and CUDA IPC to handle dynamic token placement and inter-GPU memory access. Evaluation on 16- and 32-GPU clusters shows that SwiftEP achieves up to 119.7% higher algorithm bandwidth, reduces SM occupancy by up to 66.7%, and improves request serving capacity by 21.2% compared to DeepEP.
items.abstract_zh:
大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越依赖混合专家 (MoE) 架构来有效扩展计算。专家并行（EP）将专家分布在 GPU 上，在调度和组合阶段引入了所有到所有的通信开销，特别是在预填充阶段，该阶段决定了推理性能。现有的通信库（例如 DeepEP）存在 GPU SM 利用率过高和互连带宽未充分利用的问题，从而限制了预填充性能。

在本文中，我们确定了两个根本原因：冗余缓冲区副本和通过 NVLink 的服务器内传输效率低下。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 SwiftEP，这是一个专为 MoE 预填充量身定制的全方位通信库，结合了缓冲区融合和张量内存加速器 (TMA) 卸载。缓冲区融合消除了冗余的暂存副本，从而实现了真正的零复制通信，而 TMA 卸载则最大限度地提高了 NVLink 利用率并支持高效的多播/归约操作。 SwiftEP 进一步结合了 RDMA 分散收集列表、QP 传输并行化和 CUDA IPC，以处理动态令牌放置和 GPU 间内存访问。对16和32GPU集群的评估表明，与DeepEP相比，SwiftEP的算法带宽提高了119.7%，SM占用率降低了66.7%，请求服务能力提高了21.2%。

items.title: CStar Gateway: Augmenting Public Cloud Infrastructure for Heterogeneous Network Function Virtualization.
items.abstract: Major cloud providers often build NFV products by reusing existing architectures. These designs were originally developed and optimized for tenant virtual machines (VMs) that operate at network endpoints. In contrast, network function (NF) VMs function as intermediate forwarding nodes shared by multiple tenants, which have very different resource demands. Directly applying tenant-oriented designs creates mismatches between infrastructure capabilities and NF requirements. A common case arises when NF VMs serve many tenants: they typically exhaust vNIC and sessions on vSwitches well before CPU resources are saturated. At this point, NF VMs cannot accept additional traffic despite having idle CPU cycles. Providers usually address this by scaling out or scaling up NF VMs, which wastes resources and increases cost. This is just one example, where numerous other mismatches remain. To address these, we present CStar Gateway. CStar Gateway shifts NF VM multi-tenancy support from vSwitches into NF VMs, which reduces vNIC and session bottlenecks with minimal changes to the existing cloud infrastructure. CStar Gateway also identifies and redirects I/O- or CPU-intensive flows to FPGA-based NFs, increasing the service capacity. In addition, CStar Gateway takes over NF VM elasticity support from vSwitch, simplifying and accelerating the scaling process, and thereby enhancing overall system flexibility. Deployment results show that the design improves CPU and I/O utilization of NF VMs by at least 5x and reduces NF cluster capital expenditure by 71.91% to 88.57%.
items.abstract_zh: 主要云提供商通常通过重用现有架构来构建 NFV 产品。这些设计最初是为在网络端点运行的租户虚拟机 (VM) 开发和优化的。相比之下，网络功能（NF）虚拟机充当多个租户共享的中间转发节点，其资源需求差异很大。直接应用面向租户的设计会造成基础设施功能与 NF 需求之间的不匹配。当 NF VM 为许多租户提供服务时，会出现一种常见情况：它们通常会在 CPU 资源饱和之前耗尽 vNIC 和 vSwitch 上的会话。此时，尽管 NF VM 具有空闲 CPU 周期，但仍无法接受额外流量。提供商通常通过横向扩展或纵向扩展 NF VM 来解决此问题，但这会浪费资源并增加成本。这只是一个例子，还有许多其他不匹配的情况。为了解决这些问题，我们推出了 CStar Gateway。 CStar Gateway 将 NF VM 多租户支持从 vSwitch 转移到 NF VM，从而减少了 vNIC 和会话瓶颈，同时对现有云基础设施进行了最小的更改。 CStar Gateway 还可以识别 I/O 或 CPU 密集型流量并将其重定向到基于 FPGA 的 NF，从而提高服务容量。此外，CStar Gateway接管了vSwitch的NF VM弹性支持，简化并加速了扩展过程，从而增强了整体系统的灵活性。部署结果表明，该设计将NF虚拟机的CPU和I/O利用率提高至少5倍，并将NF集群资本支出降低71.91%至88.57%。

items.title: SLATE: Service Layer Traffic Engineering.
items.abstract: In microservice-based applications, requests flow between many microservice instances across potentially multiple geodistributed clusters. Today, the routing of requests is limited to simple load balancing, or extensions that spill requests to nearby clusters. We argue that the problem is more subtle, and that there are significant opportunities for improvement by viewing microservice request routing as a global traffic engineering problem. We present Service Layer Traffic Engineering (SLATE), a system that optimizes request routing in microservice deployments that span multiple clusters to minimize average latency and bandwidth cost. SLATE tackles challenges unique to the service layer, including multiple request traffic classes, multi-hop call trees, and service latency profiles. To achieve this, SLATE takes a unique hybrid approach combining global optimization and local exploration. SLATE outperforms state-of-the-art global load balancing by up to 18.3× in average latency and reduces egress bandwidth cost by up to 2.64× in a Kubernetes deployment of an open-source benchmark application, and shows resilient performance against dynamic changes due to its hybrid optimization approach. Our system is completely transparent to the application and can be seamlessly plugged into existing L7 proxy deployments, specifically Envoy.
items.abstract_zh: 在基于微服务的应用程序中，请求在可能跨多个地理分布式集群的许多微服务实例之间流动。如今，请求的路由仅限于简单的负载平衡或将请求溢出到附近集群的扩展。我们认为，这个问题更加微妙，并且通过将微服务请求路由视为全局流量工程问题，存在重大的改进机会。我们推出服务层流量工程 (SLATE)，这是一个系统，可优化跨多个集群的微服务部署中的请求路由，以最大限度地减少平均延迟和带宽成本。 SLATE 解决了服务层特有的挑战，包括多个请求流量类别、多跳调用树和服务延迟配置文件。为了实现这一目标，SLATE 采用了一种独特的混合方法，将全局优化和局部探索相结合。在开源基准应用程序的 Kubernetes 部署中，SLATE 的平均延迟优于最先进的全局负载平衡高达 18.3 倍，并将出口带宽成本降低高达 2.64 倍，并且由于其混合优化方法，展现出针对动态变化的弹性性能。我们的系统对应用程序完全透明，可以无缝插入现有的 L7 代理部署，特别是 Envoy。

items.title: From Intention to Practice: Towards Systematic Validation of NIDS Rule Enforcement.
items.abstract: Rule-based Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS) are integral to contemporary cybersecurity, relying on the rule matching mechanism to identify malicious activities within network traffic. However, there is no inherent assurance that the deployed rules are enforced as intended due to factors regarding the composition of the rules and implementation flaws of NIDS. Unfortunately, administrators lack appropriate means to validate the gap between rule definition and enforcement as existing testing approaches towards NIDS are often rule irrelevant and lack systematic methodologies. To address this issue, this paper presents NIDSFuzz , a systematic fuzzing approach designed to validate the enforcement of rules within NIDS, which is rule-oriented so that it employs tailored mutation strategies to generate test traffic based on the very ruleset deployed. In this manner, it becomes feasible to validate the targeted rulesets with guarantee of coverage. An NIDS-specific fuzzing framework is proposed, incorporating an appropriate test traffic injection method to perform fuzzing and carefully designed approaches of sanitization and analysis to effectively identify rule enforcement issues. Experimental results show that NIDSFuzz is able to uncover over 10,000 rule enforcement issues. We classified the discovered issues into different categories and explored corresponding countermeasures in terms of both rules and NIDS implementation. Moreover, performance evaluation confirms the efficiency of NIDSFuzz and comparison to other tools highlights the significant advantage of NIDSFuzz in evaluating rules of NIDS. We have made our code publicly available.
items.abstract_zh: 基于规则的网络入侵检测系统 (NIDS) 是当代网络安全不可或缺的一部分，它依靠规则匹配机制来识别网络流量中的恶意活动。然而，由于规则的组成和 NIDS 的实施缺陷等因素，并不能保证已部署的规则按预期执行。不幸的是，管理员缺乏适当的方法来验证规则定义和执行之间的差距，因为现有的 NIDS 测试方法通常与规则无关并且缺乏系统的方法。为了解决这个问题，本文提出了 NIDSFuzz，这是一种系统模糊方法，旨在验证 NIDS 内规则的执行情况，该方法是面向规则的，因此它采用定制的变异策略来根据部署的规则集生成测试流量。通过这种方式，在保证覆盖范围的情况下验证目标规则集变得可行。提出了一种特定于 NIDS 的模糊测试框架，结合了适当的测试流量注入方法来执行模糊测试，并精心设计了清理和分析方法，以有效地识别规则执行问题。实验结果表明，NIDSFuzz 能够发现超过 10,000 个规则执行问题。我们对发现的问题进行了分类，并从规则和NIDS实施方面探讨了相应的对策。此外，性能评估证实了NIDSFuzz的效率，并且与其他工具的比较凸显了NIDSFuzz在评估NIDS规则方面的显着优势。我们已公开我们的代码。

items.title: CCEval: Accurately and Confidently Evaluating Performance Metrics of Congestion Control Algorithms for Datacenter Networks.
items.abstract:
Congestion control in datacenter networks (DCNs) is a highly active research area. Typical CCA evaluation workflows contain three steps: generate experimental configurations, execute the experiments, and estimate performance metrics using results from multiple trials. However, due to variability brought by random traffic workloads and single-digit trial counts, common experimental methodologies fail to provide enough confidence to properly evaluate CCA performance.

We propose CCEval, an evaluation framework for accurately and confidently estimating performance metrics of CCAs in DCNs. The key idea is using confidence intervals and more trials to quantify and improve the accuracy and confidence of performance metrics. To this end, we propose a model-free estimation algorithm to calculate the confidence intervals and forecast the required trial count for a given accuracy, confidence level, metric, and CCA. We further design a model-based tail quantile estimation algorithm to reduce the needed trial counts significantly without losing accuracy and confidence. Extensive experiments on simulators and real-world testbeds with four CCAs on typical topologies and flow distributions show that CCEval can produce estimations of performance metrics accurately and confidently, with 1% relative margin of error and 95% confidence level, and can reduce trial counts by 75%~80% for tail quantile estimation.
items.abstract_zh:
数据中心网络 (DCN) 中的拥塞控制是一个非常活跃的研究领域。典型的 CCA 评估工作流程包含三个步骤：生成实验配置、执行实验以及使用多次试验的结果估计性能指标。然而，由于随机流量工作负载和个位数试验计数带来的可变性，常见的实验方法无法提供足够的信心来正确评估 CCA 性能。

我们提出了 CCEval，一个评估框架，用于准确、自信地估计 DCN 中 CCA 的性能指标。关键思想是使用置信区间和更多试验来量化和提高性能指标的准确性和置信度。为此，我们提出了一种无模型估计算法来计算置信区间并预测给定精度、置信水平、指标和 CCA 所需的试验次数。我们进一步设计了一种基于模型的尾部分位数估计算法，以显着减少所需的试验次数，而不会损失准确性和置信度。在模拟器和真实测试平台上使用四个 CCA 对典型拓扑和流量分布进行的大量实验表明，CCEval 可以准确、自信地生成性能指标估计，相对误差范围为 1%，置信度为 95%，并且可以将尾分位数估计的试验次数减少 75%~80%。

items.title: DroidSpeak: KV Cache Sharing Across Fine-tuned Model Variants.
items.abstract:
Compound AI systems , such as agentic systems, are an emerging trend in large-scale enterprise settings, with multiple LLMs specialized for different users, tasks, and/or roles working together. In these scenarios, different models often process inputs that share the same context prefix. Although much work was done in the past to enable the reuse of prefix KV caches across inputs for a single model, how to enable one model to reuse the prefix KV caches of a different model remains an open question.

We introduce DroidSpeak, the first distributed LLM inference system that enables KV cache reuse across distributed nodes running inference of different LLMs, so long as the LLMs have the same architecture. We present the first study that aims at understanding the impact of sharing KV caches across different LLMs, and if/when such sharing affects quality. Inspired by the findings, we present DroidSpeak, which selectively recomputes a few layers of the KV cache produced by another LLM and reuses the remaining layers, with negligible quality loss. Moreover, carefully pipelining the layer-wise re-computation and the loading of reused KV cache further improves the inference performance. Experiments on diverse datasets and model pairs demonstrate that DroidSpeak achieves up to 4x throughput improvement and about 3.1× faster prefill (time to first token), with negligible loss of quality in F1 scores, Rouge-L or code similarity score, compared to the baseline which does not allow any sharing across models.
items.abstract_zh:
复合人工智能系统（例如代理系统）是大型企业环境中的新兴趋势，多个法学硕士专门针对不同的用户、任务和/或角色一起工作。在这些场景中，不同的模型通常处理共享相同上下文前缀的输入。尽管过去已经做了很多工作来实现单个模型的跨输入重用前缀 KV 缓存，但如何使一个模型能够重用不同模型的前缀 KV 缓存仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。

我们推出了 DroidSpeak，这是第一个分布式 LLM 推理系统，只要 LLM 具有相同的架构，它就可以在运行不同 LLM 推理的分布式节点之间重用 KV 缓存。我们提出了第一项研究，旨在了解跨不同 LLM 共享 KV 缓存的影响，以及这种共享是否/何时会影响质量。受这些发现的启发，我们提出了 DroidSpeak，它有选择地重新计算另一个 LLM 生成的 KV 缓存的几层，并重用剩余的层，质量损失可以忽略不计。此外，仔细地流水线化分层重新计算和重用 KV 缓存的加载进一步提高了推理性能。对不同数据集和模型对的实验表明，与不允许跨模型共享的基线相比，DroidSpeak 的吞吐量提高了 4 倍，预填充速度（第一个令牌的时间）提高了约 3.1 倍，F1 分数、Rouge-L 或代码相似性分数的质量损失可以忽略不计。

items.title: Geminet: Learning the Duality-based Topology-Agnostic Update Operator for Lightweight Traffic Engineering in Changing Topologies.
items.abstract: Recently, researchers have explored ML-based Traffic Engineering (TE), leveraging neural networks to solve TE problems traditionally addressed by optimization. However, existing ML-based TE schemes remain impractical: they either fail to handle topology changes or suffer from poor scalability due to excessive computational and memory overhead. To overcome these limitations, we propose Geminet, a lightweight and scalable ML-based TE framework that can handle changing topologies. Geminet is built upon two key insights: (i) decoupling neural networks from topology by learning a topology-agnostic update operator inspired by classical iterative optimization methods (e.g., gradient descent), which depend only on a few gradient-related quantities; (ii) shifting optimization from path-level routing weights to edge-level dual variables, reducing memory consumption by leveraging the fact that edges are far fewer than paths. Evaluations on WAN and data center datasets show that Geminet significantly improves scalability. Its neural network size is only 0.04%-7% of existing schemes, while handling topology variations as effectively as HARP, a state-of-the-art ML-based TE approach, without performance degradation. When trained on large-scale topologies, Geminet consumes less than 10 GiB of memory compared to more than 80 GiB required by HARP, while achieving 18× faster convergence, demonstrating its potential for large-scale deployment.
items.abstract_zh: 最近，研究人员探索了基于机器学习的流量工程 (TE)，利用神经网络来解决传统上通过优化解决的 TE 问题。然而，现有的基于 ML 的 TE 方案仍然不切实际：它们要么无法处理拓扑变化，要么由于过多的计算和内存开销而导致可扩展性较差。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了 Geminet，这是一种轻量级且可扩展的基于 ML 的 TE 框架，可以处理不断变化的拓扑。 Geminet 建立在两个关键见解的基础上：（i）通过学习受经典迭代优化方法（例如梯度下降）启发的拓扑不可知更新算子，将神经网络与拓扑解耦，该算子仅依赖于一些与梯度相关的量； (ii) 将优化从路径级路由权重转向边缘级双变量，利用边缘远少于路径的事实来减少内存消耗。对广域网和数据中心数据集的评估表明，Geminet 显着提高了可扩展性。其神经网络规模仅为现有方案的 0.04%-7%，同时可以像 HARP（一种最先进的基于 ML 的 TE 方法）一样有效地处理拓扑变化，而不会降低性能。在大规模拓扑上进行训练时，Geminet 消耗的内存不到 10 GiB，而 HARP 需要超过 80 GiB，同时实现了 18 倍的更快收敛速度​​，展示了其大规模部署的潜力。

items.title: Decoding RSSI Compression in RFID: Dynamic RCS Modeling and Tag-Intrinsic Power Metrics for Reliable Backscatter Networks.
items.abstract: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) is a foundational element of modern IoT and backscatter networks, powering inventory, localization, and battery-free sensing at scale. In this paper, we uncover RSSI compression , a power-dependent bias in reader-measured RSSI, as a critical physical-layer problem that propagates upward in the network stack, degrading MAC-layer collision resolution, network-layer link estimation, and application-layer reliability. Through carefully designed experiments, we trace this distortion to dynamic tag Radar Cross Section (RCS) behavior and introduce two novel physical-layer metrics: Interrogation Threshold Power (ITP), a channel-specific metric for accurate link-quality estimation, and Backscatter Power Index (BPI), a tag-intrinsic, environment-agnostic signature. These metrics provide high-fidelity signal information that higher layers can directly exploit for more robust collision detection, power control, localization and sensing tasks. Finally, an in-situ single-query method further reduces measurement overhead by 99.8%, while cutting channel-estimation error by 64.7%, delivering significant cross-layer performance gains in real-world backscatter networks.
items.abstract_zh: 射频识别 (RFID) 是现代物联网和反向散射网络的基本要素，为大规模库存、定位和无电池传感提供支持。在本文中，我们发现 RSSI 压缩（读取器测量的 RSSI 中的一种与功率相关的偏差）是一个关键的物理层问题，会在网络堆栈中向上传播，从而降低 MAC 层冲突解决、网络层链路估计和应用层可靠性。通过精心设计的实验，我们将这种失真追溯到动态标签雷达截面（RCS）行为，并引入了两种新颖的物理层指标：询问阈值功率（ITP），一种用于准确估计链路质量的特定于通道的指标，以及反向散射功率指数（BPI），一种标签固有的、与环境无关的签名。这些指标提供了高保真信号信息，高层可以直接利用这些信息来实现更强大的碰撞检测、功率控制、定位和传感任务。最后，原位单查询方法进一步将测量开销减少了 99.8%，同时将信道估计误差减少了 64.7%，从而在现实世界的反向散射网络中实现了显着的跨层性能提升。

items.title: Supercharging Packet-level Network Simulation of Large Model Training via Memoization and Fast-Forwarding.
items.abstract:
Packet-level discrete-event simulation (PLDES) is a prevalent tool for evaluating detailed performance of large model training. Although PLDES offers high fidelity and generality, its slow performance has plagued networking practitioners. Existing optimization techniques either simplify the network model, resulting in large errors; or execute it in parallel using multiple processors, with an upper bound on speedup.

This paper explores an alternative optimization direction that reduces the computational loads of PLDES while maintaining high fidelity. Our key insight is that, in distributed LLM training, packet-level traffic behaviors often exhibit repetitive contention patterns and steady-states where flow rates stabilize, ignoring these redundant discrete events speeds up the simulation considerably and the error is negligible. We realize this idea by proposing Wormhole, a user-transparent PLDES kernel capable of automatically memoization for unsteady-states and skipping for steady-states. Wormhole adopts network partitioning, state memoization and reuse, and rate-based steady-state identification to accurately determine the periods of each flow’s steady-state, while maintaining simulation consistency after fast-forwarding. Experiments demonstrate that Wormhole can achieve a 744× speedup over the original ns-3 (510× for MoE workload), with a bounded error of <1%. Applying current multithreading parallel techniques and Wormhole together allows a 1012× speedup, reducing the simulation time for one GPT-13B training under 128 GPUs from 9 hours to 5 minutes.
items.abstract_zh:
数据包级离散事件仿真 (PLDES) 是评估大型模型训练详细性能的流行工具。尽管 PLDES 提供高保真度和通用性，但其缓慢的性能一直困扰着网络从业者。现有的优化技术要么简化网络模型，导致误差较大；要么简化网络模型，导致误差较大。或者使用多个处理器并行执行它，并有加速上限。

本文探索了一种替代优化方向，可减少 PLDES 的计算负载，同时保持高保真度。我们的主要见解是，在分布式 LLM 训练中，数据包级流量行为通常表现出重复的争用模式和流量稳定的稳态，忽略这些冗余离散事件可显着加快模拟速度，并且误差可以忽略不计。我们通过提出 Wormhole 来实现这个想法，这是一个用户透明的 PLDES 内核，能够自动记忆非稳态并跳过稳态。 Wormhole采用网络划分、状态记忆和重用以及基于速率的稳态识别来准确确定每个流的稳态周期，同时在快进后保持模拟一致性。实验表明，与原始 ns-3 相比，Wormhole 可以实现 744 倍的加速（MoE 工作负载为 510 倍），且有限误差 <1%。将当前的多线程并行技术和 Wormhole 结合在一起，可以实现 1012 倍的加速，将 128 个 GPU 下一次 GPT-13B 训练的模拟时间从 9 小时缩短到 5 分钟。

items.title: HydraServe: Minimizing Cold Start Latency for Serverless LLM Serving in Public Clouds.
items.abstract: With the proliferation of large language model (LLM) variants, developers are turning to serverless computing for cost-efficient LLM deployment. However, public cloud providers often struggle to provide performance guarantees for serverless LLM serving due to significant cold start latency caused by substantial model sizes and complex runtime dependencies. To address this problem, we present HydraServe, a serverless LLM serving system designed to minimize cold start latency in public clouds. HydraServe proactively distributes models across servers to quickly fetch them, and overlaps cold-start stages within workers to reduce startup latency. Additionally, HydraServe strategically places workers across GPUs to avoid network contention among cold-start instances. To minimize resource consumption during cold starts, HydraServe further introduces pipeline consolidation that can merge groups of workers into individual serving endpoints. Our comprehensive evaluations under diverse settings demonstrate that HydraServe reduces the cold start latency by 1.7×–4.7× and improves service level objective attainment by 1.43×–1.74× compared to baselines.
items.abstract_zh: 随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 变体的激增，开发人员正在转向无服务器计算，以实现经济高效的 LLM 部署。然而，由于大量的模型大小和复杂的运行时依赖性导致显着的冷启动延迟，公共云提供商通常很难为无服务器 LLM 服务提供性能保证。为了解决这个问题，我们推出了 HydraServe，这是一种无服务器 LLM 服务系统，旨在最大限度地减少公共云中的冷启动延迟。 HydraServe 主动跨服务器分发模型以快速获取它们，并重叠工作线程内的冷启动阶段以减少启动延迟。此外，HydraServe 战略性地将工作人员放置在 GPU 上，以避免冷启动实例之间的网络争用。为了最大限度地减少冷启动期间的资源消耗，HydraServe 进一步引入了管道整合，可以将工作组合并到单独的服务端点中。我们在不同设置下的综合评估表明，与基线相比，HydraServe 将冷启动延迟降低了 1.7×–4.7×，并将服务水平目标实现提高了 1.43×–1.74×。

items.title: CascadeNet: Generating Network Traffic with High-Fidelity Temporal Patterns.
items.abstract: Facing the challenge of limited network trace access, the exploration of synthetic trace generation has become crucial for research. Although current methods manage to replicate the statistical characteristics of network traffic accurately, they fail to capture the temporal dynamics of network activities. This gap stems primarily from their approach to data representation. To address this issue, we propose a novel representation of network traces by aggregating network flows into time series. Built upon this data representation, we propose CascadeNet, an end-to-end framework embedded with CascadeGAN—a hierarchical generative model—to generate network traffic with high-fidelity temporal patterns while learning complex flow structures and dependencies. We also develop several techniques to facilitate the transformation from aggregated time series to timestamps. Our evaluations across four diverse IPv4 header traces show (1) CascadeNet surpasses baselines by 41%~76% on temporal distance metrics; (2) CascadeNet outperforms baselines in downstream tasks; (3) it offers remarkable scalability, reducing training time by 7.3×~25× compared to state-of-the-art method.
items.abstract_zh: 面对有限的网络痕迹访问的挑战，合成痕迹生成的探索已成为研究的关键。尽管当前的方法能够准确地复制网络流量的统计特征，但它们无法捕获网络活动的时间动态。这种差距主要源于他们的数据表示方法。为了解决这个问题，我们通过将网络流聚合成时间序列，提出了一种新的网络轨迹表示方法。基于这种数据表示，我们提出了 CascadeNet，这是一种嵌入 CascadeGAN（分层生成模型）的端到端框架，用于生成具有高保真时间模式的网络流量，同时学习复杂的流结构和依赖关系。我们还开发了多种技术来促进从聚合时间序列到时间戳的转换。我们对四个不同 IPv4 标头跟踪的评估表明：(1) CascadeNet 在时间距离指标上超出基线 41%~76%； (2) CascadeNet 在下游任务中优于基线； (3)它提供了显着的可扩展性，与最先进的方法相比，训练时间减少了 7.3×~25×。

items.title: Bridging Storage and Execution: A Semantic Virtual Bus for On-Demand Application Streaming.
items.abstract: Traditional application delivery requires full local installation, incurring persistent security risks from outdated versions, significant download delays. Despite advances in network throughput and latency, existing dynamic loading solutions such as Web applications and network filesystems like NFS suffer from performance degradation, functionality limitations, and intrusive application modifications. We introduce STREAMBUS, a transparent application streaming system that redefines the network as a semantic-aware virtual storage bus beneath the file system layer. Supporting deployment across diverse environments, including WiFi-dependent mobile devices, it addresses two key challenges: maintaining microsecond-level latency comparable to local storage and bridging the semantic gap between stateless remote storage and stateful execution. To achieve this, STREAMBUS combines a dual-mode transmission mechanism that synchronously serves requested blocks and asynchronously prefetches predicted blocks, with a thread-aware Markov-chain model that captures fine-grained access patterns. Evaluation shows STREAMBUS delivers near-native performance across diverse networks. On desktops, it achieves 15–40% better per-page access latency than local NVMe in common cases. On mobile devices, it typically sustains startup overheads below 40% relative to local storage, even over variable Wi-Fi connectivity. Robustness experiments demonstrate stable performance under emulated network conditions with realistic delay patterns, supporting intra-city deployments.
items.abstract_zh: 传统的应用程序交付需要完全本地安装，过时的版本会带来持续的安全风险，严重的下载延迟。尽管网络吞吐量和延迟方面取得了进步，但现有的动态加载解决方案（例如 Web 应用程序和 NFS 等网络文件系统）仍遭受性能下降、功能限制和侵入性应用程序修改的困扰。我们推出了 STREAMBUS，这是一种透明的应用程序流系统，它将网络重新定义为文件系统层下的语义感知虚拟存储总线。它支持跨不同环境（包括依赖 WiFi 的移动设备）的部署，解决了两个关键挑战：保持与本地存储相当的微秒级延迟，以及弥合无状态远程存储和有状态执行之间的语义差距。为了实现这一目标，STREAMBUS 将同步服务请求块和异步预取预测块的双模式传输机制与捕获细粒度访问模式的线程感知马尔可夫链模型相结合。评估表明 STREAMBUS 在不同的网络中提供接近本机的性能。在桌面上，在常见情况下，它的每页访问延迟比本地 NVMe 低 15-40%。在移动设备上，即使通过可变的 Wi-Fi 连接，它通常也能将启动开销维持在本地存储的 40% 以下。鲁棒性实验证明了在具有真实延迟模式的模拟网络条件下的稳定性能，支持城市内部署。

items.title: Agentix: An Efficient Serving Engine for LLM Agents as General Programs.
items.abstract:
Large language model (LLM) applications are evolving beyond simple chatbots into dynamic, general-purpose agentic programs, which scale LLM calls and output tokens to help AI agents reason, explore, and solve complex tasks. However, existing LLM serving systems ignore dependencies between programs and calls, missing significant opportunities for optimization. Our analysis reveals that programs submitted to LLM serving engines experience long cumulative wait times, primarily due to head-of-line blocking at both the individual LLM request and the program.

To address this, we introduce Agentix, an LLM serving system that treats programs as first-class citizens to minimize their end-to-end latencies. Agentix intercepts LLM calls submitted by programs, enriching schedulers with program-level context. We propose two scheduling algorithms—for single-threaded and distributed programs—that preempt and prioritize LLM calls based on their programs' previously completed calls. Our evaluation demonstrates that across diverse LLMs and agentic workloads, Agentix improves throughput of programs by 4-15× at the same latency compared to state-of-the-art systems, such as vLLM.
items.abstract_zh:
大型语言模型 (LLM) 应用程序正在从简单的聊天机器人演变成动态的通用代理程序，这些程序可扩展 LLM 调用和输出令牌，以帮助 AI 代理推理、探索和解决复杂任务。然而，现有的 LLM 服务系统忽略了程序和调用之间的依赖关系，错过了重要的优化机会。我们的分析表明，提交给 LLM 服务引擎的程序会经历较长的累积等待时间，这主要是由于单个 LLM 请求和程序的队头阻塞。

为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 Agentix，这是一个法学硕士服务系统，它将项目视为一等公民，以最大限度地减少其端到端延迟。 Agentix 拦截程序提交的 LLM 调用，利用程序级上下文丰富调度程序。我们针对单线程和分布式程序提出了两种调度算法，它们根据程序先前完成的调用来抢占并优先化 LLM 调用。我们的评估表明，在不同的 LLM 和代理工作负载中，与 vLLM 等最先进的系统相比，Agentix 在相同延迟的情况下将程序吞吐量提高了 4-15 倍。

items.title: TurboTest: Learning When Less is Enough through Early Termination of Internet Speed Tests.
items.abstract: Internet speed tests are indispensable for users, ISPs, and policymakers, but their static flooding-based design imposes growing costs: a single high-speed test can transfer hundreds of MB, and collectively, platforms like Ookla, M-Lab, and Fast.com generate petabytes of traffic each month. Reducing this burden requires deciding when a test can be stopped early without sacrificing accuracy. We frame this as an optimal stopping problem and show that existing heuristics—static thresholds, BBR pipe-full signals, or throughput stability rules from Fast.com and FastBTS—capture only a narrow slice of the achievable accuracy—savings trade-off. This paper introduces TURBOTEST, a systematic framework for speed test termination that sits atop existing platforms. The key idea is to decouple throughput prediction (Stage~1) from test termination (Stage~2): Stage~1 trains a regressor to estimate final throughput from partial measurements, while Stage~2 trains a classifier to decide when sufficient evidence has accumulated to stop. Leveraging richer transport-level features (RTT, retransmissions, congestion window) alongside throughput, TURBOTEST exposes a single tunable parameter ε for accuracy tolerance and includes a fallback mechanism for high-variability cases. Evaluation on 1 million M-Lab NDT speed tests (2024–2025) shows that TURBOTEST achieves 1.8-4.4× higher data savings than an approach based on BBR signals while reducing median error. These results demonstrate that adaptive ML-based termination can deliver accurate, efficient, and deployable speed tests at scale.
items.abstract_zh: 互联网速度测试对于用户、ISP 和政策制定者来说是不可或缺的，但其基于静态洪泛的设计带来了越来越高的成本：一次高速测试可以传输数百 MB，而 Ookla、M-Lab 和 Fast.com 等平台每月总共会产生 PB 的流量。减轻这种负担需要决定何时可以在不牺牲准确性的情况下提前停止测试。我们将此视为最佳停止问题，并表明现有的启发式方法（静态阈值、BBR 满管信号或来自 Fast.com 和 FastBTS 的吞吐量稳定性规则）仅捕获了可实现的精度和节省权衡中的一小部分。本文介绍了 TURBOTEST，这是一个位于现有平台之上的速度测试终止系统框架。关键思想是将吞吐量预测（Stage~1）与测试终止（Stage~2）解耦：Stage~1 训练回归器以根据部分测量估计最终吞吐量，而 Stage~2 训练分类器来决定何时积累足够的证据来停止。利用更丰富的传输级功能（RTT、重传、拥塞窗口）以及吞吐量，TURBOTEST 公开了单个可调参数 ε 以实现精度容差，并包括针对高可变性情况的回退机制。对 100 万次 M-Lab NDT 速度测试（2024-2025 年）的评估表明，TURBOTEST 比基于 BBR 信号的方法节省了 1.8-4.4 倍的数据，同时减少了中值误差。这些结果表明，基于 ML 的自适应终止可以大规模提供准确、高效且可部署的速度测试。

items.title: A Fast Solver-Free Algorithm for Traffic Engineering in Large-Scale Data Center Network.
items.abstract:
Rapid growth of data center networks (DCNs) poses significant challenges for large-scale traffic engineering (TE). Existing acceleration strategies, which rely on commercial solvers or deep learning, face scalability issues and struggle with degrading performance or long computational time.

Unlike existing algorithms adopting parallel strategies, we propose Sequential Source-Destination Optimization (SSDO), a sequential solver-free algorithm for intra-DCN TE. SSDO decomposes the problem into subproblems, each focused on adjusting the split ratios for a specific source-destination (SD) demand while keeping others fixed. To enhance the efficiency of subproblem optimization, we design a Balanced Binary Search Method (BBSM), which identifies the most balanced split ratios among multiple solutions that minimize Maximum Link Utilization (MLU). SSDO dynamically updates the sequence of SDs based on real-time utilization, which accelerates convergence and enhances solution quality.

We evaluate SSDO primarily on Meta DCNs, and additionally on two WAN topologies as auxiliary demonstrations of generality. In a Meta topology, SSDO achieves a 65% and 60% reduction in normalized MLU compared to TEAL and POP, two state-of-the-art TE acceleration methods, while delivering a 12× speedup over POP. These results demonstrate the superior performance of SSDO in large-scale TE.
items.abstract_zh:
数据中心网络（DCN）的快速增长给大规模流量工程（TE）带来了重大挑战。现有的加速策略依赖于商业求解器或深度学习，面临可扩展性问题，并与性能下降或计算时间过长作斗争。

与采用并行策略的现有算法不同，我们提出了顺序源-目的地优化（SSDO），这是一种用于 DCN 内 TE 的顺序无求解器算法。 SSDO 将问题分解为子问题，每个子问题都专注于调整特定源-目的地 (SD) 需求的分流比，同时保持其他问题固定。为了提高子问题优化的效率，我们设计了平衡二分搜索方法（BBSM），该方法可识别多个解决方案中最平衡的分流比，从而最小化最大链路利用率（MLU）。 SSDO根据实时利用率动态更新SD序列，从而加速收敛并提高解的质量。

我们主要在元 DCN 上评估 SSDO，另外还评估两种 WAN 拓扑作为通用性的辅助演示。在元拓扑中，与两种最先进的 TE 加速方法 TEAL 和 POP 相比，SSDO 的归一化 MLU 减少了 65% 和 60%，同时比 POP 提供了 12 倍的加速。这些结果证明了SSDO在大规模TE中的优越性能。

items.title: MAE: More Adaptive Video Encoder for Consistent Low Latency in High-Quality Real-Time Communication.
items.abstract: Real-time communication (RTC) is integral to modern digital life. However, high-quality RTC services still experience tail latency spikes. A primary cause of this issue is the sender’s slow adaptation to network fluctuations—when network bandwidth drops, the sender needs to quickly reduce the sending rate to avoid bufferbloat. Existing solutions focus on accelerating reactions in the network, transport layer, or sender-side buffer management, but often overlook a critical component: the reaction of the video encoder. The encoder serves as the content source, where slow convergence to new bitrates can still result in bufferbloat after the encoder. With the increasing video bitrate in high-quality RTC, our measurement shows that the encoder’s reaction is critical. To address this limitation, we propose M ore A daptive E ncoder (MAE), a framework that enables encoders to dynamically adapt to network changes with finer-grained network information. On the encoder side, MAE adaptively adjusts the internal encoding parameters to quickly converge to the target bitrate without affecting the video quality. On the network side, MAE probes the internal state of current congestion control algorithms to preemptively react to potential bandwidth drops, without waiting for the late, backpressured bitrate updates. Trace-driven emulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that our solution, MAE, reduces stall rates by 86.2% while maintaining superior visual quality compared to the state of the art.
items.abstract_zh: 实时通信 (RTC) 是现代数字生活不可或缺的一部分。然而，高质量的 RTC 服务仍然会遇到尾部延迟峰值。造成这个问题的主要原因是发送方对网络波动的适应缓慢——当网络带宽下降时，发送方需要快速降低发送速率以避免缓冲区膨胀。现有的解决方案侧重于加速网络、传输层或发送方缓冲区管理中的反应，但常常忽略一个关键组件：视频编码器的反应。编码器充当内容源，缓慢收敛到新比特率仍可能导致编码器之后的缓冲区膨胀。随着高质量 RTC 中视频比特率的增加，我们的测量表明编码器的反应至关重要。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了更多自适应编码器（MAE），该框架使编码器能够通过更细粒度的网络信息动态适应网络变化。在编码器端，MAE自适应调整内部编码参数，快速收敛到目标码率，而不影响视频质量。在网络方面，MAE 探测当前拥塞控制算法的内部状态，以先发制人地对潜在的带宽下降做出反应，而无需等待后期的背压比特率更新。跟踪驱动的仿真和真实世界的实验表明，与最先进的技术相比，我们的解决方案 MAE 可将停顿率降低 86.2%，同时保持卓越的视觉质量。

items.title: MirrorNet: High-fidelity and Scalable Network Emulation for Software-defined WAN.
items.abstract: Operating a large-scale WAN reliably is becoming increasingly challenging due to the surge in traffic volumes, and the growing complexity of both software and hardware. In this paper, we introduce MirrorNet, our production-grade emulation framework designed to mirror a software-based WAN. Unlike traditional emulators and simulators that access only a partial set of network information, MirrorNet functions as a comprehensive twin of the production network, encompassing the controller, data plane, and network traffic. Our key challenge lies in striking a balance between the requirements for a fine-grained and high-fidelity emulation, scalability, and resource efficiency. To address these, we have developed a multi-faceted approach: i) we employ an incremental storage and replay method to reconstruct the historical production network at a second-by-second level; ii) we propose a network update strategy that maintains consistent alignment between the emulation and production networks; and iii) we design a custom orchestrator capable of rapidly deploying one or more large-scale emulation networks, which can operate concurrently to expedite testing. MirrorNet has been deployed in TWAN for over 2 years and integral in our daily WAN management tasks, aiding in troubleshooting, parameter tuning, testing, and capacity assessment.
items.abstract_zh: 由于流量激增以及软件和硬件的复杂性不断增加，可靠地运营大规模 WAN 变得越来越具有挑战性。在本文中，我们介绍了 MirrorNet，这是我们的生产级仿真框架，旨在镜像基于软件的 WAN。与仅访问部分网络信息集的传统仿真器和仿真器不同，MirrorNet 充当生产网络的综合双胞胎，包含控制器、数据平面和网络流量。我们的主要挑战在于在细粒度和高保真仿真、可扩展性和资源效率的要求之间取得平衡。为了解决这些问题，我们开发了一种多方面的方法：i）我们采用增量存储和重放的方法来重建历史生产网络的秒级； ii）我们提出了一种网络更新策略，以保持仿真网络和生产网络之间的一致一致性； iii) 我们设计了一种定制编排器，能够快速部署一个或多个大规模仿真网络，该网络可以同时运行以加快测试速度。 MirrorNet 已在 TWAN 中部署超过 2 年，并成为我们日常 WAN 管理任务的一部分，有助于故障排除、参数调整、测试和容量评估。

items.title: Cost-effective and Reliable Global Internet Peering with Programmable Switches.
items.abstract: Large-scale cloud providers always deploy peering routing system at the Internet’s peering edge to route traffic between the cloud and the Internet. Traditional router-based peering systems fail to pace up to the fast-changing application requirements, while the recent host-based approach is not cost-effective and struggles to address malicious traffic from the Internet. In this paper, we advocate for a radical new peering architecture to introduce programmable switches at the peering edge. We propose and implement a first-of-its-kind system, called Janus, to simultaneously handle inbound and outbound network traffic and significantly reduce network hardware cost. The core of Janus’s approach is to leverage a traffic dispatch module to offload most of the outbound traffic to switches to enhance system’s scalability. Janus offloads all inbound traffic to switches and redirects potential malicious traffic to the anti-DDoS service to enhance system reliability. Furthermore, Janus introduces a fast route convergence mechanism to effectively handle Internet-scale route updates. We have gradually deployed Janus at the edge of our production network over the past years. Evaluation results show that Janus can reduce the average hardware cost by 78%, as compared to existing systems while gracefully handling DDoS issues. Meanwhile, Janus can reduce the route convergence within seconds under failure scenarios, which is orders of magnitude faster than existing approaches.
items.abstract_zh: 大型云提供商总是在互联网的对等边缘部署对等路由系统，以在云和互联网之间路由流量。传统的基于路由器的对等系统无法跟上快速变化的应用程序需求，而最近基于主机的方法不具有成本效益，并且难以解决来自互联网的恶意流量。在本文中，我们提倡采用全新的对等架构，在对等边缘引入可编程交换机。我们提出并实施了一个名为 Janus 的首创系统，可以同时处理入站和出站网络流量，并显着降低网络硬件成本。 Janus方法的核心是利用流量调度模块将大部分出站流量分流到交换机，以增强系统的可扩展性。 Janus将所有入站流量卸载到交换机，并将潜在的恶意流量重定向到反DDoS服务，以增强系统可靠性。此外，Janus引入了快速路由收敛机制，以有效处理互联网规模的路由更新。过去几年，我们逐渐在生产网络的边缘部署了 Janus。评估结果表明，与现有系统相比，Janus 可以将平均硬件成本降低 78%，同时妥善处理 DDoS 问题。同时，Janus 可以在故障情况下在几秒钟内减少路由收敛，这比现有方法快几个数量级。

items.title: A Composable Emulation Framework for Whitebox Switches.
items.abstract: High-fidelity network emulation is indispensable for reliable operation at scale. While existing emulators are built for monolithic, blackbox switches, emerging switch architectures are chipping away at this assumption. Cloud providers routinely source device modules from different vendors and compose them together to construct disaggregated, whitebox switches. This raises novel challenges in network emulation, as we must move from building bespoke firmware-based emulators to a composable emulation framework where diverse emulators can be stitched together for high-fidelity emulation: whether for data plane, control plane, or peripheral modules (e.g., optical components). We have designed the first such framework, MirSwitch, addressing key challenges in reconciling interface contract differences across emulator modules using an adaptor-centric approach. MirSwitch can faithfully emulate a wide range of functionalities of whitebox switches, while achieving 2.2× forwarding performance improvements which are critical for forwarding emulation. We have deployed MirSwitch in our production network, which our operators have used to troubleshoot 97.5% of a total of 203 issues in a recent year.
items.abstract_zh: 高保真网络仿真对于大规模可靠运行是必不可少的。虽然现有的仿真器是为单片、黑盒交换机构建的，但新兴的交换机架构正在削弱这一假设。云提供商通常会从不同供应商那里获取设备模块，并将它们组合在一起以构建分解的白盒交换机。这给网络仿真带来了新的挑战，因为我们必须从构建基于定制固件的仿真器转向可组合的仿真框架，在该框架中可以将不同的仿真器拼接在一起以进行高保真仿真：无论是数据平面、控制平面还是外围模块（例如光学组件）。我们设计了第一个此类框架 MirSwitch，解决了使用以适配器为中心的方法协调仿真器模块之间的接口契约差异的关键挑战。 MirSwitch 可以忠实地模拟白盒交换机的各种功能，同时实现 2.2 倍的转发性能改进，这对于转发模拟至关重要。我们在生产网络中部署了 MirSwitch，去年我们的运营商使用它解决了 203 个问题中的 97.5%。

items.title: Defeating Slow-and-Low Threats via Diffusion Model-based Generative Inference.
items.abstract: Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) are known to be vulnerable to slow-and-low threats that exploit trusted protocols while evading threshold-based defense at the edge. Our work addresses three limitations at edge defense: constrained resources, absence of a behavior monitor, and impractical assumptions for online detection. To defeat slow-and-low threats, we propose SketchVision , a vision-inspired detection framework that redefines flow behavior monitoring and attack detection under resource-constrained settings. We introduce a vision-inspired sketch that encodes packet-level temporal patterns of all flows into a compact image, a diffusion model tailored for sketch denoising, and a generative inference pipeline to forecast mature flow states from partial observations for early detection. Implemented with eBPF-enabled data planes and diffusion-based control, SketchVision achieves robust accuracy across 19 types of slow-and-low attacks, reaching an average AUC of 0.982 and F1 score of 0.913, improving detection by up to 29% over the state-of-the-art methods, while remaining efficient for large-scale CDN edge deployment.
items.abstract_zh: 众所周知，内容交付网络 (CDN) 很容易受到缓慢且低度的威胁的影响，这些威胁利用可信协议，同时规避边缘基于阈值的防御。我们的工作解决了边缘防御的三个限制：资源有限、缺乏行为监视器以及在线检测的不切实际的假设。为了战胜慢速和低速威胁，我们提出了 SketchVision，这是一种受视觉启发的检测框架，它重新定义了资源受限设置下的流行为监控和攻击检测。我们引入了一个受视觉启发的草图，将所有流的数据包级时间模式编码为紧凑的图像，一个为草图去噪量身定制的扩散模型，以及一个生成推理管道，用于根据部分观察预测成熟的流状态以进行早期检测。 SketchVision 通过支持 eBPF 的数据平面和基于扩散的控制来实现，在 19 种慢速和低速攻击中实现了强大的准确性，平均 AUC 为 0.982，F1 分数为 0.913，与最先进的方法相比，检测性能提高了 29%，同时保持大规模 CDN 边缘部署的效率。

items.title: Managing Congestion Control Heterogeneity on the Internet with Approximate Performance Isolation.
items.abstract: The Internet hosts a diverse mix of congestion control algorithms (CCAs) optimized for specific throughput-delay tradeoffs. However, traditional queuing disciplines and AQMs struggle to manage this heterogeneity and often lead to unfairness and suboptimal performance. In this paper, we explore isolation techniques that can allow competing CCAs to make their desired throughput-delay trade-offs independent of who they compete with. More specifically, we motivate Approximate Performance Isolation between competing flows by grouping flows with similar desired throughput-delay trade-offs in the same queue. We also present Santa, a new practical and scalable multi-queue AQM built on the principles of approximate performance isolation. Santa infers each flow’s throughput-delay preferences by comparing their buffer occupancy, and shuffles aggressive ("naughty") and passive ("nice") flows into appropriate queues over time. We prototype Santa on a programmable switch to demonstrate that it is practical, scalable, and can approximate the isolation benefits of Fair Queuing (FQ) with a handful of of queues.
items.abstract_zh: 互联网拥有多种拥塞控制算法 (CCA)，这些算法针对特定的吞吐量延迟权衡进行了优化。然而，传统的排队规则和 AQM 很难管理这种异质性，并且常常导致不公平和次优的性能。在本文中，我们探索了隔离技术，这些技术可以让竞争的 CCA 做出所需的吞吐量-延迟权衡，而与他们的竞争者无关。更具体地说，我们通过将具有相似的所需吞吐量延迟权衡的流分组到同一队列中来激励竞争流之间的近似性能隔离。我们还推出了 Santa，一种基于近似性能隔离原则构建的新型实用且可扩展的多队列 AQM。圣诞老人通过比较缓冲区占用率来推断每个流的吞吐量延迟偏好，并随着时间的推移将积极（“顽皮”）和被动（“好”）流洗牌到适当的队列中。我们在可编程交换机上对 Santa 进行原型设计，以证明它实用、可扩展，并且可以通过少量队列来近似公平队列 (FQ) 的隔离优势。

items.title: Eywa: Automating Model-Based Testing using LLMs.
items.abstract:
Model-based testing (MBT), whereby a model of the system under test is analyzed to generate high-coverage test cases, has been used to test protocol implementations. A key barrier to the use of MBT is the need for users to understand protocol RFCs in detail to create a compliant model.

Our new approach to MBT uses LLMs to automatically build rich models of intended protocol behavior from knowledge embedded in Request for Comments documents (RFCs), blogs, and other natural language sources. Our approach addresses key challenges with using LLMs, including hallucinations and their inability to monolithically generate complex protocol models. We realize our approach through a novel protocol testing framework EYWA, and demonstrate its effectiveness through extensive case studies of DNS and BGP, and a smaller study of SMTP. Despite minimal user effort, applying EYWA enabled the discovery of 33 unique bugs across widely used DNS, BGP, and SMTP implementations, 16 of which were previously undiscovered despite extensive prior testing with manually crafted models.
items.abstract_zh:
基于模型的测试（MBT）已被用于测试协议实现，通过该模型分析被测系统的模型以生成高覆盖率的测试用例。使用 MBT 的一个主要障碍是用户需要详细了解协议 RFC 以创建兼容模型。

我们的 MBT 新方法使用 LLM，根据征求意见文档 (RFC)、博客和其他自然语言源中嵌入的知识，自动构建丰富的预期协议行为模型。我们的方法解决了使用法学硕士的关键挑战，包括幻觉和它们无法整体生成复杂的协议模型。我们通过新颖的协议测试框架 EYWA 实现我们的方法，并通过 DNS 和 BGP 的广泛案例研究以及 SMTP 的小型研究证明其有效性。尽管用户付出的努力很少，但应用 EYWA 在广泛使用的 DNS、BGP 和 SMTP 实现中发现了 33 个独特的错误，其中 16 个错误以前未被发现，尽管之前使用手动制作的模型进行了广泛的测试。

items.title: FlexLLM: Token-Level Co-Serving of LLM Inference and Finetuning with SLO Guarantees.
items.abstract: Finetuning large language models (LLMs) is essential for task adaptation, yet today's serving stacks isolate inference and finetuning on separate GPU clusters—wasting resources and under-utilizing hardware. We introduce FlexLLM, the first system to co-serve LLM inference and PEFT-based finetuning on shared GPUs by fusing computation at the token level. FlexLLM's static compilation optimizations— dependent parallelization and graph pruning significantly shrink activation memory, leading to end-to-end GPU memory savings by up to 80%. At runtime, a novel token-level finetuning mechanism paired with a hybrid token scheduler dynamically interleaves inference and training tokens within each co-serving iteration, meeting strict latency SLOs while maximizing utilization. In end-to-end benchmarks on LLaMA-3.1-8B, Qwen-2.5-14B, and Qwen-2.5-32B, FlexLLM maintains inference SLO compliance at up to 20 req/s, and improves finetuning throughput by 1.9-4.8× under heavy inference workloads and 2.5-6.8× under light loads, preserving over 76% of peak finetuning progress even at peak demand. FlexLLM is publicly available at https://flexllm.github.io .
items.abstract_zh: 微调大型语言模型 (LLM) 对于任务适应至关重要，但当今的服务堆栈将推理和微调隔离在单独的 GPU 集群上，从而浪费资源且未充分利用硬件。我们推出了 FlexLLM，这是第一个通过在令牌级别融合计算来在共享 GPU 上共同提供 LLM 推理和基于 PEFT 的微调的系统。 FlexLLM 的静态编译优化——相关并行化和图形修剪显着缩小了激活内存，从而使端到端 GPU 内存节省高达 80%。在运行时，新颖的令牌级微调机制与混合令牌调度程序相结合，在每次协同服务迭代中动态交错推理和训练令牌，满足严格的延迟 SLO，同时最大限度地提高利用率。在 LLaMA-3.1-8B、Qwen-2.5-14B 和 Qwen-2.5-32B 的端到端基准测试中，FlexLLM 将推理 SLO 合规性维持在高达 20 req/s，并在重推理工作负载下将微调吞吐量提高了 1.9-4.8 倍，在轻负载下将微调吞吐量提高了 2.5-6.8 倍，即使在峰值时也能保持超过 76% 的峰值微调进度需求。 FlexLLM 可在 https://flexllm.github.io 上公开获取。

items.title: Syntra: Synthesizing Cross-Layer Controllers for Low-Latency Video Streaming.
items.abstract: Modern applications such as low-latency video streaming demand tight coordination across multiple control dimensions, including bitrate selection, congestion control, frame skipping, and forward error correction (FEC). These dimensions interact in complex ways, making existing heuristic approaches difficult to design, tune, and generalize. This paper presents Syntra, an automated tool that synthesizes joint controllers from a symbolic model of the system and a declarative performance objective. Syntra formulates control as a partially observable game, performs bounded-horizon minimax search (similar to Chess engines) to synthesize strategies, and distills them into an efficient, interpretable policy via imitation learning. Synthesized controllers incorporate novel strategies that exploit the synergy between control dimensions to consistently outperform existing designs in our evaluation.
items.abstract_zh: 低延迟视频流等现代应用需要跨多个控制维度的紧密协调，包括比特率选择、拥塞控制、跳帧和前向纠错 (FEC)。这些维度以复杂的方式相互作用，使得现有的启发式方法难以设计、调整和推广。本文介绍了 Syntra，这是一种自动化工具，可根据系统的符号模型和声明性性能目标合成联合控制器。 Syntra 将控制制定为部分可观察的游戏，执行有界极小极大搜索（类似于国际象棋引擎）来综合策略，并通过模仿学习将其提炼为高效、可解释的策略。综合控制器采用了新颖的策略，利用控制维度之间的协同作用，在我们的评估中始终优于现有设计。

items.title: SPLIDT: Partitioned Decision Trees for Scalable Stateful Inference at Line Rate.
items.abstract:
Machine learning (ML) is increasingly being deployed in programmable data planes (switches and SmartNICs) to enable real-time traffic analysis, security monitoring, and in-network decision-making. Decision trees (DTs) are particularly well-suited for these tasks due to their interpretability and compatibility with data-plane architectures, i.e., match-action tables (MATs). However, existing in-network DT implementations are constrained by the need to compute all input features upfront, forcing models to rely on a small, fixed set of features per flow. This significantly limits model accuracy and scalability under stringent hardware resource constraints.

We present SPLIDT, a system that rethinks DT deployment in the data plane by enabling partitioned inference over sliding windows of packets. SPLIDT introduces two key innovations: (1) it groups individual subtrees of a DT into partitions and allows each subtree to have its own feature set, and (2) it leverages an in-band control channel (via recirculation) to reuse data-plane resources (both stateful registers and match keys) across partitions at line rate. These insights allow SPLIDT to scale the number of stateful features a model can use without exceeding hardware limits. To support this architecture, SPLIDT incorporates a custom training and design-space exploration (DSE) framework that jointly optimizes feature allocation, tree partitioning, and DT model depth. Evaluation across multiple real-world datasets shows that SPLIDT achieves higher accuracy while supporting up to 5x more stateful features than prior approaches (e.g., NetBeacon and Leo). It maintains the same low time-to-detection (TTD) as these systems, while scaling to millions of flows with minimal recirculation overhead (≤ 0.05%).
items.abstract_zh:
机器学习 (ML) 越来越多地部署在可编程数据平面（交换机和 SmartNIC）中，以实现实时流量分析、安全监控和网络内决策。决策树（DT）由于其可解释性以及与数据平面架构（即匹配动作表（MAT））的兼容性而特别适合这些任务。然而，现有的网络内 DT 实现受到需要预先计算所有输入特征的限制，迫使模型依赖于每个流的一小部分固定特征。在严格的硬件资源限制下，这极大地限制了模型的准确性和可扩展性。

我们提出了 SPLIDT，这是一个通过在数据包滑动窗口上启用分区推理来重新思考数据平面中 DT 部署的系统。 SPLIDT 引入了两项关键创新：(1) 它将 DT 的各个子树分组为分区，并允许每个子树拥有自己的功能集，(2) 它利用带内控制通道（通过再循环）以线速跨分区重用数据平面资源（有状态寄存器和匹配密钥）。这些见解使 SPLIDT 能够在不超出硬件限制的情况下扩展模型可以使用的有状态特征的数量。为了支持该架构，SPLIDT 结合了自定义训练和设计空间探索 (DSE) 框架，该框架联合优化特征分配、树分区和 DT 模型深度。对多个真实世界数据集的评估表明，SPLIDT 实现了更高的准确度，同时支持的状态特征比之前的方法（例如 NetBeacon 和 Leo）多出 5 倍。它保持与这些系统相同的低检测时间 (TTD)，同时以最小的再循环开销 (≤ 0.05%) 扩展到数百万个流。

items.title: KRAKENGUARD: Towards Fine-Grained eBPF Isolation.
items.abstract:
eBPF is a powerful in-kernel virtual machine that enables dynamic, safe extensions to operating system kernels. Despite the guarantees provided by its in-kernel verifier, eBPF’s access control model remains coarse-grained, relying on broad Linux capabilities, such as CAP_BPF. Once granted, these allow unrestricted loading of eBPF programs to different kernel hooks. This poses serious security risks in multi-tenant or untrusted environments, where a compromised or malicious process can misuse eBPF to trace sensitive activity, access kernel memory, or disrupt system behavior. While existing verification ensures safety properties, it cannot enforce fine-grained constraints on what programs can do.

We present KRAKENGUARD, a trusted user-space manager that enforces fine-grained, policy-driven constraints on eBPF bytecode at load time. Using symbolic execution, it checks all program paths for compliance with policies on helper usage, memory accesses, and return values. It enables safe delegation of program loading by unprivileged processes and detects cross-program interference to ensure safe co-location of eBPF programs on the same host.

We show that KRAKENGUARD can block the misuse of restricted helpers, unauthorized memory and map access, and unsafe packet modifications in real-world eBPF programs, while also being able to detect existing CVEs. As a use case, we implement an XDP-as-a-Service application that securely runs XDP programs belonging to different tenants directly on the host interface after guaranteeing they cannot do anything malicious and that they do not interfere with each other.
items.abstract_zh:
eBPF 是一个功能强大的内核虚拟机，可以对操作系统内核进行动态、安全的扩展。尽管内核验证器提供了保证，但 eBPF 的访问控制模型仍然是粗粒度的，依赖于广泛的 Linux 功能，例如 CAP_BPF。一旦获得授权，它们就允许将 eBPF 程序不受限制地加载到不同的内核挂钩。这在多租户或不受信任的环境中带来了严重的安全风险，在这些环境中，受损或恶意进程可能会滥用 eBPF 来跟踪敏感活动、访问内核内存或破坏系统行为。虽然现有的验证可以确保安全属性，但它无法对程序可以执行的操作实施细粒度的限制。

我们推出了 KRAKENGUARD，这是一个值得信赖的用户空间管理器，它在加载时对 eBPF 字节码实施细粒度、策略驱动的约束。使用符号执行，它检查所有程序路径是否符合帮助程序使用、内存访问和返回值的策略。它支持非特权进程对程序加载的安全委托，并检测跨程序干扰，以确保 eBPF 程序在同一主机上安全共置。

我们证明 KRAKENGUARD 可以阻止对受限助手的滥用、未经授权的内存和映射访问以及现实世界 eBPF 程序中不安全的数据包修改，同时还能够检测现有的 CVE。作为一个用例，我们实现了一个 XDP 即服务应用程序，该应用程序在保证不同租户不会执行任何恶意行为并且不会相互干扰后，直接在主机接口上安全地运行属于不同租户的 XDP 程序。

items.title: KUBEDIRECT: Unleashing the Full Power of the Cluster Manager for Serverless Computing.
items.abstract:
FaaS platforms rely on cluster managers like Kubernetes for resource management. Kubernetes is popular due to its extensible state-centric APIs and modular architecture. However, to scale out a burst of FaaS instances, message passing becomes the primary bottleneck as controllers have to exchange extensive state through the API Server. Existing solutions opt for a clean-slate redesign of cluster managers, at the expense of ecosystem compatibility and substantial engineering effort.

We present KUBEDIRECT, a Kubernetes-based cluster manager for FaaS.
