We find that there exists a common narrow waist across FaaS platforms that allows us to achieve both efficiency and external compatibility. The narrow waist has a sequential structure that obviates the need for a single source of truth, allowing us to bypass the API Server and perform lightweight direct message passing. However, our approach introduces distributed and ephemeral state across controllers, making it challenging to enforce end-to-end semantics without centralized coordination. KUBEDIRECT performs novel state management that leverages the narrow waist as a hierarchical write-back cache , ensuring consistency and convergence to the desired state. KUBEDIRECT can seamlessly integrate with Kubernetes, adding ~150 LoC per controller. KUBEDIRECT can reduce serving latency by 26.7× over Knative, and has similar performance as the state-of-the-art clean-slate platform Dirigent.
items.abstract_zh:
FaaS 平台依赖 Kubernetes 等集群管理器进行资源管理。 Kubernetes 因其可扩展的以状态为中心的 API 和模块化架构而广受欢迎。然而，为了横向扩展 FaaS 实例的爆发，消息传递成为主要瓶颈，因为控制器必须通过 API Server 交换大量状态。现有的解决方案选择对集群管理器进行全新的重新设计，但牺牲了生态系统兼容性和大量的工程工作。

我们推出了 KUBEDIRECT，这是一个基于 Kubernetes 的 FaaS 集群管理器。我们发现FaaS平台之间存在一个共同的“窄腰”，使我们能够同时实现效率和外部兼容性。窄腰具有顺序结构，消除了对单一事实来源的需要，使我们能够绕过 API Server 并执行轻量级直接消息传递。然而，我们的方法在控制器之间引入了分布式和短暂的状态，使得在没有集中协调的情况下实施端到端语义变得具有挑战性。 KUBEDIRECT 执行新颖的状态管理，利用窄腰作为分层回写缓存，确保一致性和收敛到所需状态。 KUBEDIRECT 可以与 Kubernetes 无缝集成，为每个控制器添加约 150 个 LoC。 KUBEDIRECT can reduce serving latency by 26.7× over Knative, and has similar performance as the state-of-the-art clean-slate platform Dirigent.

items.title: Phantora: Maximizing Code Reuse in Simulation-based Machine Learning System Performance Estimation.
items.abstract:
Modern machine learning (ML) training workloads place substantial demands on both computational and communication resources. Consequently, accurate performance estimation has become increasingly critical for guiding system design decisions, such as the selection of parallelization strategies, cluster configurations, and hardware provisioning. Existing simulation-based performance estimation requires reimplementing the ML framework in a simulator, which demands significant manual effort and is hard to maintain as ML frameworks evolve rapidly.

This paper introduces Phantora, a hybrid GPU cluster simulator designed for performance estimation of ML training workloads. Phantora executes unmodified ML frameworks as is within a distributed, containerized environment. Each container emulates the behavior of a GPU server in a large-scale cluster, while Phantora intercepts and simulates GPU- and communication-related operations to provide high-fidelity performance estimation. We call this approach hybrid simulation of ML systems, in contrast to traditional methods that simulate static workloads. The primary advantage of hybrid simulation is that it allows direct reuse of ML framework source code in simulation, avoiding the need for reimplementation. Our evaluation shows that Phantora provides accuracy comparable to static workload simulation while supporting three state-of-the-art LLM training frameworks out-of-the-box. In addition, Phantora operates on a single GPU, eliminating the need for the resource-intensive trace collection and workload extraction steps required by traditional trace-based simulators. Phantora is open-sourced at https://github.com/QDelta/Phantora .
items.abstract_zh:
现代机器学习 (ML) 训练工作负载对计算和通信资源提出了大量要求。因此，准确的性能估计对于指导系统设计决策（例如并行化策略的选择、集群配置和硬件配置）变得越来越重要。现有的基于模拟的性能估计需要在模拟器中重新实现 ML 框架，这需要大量的手动工作，并且随着 ML 框架的快速发展而难以维护。

本文介绍了 Phantora，这是一种混合 GPU 集群模拟器，专为 ML 训练工作负载的性能评估而设计。 Phantora 在分布式容器化环境中执行未经修改的机器学习框架。每个容器模拟大规模集群中 GPU 服务器的行为，而 Phantora 拦截并模拟与 GPU 和通信相关的操作，以提供高保真性能估计。与模拟静态工作负载的传统方法相比，我们将这种方法称为机器学习系统的混合模拟。混合仿真的主要优点是它允许在仿真中直接重用 ML 框架源代码，从而避免重新实现的需要。我们的评估表明，Phantora 提供了与静态工作负载模拟相当的准确性，同时支持三种最先进的开箱即用的 LLM 培训框架。此外，Phantora 在单个 GPU 上运行，无需传统基于跟踪的模拟器所需的资源密集型跟踪收集和工作负载提取步骤。 Phantora 在 https://github.com/QDelta/Phantora 上开源。

items.title: Remembrall: Leaning into Memory for Accurate Video Analytics on System-on-Chip GPUs.
items.abstract: Continually retraining models has emerged as a primary technique to enable high-accuracy video analytics on edge devices. Yet, existing systems employ such adaptation by relying on the spare compute resources that traditional (memory-constrained) edge servers afford. In contrast, mobile edge devices such as drones and dashcams offer a fundamentally different resource profile: weak(er) compute with abundant unified memory pools. We present Remembrall, a continuous learning system for the mobile edge's System-on-Chip GPUs. Our driving insight is that visually distinct scenes that require retraining exhibit substantial overlap in model embeddings; if captured into a base model on device memory, specializing to each new scene can become lightweight, requiring very few samples. To practically realize this approach, Remembrall presents new, compute-efficient techniques to (1) select high-utility data samples for retraining specialized models, (2) update the base model without complete retraining, and (3) time-share compute resources between retraining and live inference for maximal accuracy. Across diverse workloads, Remembrall lowers retraining costs by 2.8-10× compared to existing systems, resulting in 18-45% higher accuracies.
items.abstract_zh: 持续再训练模型已成为在边缘设备上实现高精度视频分析的主要技术。然而，现有系统通过依赖传统（内存受限）边缘服务器提供的备用计算资源来采用这种适应。相比之下，无人机和行车记录仪等移动边缘设备提供了根本不同的资源配置：具有丰富的统一内存池的弱计算。我们推出了 Remembrall，这是一种用于移动边缘片上系统 GPU 的持续学习系统。我们的深刻见解是，需要重新训练的视觉上不同的场景在模型嵌入中表现出大量重叠；如果捕获到设备内存上的基本模型中，则专门针对每个新场景可以变得轻量级，只需要很少的样本。为了实际实现这种方法，Remembrall 提出了新的、计算高效的技术，以 (1) 选择高实用性数据样本来重新训练专用模型，(2) 在不完全重新训练的情况下更新基础模型，以及 (3) 在重新训练和实时推理之间分时共享计算资源，以实现最大准确度。在不同的工作负载中，与现有系统相比，Remembrall 将再训练成本降低了 2.8-10 倍，从而将准确率提高了 18-45%。

items.title: Iris: Expressive Traffic Analysis for the Modern Internet.
items.abstract: In this work, we investigate the needs of modern traffic analysis, and we introduce Iris, a framework for efficiently building complex, high-performance traffic analysis applications. Iris's key contribution is a compiler that transforms user-defined traffic filters, stream transformations, and computation written in Rust into an optimized processing pipeline. The Iris compiler eliminates redundant logic across analysis tasks to generate a unified runtime that minimizes aggregate work, allowing it to scale to hundreds of concurrent workloads. Rather than restricting users to a domain-specific query language, Iris provides a flexible development environment by exposing connection- and application-layer semantics as Rust data types to user-defined functions. We show that Iris can execute hundreds of analysis tasks concurrently at 100Gbps+ on a single commodity server, and we demonstrate its flexibility through three use cases drawn from prior work.
items.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究了现代流量分析的需求，并介绍了 Iris，一个用于高效构建复杂、高性能流量分析应用程序的框架。 Iris 的主要贡献是一个编译器，它将用户定义的流量过滤器、流转换和用 Rust 编写的计算转换为优化的处理管道。 Iris 编译器消除了分析任务之间的冗余逻辑，以生成统一的运行时，最大限度地减少聚合工作，使其能够扩展到数百个并发工作负载。 Iris 没有将用户限制为特定于域的查询语言，而是通过将连接层和应用程序层语义作为 Rust 数据类型公开给用户定义的函数，提供了灵活的开发环境。我们展示了 Iris 可以在单个商用服务器上以 100Gbps+ 的速度同时执行数百个分析任务，并且我们通过从先前工作中提取的三个用例展示了其灵活性。

items.title: Cortex: Achieving Low-Latency, Cost-Efficient Remote Data Access For LLM via Semantic-Aware Knowledge Caching.
items.abstract:
Large Language Model (LLM) agents tackle data-intensive tasks such as deep research and code generation. However, their effectiveness depends on frequent interactions with knowledge sources across remote clouds or regions. Such interactions can create non-trivial latency and cost bottlenecks. Existing caching solutions focus on exact-match queries, limiting their effectiveness for semantic knowledge reuse.

To address this challenge, we introduce Cortex, a novel cross-region knowledge caching architecture for LLM agents. At its core are two abstractions: Semantic Element (SE) and Semantic Retrieval Index (Seri). A semantic element captures the semantic embedding representation of an LLM query together with performance-aware metadata such as latency, cost, and staticity. Seri then provides two-stage retrieval: a vector similar index with semantic embedding for fast candidate selection and a lightweight LLM-powered semantic judger for precise validation. Atop these primitives, Cortex builds a new cache interface that includes a new semantic-aware cache hit definition, a cost-efficient eviction policy, and proactive prefetching. To reduce overhead, Cortex co-locates the small LLM judger with the main LLM using adaptive scheduling and resource sharing. Our evaluation demonstrates that Cortex delivers substantial performance improvements without compromising correctness. On representative search workloads, Cortex achieves up to a 3.6× increase in throughput by maintaining cache hit rates of over 85×, while preserving accuracy virtually identical to non-cached baselines. Cortex also improves throughput for coding tasks by 20×, showcasing its versatility across diverse agentic workloads.
items.abstract_zh:
大型语言模型 (LLM) 代理处理数据密集型任务，例如深入研究和代码生成。然而，它们的有效性取决于与远程云或区域的知识源的频繁交互。此类交互可能会造成严重的延迟和成本瓶颈。现有的缓存解决方案侧重于精确匹配查询，限制了其语义知识重用的有效性。

为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了 Cortex，一种用于 LLM 代理的新型跨区域知识缓存架构。其核心是两个抽象：语义元素（SE）和语义检索索引（Seri）。语义元素捕获 LLM 查询的语义嵌入表示以及性能感知元数据（例如延迟、成本和静态性）。然后，Seri 提供两阶段检索：带有语义嵌入的向量相似索引，用于快速候选选择，以及由 LLM 支持的轻量级语义判断器，用于精确验证。在这些原语之上，Cortex 构建了一个新的缓存接口，其中包括新的语义感知缓存命中定义、经济高效的驱逐策略和主动预取。为了减少开销，Cortex 使用自适应调度和资源共享将小型 LLM 判断器与主 LLM 放在一起。我们的评估表明，Cortex 在不影响正确性的情况下提供了显着的性能改进。在代表性搜索工作负载上，Cortex 通过保持超过 85 倍的缓存命中率，同时保持与非缓存基线几乎相同的精度，将吞吐量提高了 3.6 倍。 Cortex 还将编码任务的吞吐量提高了 20 倍，展示了其在不同代理工作负载中的多功能性。

items.title: Libra: Flexible Request Partitioning and Scheduling for Serving Unbalanced and Dynamic LLM Workloads.
items.abstract:
LLM inference must meet strict latency SLOs while maximizing throughput. Yet, real-world variability in prompt and response lengths skews compute-intensive prefill and memory-bound decode phases, making both colocated (even with chunked prefill) and disaggregated deployments unable to simultaneously deliver low tail latency and high throughput.

We introduce Libra, a high performance LLM serving system that maximizes goodput under SLO constraints even when handling imbalanced and dynamic workloads. At the core of Libra is a micro-request based flexible partitioning and scheduling (FPS) abstraction. The abstraction splits each request at any token boundary into multiple cooperating segments. Libra then designs a two-level scheduling framework that balances micro-request load across unified GPU instances. The framework consists of a global scheduler that selects per-request split points, and a local scheduler on each GPU instance to form SLO-aware batches. Finally, Libra uses chunked KV cache transfers to support cross-instance micro-request execution. On real-world traces, Libra improves goodput by up to 1.91× and 1.61×, increases serving capacity from 1.15× to 3.07×, and improves serving performance by up to 74.2% in a hybrid workload under strict SLOs and A100/H100 GPUs compared to state-of-the-art colocated and disaggregated baselines.
items.abstract_zh:
LLM 推理必须满足严格的延迟 SLO，同时最大化吞吐量。然而，现实世界中提示和响应长度的变化会影响计算密集型预填充和内存限制的解码阶段，使得共置（即使使用分块预填充）和分解部署无法同时提供低尾部延迟和高吞吐量。

我们推出 Libra，这是一种高性能 LLM 服务系统，即使在处理不平衡和动态工作负载时，也能在 SLO 约束下最大化吞吐量。 Libra 的核心是基于微请求的灵活分区和调度（FPS）抽象。该抽象将任意令牌边界处的每个请求拆分为多个协作段。然后，Libra 设计了一个两级调度框架，用于平衡统一 GPU 实例之间的微请求负载。该框架由一个全局调度程序（选择每个请求的分割点）和每个 GPU 实例上的本地调度程序（用于形成 SLO 感知批次）组成。最后，Libra 使用分块 KV 缓存传输来支持跨实例微请求执行。在实际跟踪中，与最先进的共置和分解基线相比，Libra 将吞吐量提高了高达 1.91 倍和 1.61 倍，将服务容量从 1.15 倍提高到 3.07 倍，并在严格的 SLO 和 A100/H100 GPU 下的混合工作负载中将服务性能提高了高达 74.2%。

items.title: Wallet: Confidential Serverless Computing.
items.abstract:
Although serverless computing offers compelling cost and deployment simplicity advantages, a significant challenge remains in securely managing sensitive data as it flows through the network of ephemeral function executions in serverless computing environments within untrusted clouds. While Confidential Virtual Machines (CVMs) offer a promising secure execution environment, their integration with serverless architectures currently faces fundamental limitations in key areas: security , performance , and resource efficiency .

We present WALLET, a lightweight confidential computing system for secure serverless deployments. By employing nested confidential execution and a decoupled guest OS within CVMs, WALLET runs each function in a minimal "trustlet", significantly improving security through a reduced Trusted Computing Base (TCB). Furthermore, by leveraging a data-centric I/O architecture built upon a lightweight LibOS, WALLET optimizes network communication to address performance and resource efficiency challenges.

Our evaluation shows that compared to CVM-based deployments, WALLET has a 4.3× smaller TCB, improves end-to-end latency (15–93%), achieves higher function density (up to 907×), and reduces inter-function communication (up to 27×) and function chaining latency (16.7-30.2×); thus, WALLET offers a practical system design for confidential serverless computing.
items.abstract_zh:
尽管无服务器计算提供了令人信服的成本和部署简单性优势，但当敏感数据流经不受信任的云中的无服务器计算环境中的临时功能执行网络时，安全管理敏感数据仍然存在重大挑战。虽然机密虚拟机 (CVM) 提供了一个有前途的安全执行环境，但它们与无服务器架构的集成目前在安全、性能和资源效率等关键领域面临根本限制。

我们推出了 WALLET，这是一种用于安全无服务器部署的轻量级机密计算系统。通过在 CVM 内采用嵌套机密执行和解耦来宾操作系统，WALLET 在最小的“trustlet”中运行每个功能，通过减少可信计算基础 (TCB) 显着提高安全性。此外，通过利用基于轻量级 LibOS 构建的以数据为中心的 I/O 架构，WALLET 优化了网络通信，以应对性能和资源效率挑战。

我们的评估表明，与基于 CVM 的部署相比，WALLET 的 TCB 减小了 4.3 倍，改善了端到端延迟（15-93%），实现了更高的功能密度（高达 907 倍），并减少了功能间通信（高达 27 倍）和功能链延迟（16.7-30.2 倍）；因此，WALLET 为机密无服务器计算提供了实用的系统设计。

items.title: PD3: Prefetching Data with DPUs for Disaggregated Memory.
items.abstract: We introduce PD3, a memory disaggregation solution that "avoids" cache misses, via prefetching, on compute servers and thus all their associated overhead. Unlike a traditional prefetcher that may pollute the cache or miss preloading opportunities due to false positives and false negatives, PD3 prevents mis-predictions with network support and minimal yet critical application information. Enabling PD3 is data processing units or DPUs, which allow (1) parsing user requests before they are processed by the compute server, (2) fetching data from remote memory on the shortest path, (3) offloading expensive RDMA and DMA operations from the host, and (4) incorporating application knowledge to faithfully predict cache misses and take actions accordingly. Designing PD3 requires reconciling DPU resource constraints and scaling requirements of cloud data systems, as well as achieving high efficiency with a myriad of performance optimizations. Our experimental results on real hardware, applications, and workloads show that with nominal compute-local memory, PD3 eliminates the performance gap between memory-disaggregated applications and their monolithic counterparts.
items.abstract_zh: 我们引入 PD3，这是一种内存分解解决方案，可通过预取在计算服务器上“避免”缓存缺失，从而避免所有相关开销。传统的预取器可能会污染缓存或因误报和漏报而错过预加载机会，而 PD3 与此不同，PD3 通过网络支持和最少但关键的应用程序信息来防止错误预测。支持 PD3 的是数据处理单元或 DPU，它允许 (1) 在计算服务器处理用户请求之前解析用户请求，(2) 以最短路径从远程内存获取数据，(3) 从主机卸载昂贵的 RDMA 和 DMA 操作，以及 (4) 结合应用程序知识来准确预测缓存未命中并采取相应措施。设计PD3需要协调DPU资源限制和云数据系统的扩展要求，并通过无数的性能优化来实现高效率。我们对真实硬件、应用程序和工作负载的实验结果表明，使用标称计算本地内存，PD3 消除了内存分解应用程序与其整体对应应用程序之间的性能差距。

items.title: Towards Performance Robustness for Microservices.
items.abstract:
Microservices are foundational to modern distributed applications, enabling modular design and scalability. However, they face performance variability due to environmental factors like workload burstiness, resource contention, and shared dependencies. Existing microservice controllers, such as autoscalers and admission controllers, struggle to ensure good performance, often causing several Service Level Objective (SLO) violations. We argue that this is because controller decision-making is uninformed, lacking guidance about robustness to environmental factors.

We propose the concept of run-time "performance robustness certificates" (PERCs) to address this limitation. A PERC provides statistical bounds on tail latencies of specific request types under a range of environmental perturbations. We show how to leverage a queueing-theoretic model of microservice performance to quickly derive actionable {PeRC}s. We introduce Galileo, a framework that integrates PERCs with two state-of-the-art learned controllers to guide robust actions toward meeting SLOs. Experimental results with real-world benchmarks validate the effectiveness of PERCs in ensuring robust microservice performance.
items.abstract_zh:
微服务是现代分布式应用程序的基础，支持模块化设计和可扩展性。然而，由于工作负载突发性、资源争用和共享依赖性等环境因素，它们面临着性能变化。现有的微服务控制器（例如自动缩放器和准入控制器）很难确保良好的性能，通常会导致多次违反服务级别目标 (SLO)。我们认为这是因为控制器决策不知情，缺乏对环境因素稳健性的指导。

我们提出运行时“性能稳健性证书”（PERC）的概念来解决这一限制。 PERC 提供了在一系列环境扰动下特定请求类型的尾部延迟的统计界限。我们展示了如何利用微服务性能的排队理论模型来快速导出可操作的 {PeRC}。我们引入了 Galileo，这是一个将 PERC 与两个最先进的学习控制器集成在一起的框架，以指导实现 SLO 的稳健行动。真实世界基准的实验结果验证了 PERC 在确保稳健的微服务性能方面的有效性。

items.title: EZ-SAVE: Evaluation of Easy-to-Deploy Source Address Validation Policies.
items.abstract:
The lack of Source Address Validation (SAV) is a significant vulnerability of the Internet, which is abused in many Denial-of-Service (DoS) and other attacks. Several IETF RFCs define easy-to-deploy, non-interactive SAV designs ; the IETF is currently developing another SAV mechanism, BAR-SAV, which, as its name suggests, uses B GP, A SPA (Autonomous System Provider Authorization), and R OA (Route Origin Authorization) data. However, no comparative evaluation of the potential impact of their large-scale deployment has been done. A recent survey of network vendors and operators indicates that more efficacy data and usage guidelines are necessary to motivate their adoption.

We present EZ-SAVE , the first simulation-based analysis evaluating easy-to-deploy SAV policies. We measure both the spoofed traffic detection rates and the legitimate traffic filtering (false-positive) rates for each standard and proposed design at different adoption rates, using a realistic Internet topology and traffic engineering policies. Our results reveal several significant insights that may assist and guide the standardization process as well as developers and operators. In particular, we find that BAR-SAV proves to be the most effective design that features high spoof detection rates and low (or even zero) false-positive rates, motivating its standardization and deployment. Our results also provide operators with guidance on other SAV mechanisms that are effective for specific scenarios. In addition, our results highlight the importance of using realistic export policies for SAV evaluation.
items.abstract_zh:
缺乏源地址验证 (SAV) 是互联网的一个重大漏洞，在许多拒绝服务 (DoS) 和其他攻击中被滥用。多个 IETF RFC 定义了易于部署的非交互式 SAV 设计； IETF目前正在开发另一种SAV机制BAR-SAV，顾名思义，它使用B GP、A SPA（自治系统提供商授权）和ROA（路由起源授权）数据。然而，尚未对其大规模部署的潜在影响进行比较评估。最近对网络供应商和运营商的一项调查表明，需要更多的功效数据和使用指南来推动其采用。

我们推出 EZ-SAVE，这是第一个基于模拟的分析，评估易于部署的 SAV 策略。我们使用现实的互联网拓扑和流量工程策略，测量不同采用率下每个标准和建议设计的欺骗流量检测率和合法流量过滤（误报）率。我们的结果揭示了一些重要的见解，可以帮助和指导标准化过程以及开发人员和运营商。特别是，我们发现 BAR-SAV 被证明是最有效的设计，具有高欺骗检测率和低（甚至零）误报率，从而推动了其标准化和部署。我们的结果还为运营商提供了针对特定场景有效的其他 SAV 机制的指导。此外，我们的结果凸显了使用现实的出口政策进行 SAV 评估的重要性。

items.title: Queue-Mem: Energy-Efficient Hardware Storage for Advanced Network Function Acceleration.
items.abstract:
General-purpose CPU servers have been widely used to deploy Network Functions (NFs) thanks to their high flexibility and simplicity of deployment. Due to their high energy consumption, best practices advocate for only processing packet headers on CPU cores while temporary storing the corresponding packet payloads on either network interface cards or external RDMA-enabled memory.

We show that the seemingly minor decision of where to store a packet payload greatly impacts overall energy consumption in state-of-the-art NF systems operating at terabit-per-second speeds. In fact, we show that if one could ideally store packet payloads on today's hardware switches , while processing headers externally, one could reduce energy use by 1.8× to 10.9× compared to current practices.

In this paper, we introduce Queue-Mem, a general-purpose, energy-efficient storage solution to enhance NF deployment that is amenable for implementation with various existing hardware switches. Building Queue-Mem involves addressing significant challenges associated with payload storage, as hardware switches lack such functionality. By carefully exploiting the buffer queues of existing switches, we are the first ones to build and showcase a robust, energy-efficient packet processing pipeline capable of handling terabit-per-second speeds and supporting advanced per-flow network functions, all while using just a single commodity server connected to an ASIC switch.
items.abstract_zh:
通用CPU服务器因其高度灵活性和部署简单性而被广泛用于部署网络功能（NF）。由于能耗较高，最佳实践主张仅在 CPU 内核上处理数据包标头，同时将相应的数据包有效负载临时存储在网络接口卡或支持 RDMA 的外部内存上。

我们表明，在以每秒太比特的速度运行的最先进的 NF 系统中，存储数据包有效负载的位置看似很小的决定会极大地影响整体能耗。事实上，我们表明，如果能够在当今的硬件交换机上理想地存储数据包有效负载，同时在外部处理标头，则与当前实践相比，可以将能源消耗减少 1.8 倍至 10.9 倍。

在本文中，我们介绍了 Queue-Mem，这是一种通用、节能的存储解决方案，用于增强 NF 部署，适合使用各种现有硬件交换机实施。构建队列内存涉及解决与有效负载存储相关的重大挑战，因为硬件交换机缺乏此类功能。通过仔细利用现有交换机的缓冲队列，我们​​率先构建并展示了强大、节能的数据包处理管道，能够处理太比特每秒的速度并支持高级的每流网络功能，同时仅使用连接到 ASIC 交换机的单个商用服务器。

items.title: Count-Based Abstractions for Performance Verification of Contention Points.
items.abstract: Networking researchers and engineers spend much of their time trying to understand the performance of contention points – network components where multiple incoming packet streams share the same outgoing link(s). Recently, researchers have developed new logical models for analyzing such contention points, but unfortunately, such models are expensive: They do not scale well as buffer capacities increase beyond 10s of packets, making it difficult or impossible to reason about real-world systems faithfully. In this paper, we develop a suite of effective, new abstractions for reasoning about buffers and their performance characteristics. We also show how to architect a performance analysis framework for contention points in a modular way so it can take advantage of a range of abstractions that trade performance off against precision. We evaluate our abstractions against a collection of benchmarks and demonstrate their scaling benefits.
items.abstract_zh: 网络研究人员和工程师花费大量时间试图了解争用点的性能，即多个传入数据包流共享相同传出链路的网络组件。最近，研究人员开发了新的逻辑模型来分析此类争用点，但不幸的是，此类模型非常昂贵：当缓冲区容量增加到超过 10 个数据包时，它们就无法很好地扩展，从而很难或不可能忠实地推理现实世界的系统。在本文中，我们开发了一套有效的新抽象来推理缓冲区及其性能特征。我们还展示了如何以模块化方式构建针对争用点的性能分析框架，以便它可以利用一系列在性能与精度之间进行权衡的抽象。我们根据一系列基准评估我们的抽象，并展示它们的扩展优势。

items.title: Predict, Prune, Play: Efficient Video Playback Optimization Under Device Diversity and Drift.
items.abstract:
Video-streaming platforms tune dozens of playback parameters across thousands of client devices. Our measurements from Amazon Prime Video show that device-specific tuning can enhance stream quality. Yet traditional tuning techniques like Bayesian optimization become prohibitively expensive due to the large configuration space and the constant emergence of new device types.

We introduce AZEEM, a scalable recommendation system leveraging few-shot prediction to rapidly identify promising configurations for new devices. The key insight behind AZEEM is that devices exhibit performance similarities that enable predictions from limited observations. Trained on offline data of device-playback configuration interactions, AZEEM efficiently narrows down the search space to a small set of configurations likely to contain optimal or near-optimal candidates. Additionally, AZEEM addresses temporal distribution shift—where the best-performing configurations change over time—by recommending a small, robust set of candidates rather than a single configuration. Evaluations using large-scale real-world datasets show that AZEEM reduces exploration cost by 5.8−13.6× and improves stream quality compared to state-of-the-art Bayesian optimization and multi-armed bandit approaches, enabling effective device-specific optimization at scale. We deploy AZEEM on a subset of Amazon Prime Video’s production traffic, where it achieved a relative QoE improvement of 2.7% on average and 10.6% at the 90th percentile over an existing treatment tuning system.
items.abstract_zh:
视频流平台可在数千个客户端设备上调整数十个播放参数。我们对 Amazon Prime Video 的测量表明，特定于设备的调整可以提高流媒体质量。然而，由于配置空间较大和新设备类型的不断出现，贝叶斯优化等传统调整技术变得异常昂贵。

我们推出了 AZEEM，这是一种可扩展的推荐系统，利用少量预测来快速识别新设备的有前景的配置。 AZEEM 背后的关键见解是，设备表现出相似的性能，可以根据有限的观察进行预测。通过设备播放配置交互的离线数据进行训练，AZEEM 有效地将搜索空间缩小到可能包含最佳或接近最佳候选的一小组配置。此外，AZEEM 通过推荐一组小型、稳健的候选配置而不是单一配置来解决时间分布变化（即性能最佳配置随时间变化）。使用大规模现实世界数据集的评估表明，与最先进的贝叶斯优化和多臂老虎机方法相比，AZEEM 将探索成本降低了 5.8−13.6 倍，并提高了流质量，从而实现了大规模的有效的特定于设备的优化。我们在 Amazon Prime Video 制作流量的一个子集上部署了 AZEEM，与现有的处理调整系统相比，它的 QoE 平均提高了 2.7%，在第 90 个百分点上提高了 10.6%。

items.title: XLL: Cross-Layer Logging for Data Deduplication in Consensus-Based Storage.
items.abstract: Modern distributed storage systems exhibit cross-layer data duplication, writing data to disk once during a consensus phase and again during a local database logging phase. The result is poor performance and significant write amplification. To remedy this cross-layer redundancy, we design and implement Cross-Layer Log (XLL), a shared log built upon the principle of key-value separation. We use XLL to deduplicate updates within a distributed key-value store (TiKV), leading to a 5.5x increase in write throughput while reducing write amplification by 73%. We also demonstrate the effectiveness of our crash recovery protocol in maintaining data integrity.
items.abstract_zh: 现代分布式存储系统表现出跨层数据复制，在共识阶段将数据写入磁盘一次，在本地数据库日志记录阶段再次将数据写入磁盘。结果是性能不佳并且写入放大显着。为了弥补这种跨层冗余，我们设计并实现了跨层日志（XLL），这是一种基于键值分离原则构建的共享日志。我们使用 XLL 对分布式键值存储 (TiKV) 中的更新进行重复数据删除，从而使写入吞吐量提高 5.5 倍，同时将写入放大减少 73%。我们还展示了我们的崩溃恢复协议在维护数据完整性方面的有效性。

items.title: Mortise: Auto-tuning Congestion Control to Optimize QoE via Network-Aware Parameter Optimization.
items.abstract: Congestion control algorithms (CCAs) critically shape the tradeoff among throughput, latency, and loss, directly impacting user Quality of Experience (QoE). However, most existing CCAs use static, heuristically chosen parameter settings that fail to adapt to dynamic network states, resulting in suboptimal QoE. Our key observation is that the optimal CCA parameter configuration depends on real-time network states. To bridge this gap, we propose Mortise, a real-time, network-aware adaptation framework that dynamically tunes rule-based CCA parameters to maximize QoE. To address the challenges in modeling the complex parameter-QoE relationship, Mortise introduces a QoS tradeoff proxy to decompose parameter optimization into two steps: it first infers the application's preferred QoS tradeoff from real-time QoE gradients and then derives the corresponding parameter settings via control-theoretic analysis. Implemented atop TCP and evaluated in both emulated and production environments, Mortise outperforms state-of-the-art solutions, enhancing the QoE of file downloading service by up to 73% and QoE of video streaming service by up to 167% in real-world scenarios, with minimal deployment overhead.
items.abstract_zh: 拥塞控制算法 (CCA) 至关重要地影响吞吐量、延迟和丢失之间的权衡，直接影响用户体验质量 (QoE)。然而，大多数现有 CCA 使用静态、启发式选择的参数设置，无法适应动态网络状态，导致 QoE 不佳。我们的主要观察结果是，最佳 CCA 参数配置取决于实时网络状态。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了 Mortise，这是一种实时、网络感知的适应框架，可以动态调整基于规则的 CCA 参数以最大化 QoE。为了解决复杂参数-QoE关系建模的挑战，Mortise引入了QoS权衡代理，将参数优化分解为两个步骤：首先从实时QoE梯度推断应用程序的首选QoS权衡，然后通过控制理论分析得出相应的参数设置。 Mortise 在 TCP 之上实施，并在模拟和生产环境中进行评估，其性能优于最先进的解决方案，在现实场景中将文件下载服务的 QoE 提高高达 73%，将视频流服务的 QoE 提高高达 167%，同时部署开销极低。

items.title: Law: Towards Consistent Low Latency in 802.11 Home Networks.
items.abstract: Wireless ultra-low-latency video streaming over 802.11 WiFi networks is increasingly popular, but the latency on the Wi-Fi link is always fluctuating. With the development of CDNs and edge servers, the fluctuation of the wireless lasthop is increasingly dominating the fluctuation of the end-toend latency. In this paper, we investigate the reasons why the existing Wi-Fi link layer will have a fluctuating latency from a systematic perspective. We find that the hierarchical queueing structure, queue-agnostic rate adaptation, and delay-insensitive retry management of the existing link layer design are the main reasons to a latency spike when channel fluctuates. Thus, we propose LAtency-bounded Wi-Fi (Law), an 802.11 link layer architecture to provide a consistent low latency for the application. Law exploits the loss tolerance ability from the upper layer video streaming application and significantly avoids the latency spikes caused by the blockage in the link layer at the cost of acceptably additional packet loss. Law maintains a high goodput by carefully redesigning the queueing structure and introducing fine-grained control for each transmission opportunity. We implement the prototype of Law on OpenWiFi and test it with WebRTC – both the tail frame latency and stall rate can be significantly reduced over existing baselines.
items.abstract_zh: 通过 802.11 WiFi 网络的无线超低延迟视频流越来越受欢迎，但 Wi-Fi 链路上的延迟始终在波动。随着CDN和边缘服务器的发展，无线最后一站的波动越来越主导端到端延迟的波动。在本文中，我们从系统角度探讨了现有Wi-Fi链路层时延波动的原因。我们发现现有链路层设计的分层排队结构、与队列无关的速率自适应和对延迟不敏感的重试管理是通道波动时出现延迟峰值的主要原因。因此，我们提出了 LAtency-bounded Wi-Fi（Law），这是一种 802.11 链路层架构，可为应用程序提供一致的低延迟。 Law利用了上层视频流应用程序的丢包能力，并以可接受的额外数据包丢失为代价，显着避免了链路层阻塞引起的延迟峰值。 Law 通过仔细地重新设计排队结构并为每个传输机会引入细粒度控制来保持高吞吐量。我们在 OpenWiFi 上实现了 Law 的原型，并使用 WebRTC 对其进行了测试——尾帧延迟和停顿率都比现有基线显着降低。

items.title: BURST: Seeking High-performance, Interoperability and Scalability in Soft-RDMA.
items.abstract:
Modern data centers deploy heterogeneous server pods, including a mix of commercial RDMA NICs (RNICs), legacy Ethernet NICs, and custom in-house hardware. This diversity creates significant interoperability challenges, particularly for Non-RNIC-to-RNIC (NR2R) communication, a scenario driven by emerging disaggregated workloads like LLM inference, large-scale infrastructure upgrades, and the integration of novel network protocols. Due to strict hardware dependencies, RNICs discard packets from non-compliant packets, forcing a costly fallback to TCP/IP and limiting RDMA network scaling. Existing software RDMA solutions, RXE (SoftRoCE implementation in Linux kernel), suffer from prohibitive CPU overhead, making them unsuitable for high-speed networks.

To address this, we present BURST, a high-performance, user-space software RDMA stack designed for high-speed networks. BURST operates as an independent process that maintains full compatibility with the standard RDMA Verbs API, allowing unmodified applications to run on Ethernet NICs. It integrates a lock-free DPDK data plane for line-rate packet processing, leverages Intel's DSA for reducing CPU, and features a kernel-bypass connection manager to accelerate setup. Experimental results show that BURST achieves 98.7% line-rate bandwidth on 400G NICs, delivering a 3.2-6.3x throughput improvement over kernel RXE. In production workloads, BURST accelerates LLM inference latency to 25.2% of TCP's and increases connection setup speeds by 12x compared to native RDMA CM, demonstrating its benefits for unifying communication in heterogeneous environments.
items.abstract_zh:
现代数据中心部署异构服务器单元，包括商业 RDMA NIC (RNIC)、传统以太网 NIC 和自定义内部硬件的组合。这种多样性带来了重大的互操作性挑战，特别是对于非 RNIC 到 RNIC (NR2R) 通信，这是由新兴的分类工作负载（如 LLM 推理、大规模基础设施升级和新颖网络协议的集成）驱动的场景。由于严格的硬件依赖性，RNIC 会丢弃不合规数据包中的数据包，迫使成本高昂的回退到 TCP/IP，并限制 RDMA 网络扩展。现有的软件 RDMA 解决方案 RXE（Linux 内核中的 SoftRoCE 实现）的 CPU 开销过高，使其不适合高速网络。

为了解决这个问题，我们推出了 BURST，这是一种专为高速网络设计的高性能用户空间软件 RDMA 堆栈。 BURST 作为独立进程运行，与标准 RDMA Verbs API 保持完全兼容，允许未经修改的应用程序在以太网 NIC 上运行。它集成了用于线速数据包处理的无锁 DPDK 数据平面，利用英特尔的 DSA 来减少 CPU 占用，并具有内核旁路连接管理器来加速设置。实验结果表明，BURST 在 400G NIC 上实现了 98.7% 的线速带宽，吞吐量比内核 RXE 提高了 3.2-6.3 倍。在生产工作负载中，与本机 RDMA CM 相比，BURST 将 LLM 推理延迟加速至 TCP 的 25.2%，并将连接设置速度提高了 12 倍，展示了其在异构环境中统一通信的优势。

items.title: SYMI: Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training via Model and Optimizer State Decoupling.
items.abstract:
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become a widely-adopted solution to continue scaling model sizes without a corresponding linear increase in compute. During MoE model training, each input token is dynamically routed to a subset of experts—sparsely-activated feed-forward networks—within each transformer layer. The distribution of tokens assigned to each expert varies widely and rapidly over the course of training. To handle the wide load imbalance across experts, current systems are forced to either drop tokens assigned to popular experts, degrading convergence, or frequently rebalance resources allocated to each expert based on popularity, incurring high state migration overheads.

To break this performance-accuracy tradeoff, we introduce SYMI, an adaptive MoE training system. The key insight of SYMI is to decouple the placement of expert parameters from their large optimizer state. SYMI statically partitions the optimizer of each expert across all training nodes. Meanwhile, SYMI dynamically adjusts the placement of expert parameters by repurposing existing weight updates, avoiding migration overheads. In doing so, SYMI right-sizes the GPU resources allocated to each expert, on a per-iteration basis, with minimal overhead. Compared to state-of-the-art MoE training systems, DeepSpeed and FlexMoE, SYMI is able to achieve a 30.5% and 25.9% faster time-to-convergence, respectively.
items.abstract_zh:
专家混合 (MoE) 模型已成为一种广泛采用的解决方案，可在不相应线性增加计算量的情况下继续扩展模型大小。在 MoE 模型训练期间，每个输入令牌都会动态路由到每个变压器层内的专家子集（稀疏激活的前馈网络）。在训练过程中，分配给每位专家的令牌分布变化很大且迅速。为了处理专家之间广泛的负载不平衡问题，当前系统被迫放弃分配给热门专家的令牌，从而降低收敛性，或者根据受欢迎程度频繁重新平衡分配给每个专家的资源，从而产生高昂的状态迁移开销。

为了打破这种性能与准确性的权衡，我们引入了 SYMI，一种自适应 MoE 训练系统。 SYMI 的关键见解是将专家参数的放置与其大型优化器状态分离。 SYMI 在所有训练节点上静态划分每个专家的优化器。同时，SYMI 通过重新利用现有权重更新来动态调整专家参数的放置，避免迁移开销。在此过程中，SYMI 在每次迭代的基础上以最小的开销调整分配给每个专家的 GPU 资源的大小。与最先进的 MoE 训练系统 DeepSpeed 和 FlexMoE 相比，SYMI 的收敛时间分别快了 30.5% 和 25.9%。

items.title: ZooRoute: Enhancing Cloud-Scale Network Reliability via Candidate Path Provisioning and Overlay Proactive Rerouting.
items.abstract:
Failures are inevitable in production-scale cloud networks, making reliability a critical concern for both cloud service providers (CSPs) and their tenants. Existing network failure recovery solutions either fail to provide timely failover or require underlay upgrades, forcing tenants to deploy their own high availability systems with additional CapEX & OpEx. However, most tenants lack the expertise or willingness to invest in such systems but are highly sensitive to service disruptions. This motivates CSPs to assume the responsibility of fast and deterministic failure recovery as a cloud service.

In this work, we present ZooRoute, a tenant-transparent, underlay-agnostic network failure recovery service in Alibaba Cloud. ZooRoute leverages the overlay layer and enables failure bypass by modifying outer source ports during VXLAN tunnel encapsulation. A set of source port candidates per destination IP are maintained by proactive probing between tunnel endpoints to guarantee one-shot deterministic traffic reroute onto healthy paths. However, scaling such design at planet-scale cloud infra brings challenges such as probing overhead at hypervisors, memory consumption at Tofino gateways, and service disruptions at stateful middleboxes, which we address with a range of novel techniques. Deployed in Alibaba Cloud for 26 months, ZooRoute has significantly improved network reliability, reducing cumulative outage time by 93.19% and masking 98.21% of failures from tenant awareness.
items.abstract_zh:
在生产规模的云网络中，故障是不可避免的，这使得可靠性成为云服务提供商 (CSP) 及其租户的关键问题。现有的网络故障恢复解决方案要么无法提供及时的故障转移，要么需要底层升级，迫使租户部署自己的高可用性系统，并增加额外的资本支出和运营支出。然而，大多数租户缺乏投资此类系统的专业知识或意愿，但对服务中断高度敏感。这促使 CSP 承担起云服务快速、确定性故障恢复的责任。

在这项工作中，我们提出了 ZooRoute，这是阿里云中租户透明、底层不可知的网络故障恢复服务。 ZooRoute 利用覆盖层，通过在 VXLAN 隧道封装期间修改外部源端口来实现故障旁路。通过隧道端点之间的主动探测来维护每个目标 IP 的一组候选源端口，以保证一次性确定性流量重新路由到健康路径上。然而，在全球范围内扩展此类设计会带来一些挑战，例如虚拟机管理程序的探测开销、Tofino 网关的内存消耗以及有状态中间盒的服务中断，我们通过一系列新技术来解决这些问题。 ZooRoute在阿里云部署26个月，网络可靠性显着提升，累计宕机时间减少93.19%，屏蔽98.21%的故障租户感知。

items.title: PolicyCache: Intra-flow Learning in Congestion Control.
items.abstract: TCP congestion control (CC) schemes must balance fast responsiveness, adaptability to diverse network conditions, and low computational overhead. Existing approaches fall short: heuristic-based algorithms are lightweight but brittle, learning-based schemes provide high responsiveness yet struggle with generalization, and exploration-based methods adapt well but converge slowly. We present PolicyCache, the first CC algorithm based on intra-flow learning , where both training and execution of the policy are confined to a single flow. Unlike prior inter-flow learning, this paradigm avoids cross-environment generalization pitfalls while maintaining high responsiveness. PolicyCache leverages a lightweight, non-parametric tree-based model coupled with online exploration and dynamic model switching to enable rapid and robust adaptation. We provide convergence analysis of PolicyCache and have built a fully functional Linux prototype. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that PolicyCache consistently achieves high throughput, low latency, and fairness across diverse emulated and real-world networks, while incurring minimal overhead. These results establish intra-flow learning as a practical and effective new direction for congestion control.
items.abstract_zh: TCP 拥塞控制 (CC) 方案必须平衡快速响应性、对不同网络条件的适应性和低计算开销。现有方法存在不足：基于启发式的算法轻量级但脆弱，基于学习的方案提供高响应性但难以泛化，基于探索的方法适应良好但收敛缓慢。我们提出了PolicyCache，这是第一个基于流内学习的CC算法，其中策略的训练和执行都限制在单个流中。与之前的流间学习不同，这种范式避免了跨环境泛化陷阱，同时保持了高响应能力。 PolicyCache 利用轻量级、非参数的基于树的模型以及在线探索和动态模型切换来实现快速、稳健的适应。我们提供了PolicyCache的收敛分析，并构建了一个功能齐全的Linux原型。广泛的评估表明，PolicyCache 在不同的模拟和现实网络中始终如一地实现高吞吐量、低延迟和公平性，同时产生最小的开销。这些结果确立了流内学习作为拥塞控制实用且有效的新方向。

items.title: eXpressSFU: Toward Super-Scalable Video Conferencing with SmartNICs.
items.abstract:
Video conferencing has emerged as a critical Internet application. Unlike video-on-demand services, high-quality video conferencing necessitates minimal latency, as media streams are generated, transmitted, processed, forwarded and received in real time. Our empirical analysis reveals that processing latency at the media server, particularly Selective Forwarding Units (SFUs), is the dominant barrier to scalability. Notably, cryptography, memory, and I/O operations account for approximately 79% of the media packet processing latency.

In this paper, we introduce eXpressSFU , a re-architected video conferencing system designed to significantly enhance scalability for large-scale and high-quality video conferences. By decoupling the fast-control and data planes from the slow-control plane, eXpressSFU accelerates the media packet processing pipeline through the use of emerging network technologies, such as Smart Network Interface Cards (SmartNICs). Experimental results show that our system reduces packet processing latency by a factor of 8. This improvement allows it to support 3× more concurrent users while cutting computational power consumption by up to 60%.
items.abstract_zh:
视频会议已成为一种重要的互联网应用。与视频点播服务不同，高质量视频会议需要最小的延迟，因为媒体流是实时生成、传输、处理、转发和接收的。我们的实证分析表明，媒体服务器（尤其是选择性转发单元 (SFU)）的处理延迟是可扩展性的主要障碍。值得注意的是，加密、内存和 I/O 操作约占媒体数据包处理延迟的 79%。

在本文中，我们介绍了 eXpressSFU，这是一种重新架构的视频会议系统，旨在显着增强大规模和高质量视频会议的可扩展性。通过将快速控制平面和数据平面与慢速控制平面解耦，eXpressSFU 通过使用智能网络接口卡 (SmartNIC) 等新兴网络技术来加速媒体数据包处理管道。实验结果表明，我们的系统将数据包处理延迟降低了 8 倍。这一改进使其能够支持 3 倍以上的并发用户，同时将计算功耗降低高达 60%。

items.title: Enabling AI Network Cross-Layer Design and Operations with Arcadia: A Simulation Platform at Scale.
items.abstract: The rapid evolution of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology is fueling significant investments by hyperscalers, making AI networks crucial for large-scale training. Understanding the design impacts on AI training requires systematic, cross-layer evaluation. Production experience highlights the need for a robust simulation platform to guide network design and operations. This paper defines the platform requirements, addresses complex design challenges, and shares our experience building Arcadia, a scalable, high-fidelity simulation platform for AI Networks. It operates at the cluster level, focusing on overall cluster performance rather than individual job performance. By using our fast-forwarding, lock free, and synchronization-cost reduction mechanisms, Arcadia achieves scalability and speed, allowing us to faithfully simulate real-world-scale training clusters and plays an important role in guiding Meta's AI network evolution.
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能 (AI) 技术的快速发展正在推动超大规模企业的大量投资，使人工智能网络对于大规模训练至关重要。了解设计对人工智能训练的影响需要系统的、跨层的评估。生产经验强调需要一个强大的仿真平台来指导网络设计和运营。本文定义了平台要求，解决了复杂的设计挑战，并分享了我们构建 Arcadia（一个可扩展的高保真人工智能网络仿真平台）的经验。它在集群级别运行，关注整体集群性能而不是单个作业性能。通过使用我们的快进、无锁和同步成本降低机制，Arcadia 实现了可扩展性和速度，使我们能够忠实地模拟真实世界规模的训练集群，并在指导 Meta 的 AI 网络演进方面发挥重要作用。

items.title: The GOODPUT System: A Machine Learning-Driven Optimization Framework for Dynamic Spectrum Control in Heterogeneous WLANs.
items.abstract: Rapid proliferation of wireless devices is leading to spectrum scarcity, particularly in the unlicensed 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands. This paper describes a method to optimize goodput (useful communication throughput) in spectrum-constrained scenarios via access point (AP) channel assignments, channel bonding decisions, and wireless device (station) to AP mappings. Goodput demand prediction and real-time spectrum sensing are used to formulate goodput-maximizing mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) problem instances, which are optimally and efficiently solved to produce network configuration decisions. Our approach is compatible with existing IEEE 802.11 protocols (with primary emphasis on IEEE 802.11ax), commercial access points, modern wireless stations, and legacy infrastructures. A prototype of the system was evaluated and compared with the best existing solutions; it increases goodput by 17.1% relative to multi-AP loadbalancing, by 19.3% compared to a machine-learning-based AP selection, and by 47.9% relative to the static RSSI-based methods widely used in existing systems.
items.abstract_zh: 无线设备的快速扩散导致频谱稀缺，特别是在未经许可的 2.4 GHz 和 5 GHz 频段。本文描述了一种在频谱受限的情况下通过接入点 (AP) 信道分配、信道绑定决策和无线设备（站）到 AP 映射来优化有效吞吐量（有用通信吞吐量）的方法。有效吞吐量需求预测和实时频谱感知用于制定有效吞吐量最大化混合整数线性规划 (MILP) 问题实例，并对其进行优化和有效解决以产生网络配置决策。我们的方法与现有的 IEEE 802.11 协议（主要侧重于 IEEE 802.11ax）、商业接入点、现代无线站和传统基础设施兼容。对系统原型进行了评估，并与现有的最佳解决方案进行了比较；与多 AP 负载平衡相比，它的吞吐量提高了 17.1%，与基于机器学习的 AP 选择相比，吞吐量提高了 19.3%，与现有系统中广泛使用的基于静态 RSSI 的方法相比，吞吐量提高了 47.9%。

items.title: OneSidedMW: Managing Disaggregated Memory Efficiently, Flexibly, and Securely with RNIC Offloading.
items.abstract:
RDMA-based memory disaggregation is gaining popularity in modern datacenters to improve memory efficiency. However, existing memory management approaches for the disaggregated memory (DM) architecture face a critical tradeoff: they either suffer from poor memory utilization due to coarse-grained allocation, or encounter significant challenges in terms of performance, memory node CPU overhead, security vulnerabilities, and limited flexibility.

In this paper, we present OneSidedMW, a novel system that combines two advanced RDMA features—RDMA NIC (RNIC) offloading and memory windows—to provide fine-grained and highly efficient one-sided memory management primitives for DM. Specifically, it leverages RNIC offloading to perform MW binding and unbinding operations, achieving remote memory allocation and deallocation without involving the memory node’s CPU. To demonstrate the efficiency of OneSidedMW, we evaluate it over two representative DM systems: swap-based systems and disaggregated key-value stores. OneSidedMW achieves up to 10.6× better performance in disaggregated key-value stores and up to 32.3% performance improvement in swap-based systems, compared with the state-of-the-art approaches.
items.abstract_zh:
基于 RDMA 的内存分解在现代数据中心中越来越受欢迎，以提高内存效率。然而，现有的分解内存（DM）架构的内存管理方法面临着一个关键的权衡：它们要么由于粗粒度分配而导致内存利用率低下，要么在性能、内存节点CPU开销、安全漏洞和有限的灵活性方面遇到重大挑战。

在本文中，我们提出了 OneSidedMW，这是一种新颖的系统，它结合了两种先进的 RDMA 功能——RDMA NIC (RNIC) 卸载和内存窗口——为 DM 提供细粒度且高效的单侧内存管理原语。具体来说，它利用RNIC卸载来执行MW绑定和解除绑定操作，实现远程内存分配和释放，而不涉及内存节点的CPU。为了证明 OneSidedMW 的效率，我们通过两个代表性的 DM 系统对其进行了评估：基于交换的系统和分解的键值存储。与最先进的方法相比，OneSidedMW 在分类键值存储中实现了高达 10.6 倍的性能提升，在基于交换的系统中实现了高达 32.3% 的性能提升。

items.title: From Source to Solution: Tackling Packet Losses in Large-scale Cloud Gaming Systematically and Precisely.
items.abstract: Cloud gaming requires all video frames to be delivered before a stringent delay deadline to ensure seamless gaming experience. However, meeting this requirement is challenging due to packet losses, which greatly magnifies the frame delay. Various FEC-based loss recovery schemes were recently proposed to address the packet loss issue. However, the source of such packet losses remains unrevealed. Our production measurement results from Tencent START cloud gaming platform have shown that 66.5% of packet losses are caused by network infrastructure’s preferences against UDP and network congestion. Moreover, off-the-shelf video streaming systems like WebRTC could not detect retransmission loss efficiently. These issues completely nullified the performance gain of loss recovery schemes. To address this, we design and implement LADR, which combines loss avoidance, detection, and recovery to tackle packet losses. LADR incorporates the loss-based and delay-based congestion control algorithms and adopts RACK-TLP for loss avoidance and detection. Furthermore, LADR adopts an opportunistic FEC scheme to perform loss recovery. LADR has been rolled out at Tencent START cloud gaming platform, a large-scale cloud gaming provider, for one year. Production measurement results show that LADR only suffers from 0.049% packet loss rate (-59.8% vs. existing solutions) and delivers 99.87% of video frames within 100 milliseconds.
items.abstract_zh: 云游戏要求所有视频帧在严格的延迟期限之前交付，以确保无缝的游戏体验。然而，由于数据包丢失，大大放大了帧延迟，满足这一要求具有挑战性。最近提出了各种基于 FEC 的丢失恢复方案来解决数据包丢失问题。然而，此类数据包丢失的根源仍未揭晓。我们对腾讯START云游戏平台的生产测量结果显示，66.5%的丢包是由网络基础设施对UDP的偏好和网络拥塞造成的。此外，像 WebRTC 这样的现成视频流系统无法有效地检测重传丢失。这些问题完全抵消了丢失恢复方案的性能增益。为了解决这个问题，我们设计并实现了 LADR，它结合了丢失避免、检测和恢复来解决数据包丢失问题。 LADR融合了基于丢失和基于延迟的拥塞控制算法，并采用RACK-TLP进行丢失避免和检测。此外，LADR采用机会性FEC方案来执行丢失恢复。 LADR已在大型云游戏提供商腾讯START云游戏平台上线一年。生产测量结果表明，LADR 的丢包率仅为 0.049%（与现有解决方案相比为-59.8%），并在 100 毫秒内交付 99.87% 的视频帧。

items.title: ZipLLM: Efficient LLM Storage via Model-Aware Synergistic Data Deduplication and Compression.
items.abstract:
Modern model hubs, such as Hugging Face, store tens of petabytes of LLMs, with fine-tuned variants vastly outnumbering base models and dominating storage consumption. Existing storage reduction techniques—such as deduplication and compression—are either LLM-oblivious or not compatible with each other, limiting data reduction effectiveness.

Our large-scale characterization study across all publicly available Hugging Face LLM repositories reveals several key insights: (1) fine-tuned models within the same family exhibit highly structured, sparse parameter differences suitable for delta compression; (2) bitwise similarity enables LLM family clustering; and (3) tensor-level deduplication is better aligned with model storage workloads, achieving high data reduction with low metadata overhead. Building on these insights, we design BitX, an effective, fast, lossless delta compression algorithm that compresses the XORed difference between fine-tuned and base LLMs. We build ZipLLM, a model storage reduction pipeline that unifies tensor-level deduplication and lossless BitX compression. By synergizing deduplication and compression around LLM family clustering, ZipLLM reduces model storage consumption by 54%, over 20% higher than state-of-the-art deduplication and compression approaches.
items.abstract_zh:
现代模型中心（例如 Hugging Face）可存储数十 PB 的 LLM，其中经过微调的变体数量远远超过基本模型，并且占据了存储消耗的主导地位。现有的存储缩减技术（例如重复数据删除和压缩）要么忽略了 LLM，要么彼此不兼容，从而限制了数据缩减的有效性。

我们对所有公开的 Hugging Face LLM 存储库进行的大规模表征研究揭示了几个关键见解：（1）同一系列中的微调模型表现出适合增量压缩的高度结构化、稀疏参数差异； (2) 按位相似性实现LLM家族聚类； （3）张量级重复数据删除与模型存储工作负载更好地保持一致，以低元数据开销实现高数据缩减。基于这些见解，我们设计了 BitX，这是一种有效、快速、无损的增量压缩算法，可压缩微调和基础 LLM 之间的异或差异。我们构建了 ZipLLM，这是一个模型存储缩减管道，它统一了张量级重复数据删除和无损 BitX 压缩。通过围绕 LLM 系列集群协同重复数据删除和压缩，ZipLLM 将模型存储消耗降低了 54%，比最先进的重复数据删除和压缩方法高出 20% 以上。

items.title: HCDN: Coordinated Stream Scheduling for Cost-Effective Live Video Delivery.
items.abstract: Live video streaming is a major source of today's Internet traffic, yet its delivery through CDNs incurs massive bandwidth costs from both CDN edge traffic (to users) and internal traffic (between CDN nodes). To understand these costs, we conduct a large-scale measurement study of ByteDance’s global in-production live CDN. It reveals two opportunities to reduce CDN bandwidth cost: (i) lowering average edge price by incorporating cost-effective best-effort infrastructure into the CDN edge, and (ii) improving CDN tree efficiency via finer-grained stream scheduling, accounting for detailed stream characteristics such as non-uniform popularity, heterogeneous stream formats, which amplify internal traffic on cache misses in our prior CDN. To exploit these opportunities into a practical system while addressing challenges in scheduling strategy management and user quality of experience, we design, implement, and deploy HCDN. It comprises (i) an augmented CDN edge with cost-effective best-effort nodes and multihomed nodes , (ii) the OpenTiga scheduling framework, which coordinates strategies through modular orchestration and proactive client-side Quality-of-Experience (QoE) assurance, and (iii) a set of redirection-based stream scheduling strategies. Over four years of incremental deployment across more than 500 edge clusters, HCDN reduces relative bandwidth cost by 36% while incurring modest overhead and preserving QoE. We further report the deployment experience of HCDN.
items.abstract_zh: 实时视频流是当今互联网流量的主要来源，但通过 CDN 进行传输会产生 CDN 边缘流量（到用户）和内部流量（CDN 节点之间）的大量带宽成本。为了了解这些成本，我们对字节跳动的全球生产中的直播 CDN 进行了大规模的测量研究。它揭示了降低 CDN 带宽成本的两个机会：(i) 通过将具有成本效益的尽力而为基础设施纳入 CDN 边缘来降低平均边缘价格，以及 (ii) 通过更细粒度的流调度来提高 CDN 树效率，考虑详细的流特征，例如非均匀流行度、异构流格式，这些特征会放大我们先前 CDN 中缓存未命中时的内部流量。为了将这些机会应用到实际系统中，同时解决调度策略管理和用户体验质量方面的挑战，我们设计、实施和部署 HCDN。它包括 (i) 具有成本效益的尽力而为节点和多宿主节点的增强 CDN 边缘，(ii) OpenTiga 调度框架，通过模块化编排和主动客户端体验质量 (QoE) 保证来协调策略，以及 (iii) 一组基于重定向的流调度策略。经过四年的跨 500 多个边缘集群的增量部署，HCDN 将相对带宽成本降低了 36%，同时产生适度的开销并保持 QoE。我们进一步汇报HCDN的部署经验。

items.title: Co-Designing Traffic Control with NVMe-oF for Disaggregated Storage: A Comparative Study of Switched and Switchless SAN Architectures.
items.abstract:
Disaggregated storage is a pivotal component of today’s cluster infrastructures. With the advent of high-bandwidth server interconnects and new NVMe form factors, commodity storage appliances are becoming denser, delivering tens of millions of IOPS. This calls for today’s storage area network (SAN) fabric to expand the bandwidth capacity drastically. Industry practices tackle this issue via either (i) a scale-up approach, upgrading the per-port bandwidth in a switched SAN, or (ii) a scale-out strategy, integrating more paths in a switchless SAN. However, it is unclear which network architecture is more suitable for scaling storage disaggregation.

This paper presents a comparative study of switched and switchless SAN architectures from several angles. We begin by developing an experimental methodology that integrates both small-scale real-system prototypes and large-scale simulations, providing the flexibility needed to explore architectural trade-offs. We then characterize NVMe-oF I/O flows and co-design SAN traffic control mechanisms around these characteristics to improve I/O transmission efficiency in both settings. Our evaluation yields several key findings. First, the switchless SAN achieves throughput comparable to that of the switched SAN, despite involving additional routing hops, while simultaneously reducing latency through the use of multiple load-aware I/O paths that mitigate interference. Second, the switchless SAN reduces capital costs by obviating the need for expensive high-radix switches, scales effectively under heterogeneous I/O workloads, and avoids the single point of failure associated with top-of-rack (ToR) switches. Collectively, these results demonstrate that switchless SANs provide a compelling alternative to traditional switched designs for disaggregated storage environments.
items.abstract_zh:
分类存储是当今集群基础设施的关键组成部分。随着高带宽服务器互连和新 NVMe 外形尺寸的出现，商品存储设备变得越来越密集，可提供数千万次 IOPS。这就需要当今的存储区域网络 (SAN) 结构大幅扩展带宽容量。行业实践通过 (i) 纵向扩展方法，升级交换 SAN 中的每端口带宽，或 (ii) 横向扩展策略，在无交换机 SAN 中集成更多路径来解决此问题。然而，尚不清楚哪种网络架构更适合扩展存储分解。

本文从多个角度对交换式和非交换式 SAN 架构进行了比较研究。我们首先开发一种集成小规模真实系统原型和大规模模拟的实验方法，提供探索架构权衡所需的灵活性。然后，我们描述 NVMe-oF I/O 流的特征，并围绕这些特征共同设计 SAN 流量控制机制，以提高两种设置中的 I/O 传输效率。我们的评估得出了几个关键发现。首先，无交换机 SAN 的吞吐量与交换 SAN 相当，尽管涉及额外的路由跳数，同时通过使用多个负载感知 I/O 路径来减少干扰，从而减少延迟。其次，无交换机 SAN 不再需要昂贵的高基数交换机，从而降低了资本成本，在异构 I/O 工作负载下有效扩展，并避免了与架顶 (ToR) 交换机相关的单点故障。总的来说，这些结果表明，无交换机 SAN 为分散存储环境提供了传统交换设计的引人注目的替代方案。

items.title: Medley: Optimizing Midgress Bandwidth for Commercial Live Streaming CDNs.
items.abstract:
The rapid expansion of live streaming services in recent years has introduced new cost challenges for Content Delivery Networks (CDNs). Unlike conventional Video on Demand (VoD) streaming, where CDNs can utilize the off-peak hours to preload video content on edge nodes, live streaming requires real-time delivery across CDN nodes before reaching end users, significantly increasing midgress bandwidth costs for service providers. Characteristics such as real-time content generation and consumption, strict requirements for service quality, and systems that need to scale with diverse resources to support the increase in large-scale users, make it difficult to optimize live-streaming midgress traffic with traditional DNS-based and redirection-based methods.

At ByteDance, we have successfully implemented a substream-based CDN architecture to minimize midgress bandwidth for our commercial live streaming services. By dividing a video stream into multiple sub-streams and assigning each to a different edge node, the system can substantially reduce midgress traffic while adapting to the increasing scale of the system and live-stream users. We present Medley, a production-grade substream delivery system, and validate its efficacy through a large-scale, real-world deployment. Running on one of the largest live streaming platforms, Medley handled up to 0.85 million concurrent viewing requests per minute during peak hours. Our evaluations show that Medley reduces midgress costs by 76.83%, while maintaining consistent Quality of Experience (QoE).
items.abstract_zh:
近年来直播服务的快速扩张给内容分发网络（CDN）带来了新的成本挑战。与传统的视频点播 (VoD) 流媒体不同，传统的视频点播 (VoD) 流媒体可以利用非高峰时段在边缘节点上预加载视频内容，实时流媒体直播需要在到达最终用户之前跨 CDN 节点进行实时传输，从而显着增加了服务提供商的中间带宽成本。实时内容生成和消费、对服务质量的严格要求以及系统需要通过多种资源扩展以支持大规模用户的增长等特点，使得传统的基于DNS和重定向的方法难以优化直播中间流量。

在字节跳动，我们成功实现了基于子流的 CDN 架构，以最大程度地减少商业直播服务的中间带宽。通过将视频流划分为多个子流并将每个子流分配给不同的边缘节点，系统可以大幅减少中间流量，同时适应系统规模和直播用户的不断增长。我们推出了 Medley，一种生产级子流传输系统，并通过大规模的实际部署验证了其功效。 Medley 在最大的直播平台之一上运行，在高峰时段每分钟处理高达 85 万个并发观看请求。我们的评估表明，Medley 将中期成本降低了 76.83%，同时保持了一致的体验质量 (QoE)。

items.title: HyperEdge: An Edge CDN Infrastructure for Cost Efficient Video Streaming.
items.abstract: As ByteDance’s business expands, the cost of video streaming using content delivery networks (CDN) has become prohibitively high. We have discovered a sea of under-utilized edge devices with the potential to reduce content distribution cost. The unreliable performance of an edge network, however, presents deep challenges to video streaming services. In this work, we introduce HyperEdge, an edge-assisted content delivery system for video streaming. HyperEdge seamlessly integrates the robustness of a conventional CDN with the cost-efficiency of an edge network. It offers dependable streaming quality to users while minimizing traffic expenses. HyperEdge employs a centralized tracker cluster to optimize content distribution to a pool of edge devices, based on real-time monitoring. To ensure satisfactory video playback quality, we develop a novel multi-path protocol for client-edge video transmission. Having been in stable operation for six years, HyperEdge manages over a hundred thousand edge devices, serving about a hundred million users daily, and saving hundreds of millions of dollars in content delivery cost annually.
items.abstract_zh: 随着字节跳动业务的扩张，使用内容分发网络（CDN）进行视频流传输的成本变得高得令人望而却步。我们发现大量未充分利用的边缘设备有可能降低内容分发成本。然而，边缘网络的不可靠性能给视频流服务带来了严峻的挑战。在这项工作中，我们介绍了 HyperEdge，一种用于视频流的边缘辅助内容交付系统。 HyperEdge 将传统 CDN 的稳健性与边缘网络的成本效益无缝集成。它为用户提供可靠的流媒体质量，同时最大限度地减少流量费用。 HyperEdge 采用集中式跟踪器集群，基于实时监控来优化边缘设备池的内容分发。为了确保令人满意的视频播放质量，我们开发了一种新颖的用于客户端边缘视频传输的多路径协议。 HyperEdge已稳定运行六年，管理超过十万台边缘设备，每天服务约亿用户，每年节省数亿美元的内容交付成本。

items.title: Attack of the Bubbles: Straggler-Resilient Pipeline Parallelism for Large Model Training.
items.abstract: Training large Deep Neural Network (DNN) models at scale often encounters straggler issues, mostly in communications due to network congestion, RNIC/switch defects, or topological asymmetry. Under advanced pipeline parallelism, even minor communication delays can induce significant training slowdowns. This occurs because (1) slow communication disrupts the pipeline schedule, creating cascading “bubbles” in a domino effect, and (2) current GPU kernel scheduling is susceptible to head-of-line blocking, where slow communication blocks subsequent computations, further adding to these bubbles. To address these challenges, we present PIPEMORPH, a straggler-resilient training system with two key optimizations. First, it optimally adapts the pipeline schedule in the presence of stragglers to absorb communication delays without inducing cascading bubbles, using a simple yet effective algorithm guided by an analytical model. Second, upon detecting slow communication, PIPEMORPH offloads communication operations from GPU to host memory and utilizes CPU-side RDMA for data transfer. This eliminates head-of-line blocking as subsequent computation kernels can be scheduled immediately on GPUs. Together, these optimizations effectively reduce pipeline stalls in the presence of communication stragglers, improving the training iteration time by 1.2-3.5× in our experiments under various settings.
items.abstract_zh: 大规模训练大型深度神经网络 (DNN) 模型经常会遇到落后问题，主要是由于网络拥塞、RNIC/交换机缺陷或拓扑不对称导致的通信问题。在先进的管道并行性下，即使很小的通信延迟也会导致训练速度显着减慢。发生这种情况的原因是 (1) 缓慢的通信会扰乱管道调度，从而在多米诺骨牌效应中产生级联“气泡”，并且 (2) 当前的 GPU 内核调度容易受到队头阻塞的影响，其中缓慢的通信会阻塞后续计算，从而进一步增加这些气泡。为了应对这些挑战，我们推出了 PIPEMORPH，这是一个具有两项关键优化的落后者弹性训练系统。首先，它使用由分析模型引导的简单而有效的算法，在存在掉队者的情况下优化调整管道调度，以吸收通信延迟，而不会引起级联气泡。其次，在检测到通信缓慢时，PIPEMORPH 将通信操作从 GPU 卸载到主机内存，并利用 CPU 端 RDMA 进行数据传输。这消除了队头阻塞，因为后续计算内核可以立即在 GPU 上调度。总之，这些优化有效地减少了存在通信落后者时的管道停顿，在我们的实验中在各种设置下将训练迭代时间提高了 1.2-3.5 倍。

items.title: RLBoost: Harvesting Preemptible Cloud Resources for Cost-Efficient Reinforcement Learning on LLMs.
items.abstract:
Reinforcement learning (RL) has become essential for unlocking advanced reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs). RL workflows involve interleaving rollout and training stages with fundamentally different resource requirements. Rollout typically dominates overall execution time, yet scales efficiently through multiple independent instances. In contrast, training requires tightly-coupled GPUs with full-mesh communication. Existing RL frameworks fall into two categories: co-located and disaggregated architectures. Co-located frameworks fail to address this resource tension by forcing both stages to share the same GPUs. Disaggregated architectures, without modifications of well-established RL algorithms, suffer from resource under-utilization. Meanwhile, preemptible GPU resources, i.e., spot instances on public clouds and spare capacity in production clusters, present significant cost-saving opportunities for accelerating RL workflows, if efficiently harvested for rollout.

In this paper, we present RLBoost, a framework for cost-efficient RL training that harvests preemptible GPU resources. Our key insight is that rollout's stateless and embarrassingly parallel nature aligns perfectly with preemptible and often fragmented resources. To efficiently utilize these resources despite frequent and unpredictable availability changes, RLBoost adopts a hybrid architecture with three key techniques: (1) adaptive rollout offload to dynamically adjust workloads on the reserved (on-demand) cluster, (2) pull-based weight transfer that quickly provisions newly available instances, and (3) token-level response collection and migration for efficient preemption handling and continuous load balancing. Extensive experiments show RLBoost increases training throughput by 1.51x-1.97x while improving cost efficiency by 28%-49% compared to using only on-demand GPU resources. RLBoost is open-sourced at https://github.com/Terra-Flux/PolyRL .
items.abstract_zh:
强化学习 (RL) 已成为解锁大型语言模型 (LLM) 高级推理能力的关键。强化学习工作流程涉及交错的推出和训练阶段，资源需求根本不同。转出通常主导整个执行时间，但可以通过多个独立实例有效扩展。相比之下，训练需要具有全网状通信的紧密耦合 GPU。现有的强化学习框架分为两类：共置架构和分解架构。共置框架无法通过强制两个阶段共享相同的 GPU 来解决这种资源紧张问题。如果不对成熟的 RL 算法进行修改，则分解的架构会遭受资源利用不足的问题。与此同时，可抢占的 GPU 资源（即公共云上的现货实例和生产集群中的备用容量）如果能够有效地进行部署，则可以为加速 RL 工作流程提供显着的成本节约机会。

在本文中，我们提出了 RLBoost，这是一种经济高效的 RL 训练框架，可获取可抢占的 GPU 资源。我们的主要见解是，推出的无状态和令人尴尬的并行性质与可抢占且经常分散的资源完美契合。为了在频繁且不可预测的可用性变化的情况下有效利用这些资源，RLBoost 采用了具有三种关键技术的混合架构：(1) 自适应转出卸载，用于动态调整预留（按需）集群上的工作负载；(2) 基于拉动的权重转移，可快速配置新的可用实例；(3) 令牌级响应收集和迁移，以实现高效的抢占处理和持续负载平衡。大量实验表明，与仅使用按需 GPU 资源相比，RLBoost 将训练吞吐量提高了 1.51 倍-1.97 倍，同时将成本效率提高了 28%-49%。 RLBoost 在 https://github.com/Terra-Flux/PolyRL 上开源。

items.title: Offloading Cloud Network Services at Production Scale with SONiC DASH SmartSwitch.
items.abstract:
To support stateful cloud network services, Microsoft Azure has operated several generations of offloading solutions over the past decade. While these systems improved performance, operating them at hyperscale revealed three persistent lessons: (i) overly flexible programming models hinder hardware acceleration, (ii) appliance-style DPU pools inflate physical footprint and complicate deployment, and (iii) vendor-specific SDKs slow down service iteration.

We present SONiC DASH SmartSwitch that addresses these lessons with three key designs: (1) the DASH pipeline as an immutable and hardware-friendly programming model; (2) the uni-box SmartSwitch that converges NPU and DPU resources within a single T1 switch; and (3) a community-driven development model with P4 behavior specifications. SONiC DASH SmartSwitch has been deployed in Microsoft Azure at scale. It achieves 1.53Tbps throughput, 19.2M CPS, and 256M concurrent connections for network services, while improving power efficiency by ~1.8× and space efficiency by ~2.7× compared to the previous generation.
items.abstract_zh:
为了支持有状态的云网络服务，Microsoft Azure 在过去十年中运行了几代卸载解决方案。虽然这些系统提高了性能，但超大规模的运行暴露了三个长期的教训：(i) 过于灵活的编程模型阻碍了硬件加速，(ii) 设备式 DPU 池扩大了物理占用空间并使部署复杂化，(iii) 特定于供应商的 SDK 减慢了服务迭代。

我们推出 SONiC DASH SmartSwitch，通过三个关键设计来解决这些问题：(1) DASH 管道作为不可变且硬件友好的编程模型； (2) uni-box SmartSwitch，将 NPU 和 DPU 资源融合在单个 T1 交换机内； (3)具有P4行为规范的社区驱动的开发模型。 SONiC DASH SmartSwitch 已在 Microsoft Azure 中大规模部署。与上一代产品相比，它实现了 1.53Tbps 吞吐量、19.2M CPS 和 256M 并发连接数，同时电源效率提高了约 1.8 倍，空间效率提高了约 2.7 倍。

items.title: FastServe: Iteration-Level Preemptive Scheduling for Large Language Model Inference.
items.abstract:
Large language models (LLMs) power a new generation of interactive AI applications exemplified by ChatGPT. The interactive nature of these applications demands low latency for LLM inference. Existing LLM serving systems use run-tocompletion processing for inference jobs, which suffers from head-of-line blocking and long latency.

We present FastServe, a distributed LLM serving system which exploits the autoregressive pattern of LLM inference to enable preemption at the granularity of each output token. FastServe uses preemptive scheduling to minimize latency with a novel skip-join Multi-Level Feedback Queue scheduler. Based on the new semi information-agnostic setting of LLM inference, the scheduler leverages the input length information to assign an appropriate initial queue for each arrival job to join. Queues with higher priority than the one the job joins are skipped to reduce demotions. We design an efficient GPU memory management mechanism that proactively offloads and uploads intermediate state between GPU memory and host memory for LLM inference. Evaluation shows that compared to the state-of-the-art solution vLLM, FastServe improves the throughput by up to 6.1×.
items.abstract_zh:
大型语言模型 (LLM) 为以 ChatGPT 为代表的新一代交互式 AI 应用程序提供支持。这些应用程序的交互性质要求 LLM 推理具有低延迟。现有的 LLM 服务系统对推理作业使用从运行到完成的处理，这会受到队头阻塞和长延迟的影响。

我们提出了 FastServe，一种分布式 LLM 服务系统，它利用 LLM 推理的自回归模式来实现每个输出令牌粒度的抢占。 FastServe 使用抢占式调度，通过新颖的跳跃连接多级反馈队列调度程序来最大限度地减少延迟。基于 LLM 推理的新的半信息不可知设置，调度程序利用输入长度信息为每个要加入的到达作业分配适当的初始队列。优先级高于作业加入队列的队列将被跳过，以减少降级。我们设计了一种高效的 GPU 内存管理机制，可以主动卸载和上传 GPU 内存和主机内存之间的中间状态，以进行 LLM 推理。评估表明，与最先进的解决方案 vLLM 相比，FastServe 将吞吐量提高了 6.1 倍。

items.title: REAL: Emulating Control Plane at Simulator's Cost.
items.abstract: Validating control plane behavior and ensuring policy compliance in modern, large-scale networks is a critical challenge. Simulation-based approaches offer low computational and memory costs, but their level of abstraction fails to capture vendor-specific device behaviors, limiting their accuracy for real-world validation. In contrast, control plane emulation provides high fidelity by using unmodified router containers that preserve these vendor-specific details, but its excessive computational and memory requirements make it impractical for large networks. In this paper, we present REAL, a lightweight runtime that emulates control planes using unmodified router containers but at the cost of simulation-based approaches. REAL achieves this by simulating a lightweight data plane to accelerate boot-up, employing a two-phase scheduling policy to minimize cache inefficiencies during convergence, and enabling iterative convergence to reduce peak memory usage by partitioning the network. Our evaluation shows that REAL emulates a 1,000-node network 4× faster than state-of-the-art simulation while preserving vendor-specific behaviors, and can scale to 4,500 nodes on four commodity servers by shaving 8.3× memory.
items.abstract_zh: 验证控制平面行为并确保现代大型网络中的策略合规性是一项严峻的挑战。基于仿真的方法提供较低的计算和内存成本，但其抽象级别无法捕获特定于供应商的设备行为，从而限制了其在现实世界验证的准确性。相比之下，控制平面仿真通过使用未修改的路由器容器来保留这些特定于供应商的详细信息，从而提供高保真度，但其过多的计算和内存要求使其对于大型网络来说不切实际。在本文中，我们提出了 REAL，这是一种轻量级运行时，它使用未修改的路由器容器来模拟控制平面，但代价是基于模拟的方法。 REAL 通过模拟轻量级数据平面来加速启动、采用两阶段调度策略来最大限度地减少收敛过程中缓存的低效率，以及通过分区网络实现迭代收敛来减少峰值内存使用来实现这一目标。我们的评估表明，REAL 模拟 1,000 节点网络的速度比最先进的模拟快 4 倍，同时保留供应商特定的行为，并且可以通过削减 8.3 倍内存在四台商用服务器上扩展到 4,500 个节点。

items.title: Iceberg: Automated Verification of DNS Authoritative Engines via Just-in-Time Summarization.
items.abstract:
As the core of DNS services, DNS authoritative engines are responsible for answering DNS queries with DNS responses, where any bugs may lead to severe consequences. While it is critical to ensure the correctness of the engine, existing solutions fail to deliver both correctness guarantees and low manual effort when applied to large and complex implementations in use. The state-of-the-art solution, DNS-V, relies on extra manual specifications for scaling verification, which still incurs a prohibitive cost.

In this paper, we present Iceberg, an automated verification framework for DNS authoritative engines that holistically reduces manual effort. To achieve this, we propose just-in-time (JIT) summarization , a refinement-proof approach that utilizes invariants from DNS zones to enable the use of automated summaries throughout verification, especially for domain-specific DNS operations. In addition, we employ a set of techniques to further scale automation, including symbolic regions, summary optimization, and stub function interposing. We apply Iceberg to four open-source DNS engines, identifying 12 new bugs while keeping manual effort low.
items.abstract_zh:
DNS权威引擎作为DNS服务的核心，负责用DNS响应来回答DNS查询，任何错误都可能导致严重后果。虽然确保引擎的正确性至关重要，但现有的解决方案在应用于大型且复杂的实施时，无法同时提供正确性保证和低手动工作量。最先进的解决方案 DNS-V 依赖于额外的手动规范来进行扩展验证，但这仍然会产生高昂的成本。

在本文中，我们提出了 Iceberg，这是一种用于 DNS 权威引擎的自动验证框架，可从整体上减少手动工作。为了实现这一目标，我们提出了即时 (JIT) 摘要，这是一种防细化方法，利用 DNS 区域的不变量来实现在整个验证过程中使用自动摘要，特别是对于特定于域的 DNS 操作。此外，我们采用了一系列技术来进一步扩展自动化，包括符号区域、摘要优化和存根函数插入。我们将 Iceberg 应用于四个开源 DNS 引擎，识别出 12 个新错误，同时保持较低的手动工作量。

items.title: ServeGen: Workload Characterization and Generation of Large Language Model Serving in Production.
items.abstract:
With the widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs), serving LLM inference requests has become an increasingly important task, attracting active research advancements. Practical workloads play an essential role in this process: they are critical for motivating and benchmarking serving techniques and systems. However, the existing understanding of real-world LLM serving workloads is limited due to the lack of a comprehensive workload characterization. Prior analyses remain insufficient in scale and scope, thus failing to fully capture intricate workload characteristics.

In this paper, we fill the gap with an in-depth characterization of LLM serving workloads collected from our worldwide cloud LLM serving service, covering not only language models but also emerging multimodal and reasoning models, unveiling important new findings in each case. Moreover, based on our findings, we propose ServeGen, a principled framework for generating realistic LLM serving workloads by composing them on a per-client basis. Practical use cases validate that ServeGen achieves more accurate performance benchmarking compared to naive workload generation, and reveals new design implications that could otherwise be overlooked. ServeGen is open-sourced at https://github.com/alibaba/ServeGen .
items.abstract_zh:
随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 的广泛采用，服务 LLM 推理请求已成为一项日益重要的任务，吸引了积极的研究进展。实际工作负载在此过程中发挥着重要作用：它们对于激励和基准测试服务技术和系统至关重要。然而，由于缺乏全面的工作负载特征，现有对现实世界 LLM 服务工作负载的理解是有限的。先前的分析在规模和范围上仍然不足，因此未能完全捕捉复杂的工作负载特征。

在本文中，我们通过对从全球云 LLM 服务服务收集的 LLM 服务工作负载的深入描述来填补这一空白，不仅涵盖语言模型，还涵盖新兴的多模式和推理模型，在每种情况下都揭示了重要的新发现。此外，根据我们的发现，我们提出了 ServeGen，这是一个原则框架，用于通过根据每个客户组合来生成实际的 LLM 服务工作负载。实际用例验证了 ServeGen 与原始工作负载生成相比实现了更准确的性能基准测试，并揭示了可能被忽视的新设计含义。 ServeGen 在 https://github.com/alibaba/ServeGen 上开源。

items.title: DDoS Detection at the Scale of One Hundred Tbps.
items.abstract: Defending against Distributed Denial-of-Service (DDoS) attacks is a critical priority for cloud providers, who must manage ever-growing volumes of both benign and malicious traffic. While state-of-the-art DDoS detection systems leverage programmable devices to process traffic at hundreds of Gbps to Tbps on a single machine, large-scale cloud providers often handle traffic at scales approaching 100 Tbps. This massive volume—two orders of magnitude higher than the traffic handled by existing systems—motivates us to implement distributed processing across multiple servers, where new challenges are present. Specifically, naive load-balancing strategies lead to imbalanced traffic distribution and severe performance bottlenecks, while function offloading to programmable devices must balance flexibility and adaptability. In this paper, we present Canopy, a scalable DDoS detection system designed to overcome these challenges. Canopy features a dynamic load-balancing mechanism that adapts to fluctuating traffic patterns, ensuring balanced distribution across detection servers despite the mix of mice and elephant flows. Additionally, it employs a traffic compression technique at the programmable switch to significantly reduce per-server workload. These innovations enable Canopy to scale to over 100 Tbps in real-world deployments. Successfully deployed in production, Canopy has demonstrated its effectiveness in mitigating large-scale DDoS attacks.
items.abstract_zh: 防御分布式拒绝服务 (DDoS) 攻击是云提供商的首要任务，他们必须管理不断增长的良性和恶意流量。虽然最先进的 DDoS 检测系统利用可编程设备在单台机器上处理数百 Gbps 到 Tbps 的流量，但大型云提供商通常处理接近 100 Tbps 的流量。如此巨大的流量（比现有系统处理的流量高出两个数量级）促使我们在多个服务器上实现分布式处理，这也带来了新的挑战。具体来说，简单的负载平衡策略会导致流量分配不平衡和严重的性能瓶颈，而功能卸载到可编程设备必须平衡灵活性和适应性。在本文中，我们提出了 Canopy，这是一种可扩展的 DDoS 检测系统，旨在克服这些挑战。 Canopy 具有动态负载平衡机制，可适应波动的流量模式，确保检测服务器之间的平衡分配，尽管存在老鼠和大象流量。此外，它在可编程交换机上采用流量压缩技术，可显着减少每台服务器的工作负载。这些创新使 Canopy 在实际部署中能够扩展到超过 100 Tbps。 Canopy 已成功部署在生产环境中，展示了其在缓解大规模 DDoS 攻击方面的有效性。

items.title: Slowpoke: End-to-end Throughput Optimization Modeling for Microservice Applications.
items.abstract: Slowpoke is a new system to accurately quantify the effects of hypothetical optimizations on end-to-end throughput for microservice applications, without relying on tracing or a priori knowledge of the call graph. Microservice operators can use Slowpoke to ask what-if performance analysis questions of the form "What throughput could my retail application sustain if I optimized the shopping cart service from 10K req/s to 20K req/s?" . Given a target service and its hypothetical optimization, Slowpoke employs a performance model that determines how to selectively slow down non-target services to preserve the relative effect of the optimization. It then performs profiling experiments to predict the end-to-end throughput, as if the optimization had been implemented. Applied to four real-world microservice applications, Slowpoke accurately quantifies optimization effects with a root mean squared error of only 2.07%. It is also effective in more complex scenarios, e.g., predicting throughput after scaling optimizations or when bottlenecks arise from mutex contention. Evaluated in large-scale deployments of 45 nodes and 108 synthetic benchmarks, Slowpoke further demonstrates its scalability and coverage of a wide range of microservice characteristics.
items.abstract_zh: Slowpoke 是一个新系统，可以准确量化假设优化对微服务应用程序端到端吞吐量的影响，而无需依赖跟踪或调用图的先验知识。微服务运营商可以使用 Slowpoke 提出假设性能分析问题，其形式为“如果我将购物车服务从 10K 请求/秒优化到 20K 请求/秒，我的零售应用程序可以维持多少吞吐量？” 。给定目标服务及其假设的优化，Slowpoke 采用性能模型来确定如何有选择地减慢非目标服务以保持优化的相对效果。然后，它执行分析实验来预测端到端吞吐量，就好像优化已经实施一样。 Slowpoke 应用于四个真实的微服务应用，准确量化了优化效果，均方根误差仅为 2.07%。它在更复杂的场景中也很有效，例如，在扩展优化后或当互斥锁争用出现瓶颈时预测吞吐量。在 45 个节点和 108 个综合基准的大规模部署中进行评估，Slowpoke 进一步展示了其可扩展性和对广泛微服务特性的覆盖。

items.title: Defending against Traffic Analysis Attacks with Flexible In-Network Obfuscation.
items.abstract: Traffic analysis attacks can exploit side channels in encrypted traffic (e.g., packet sizes) to infer user activities. Existing defenses provide weak protection, impose excessive bandwidth overhead, or require hard-to-deploy coordination. We present Securitas, a novel network traffic obfuscation framework that protects from side-channel attacks using a learning-guided mix of packet fragmentation and insertion. We implemented Securitas on a number of different data planes: Tofino switch, AMD/Xilinx FPGA, eBPF, and BMv2. Experiments show that Securitas reduces attack accuracy by up to 95.89%, while consuming 42.69× less bandwidth than prior defenses. Real-world Internet tests confirm minimal performance impact, e.g., adding 0.15s to the web page load.
items.abstract_zh: 流量分析攻击可以利用加密流量中的侧通道（例如数据包大小）来推断用户活动。现有的防御措施提供的保护很弱，会带来过多的带宽开销，或者需要难以部署的协调。我们推出了 Securitas，这是一种新颖的网络流量混淆框架，它使用数据包分段和插入的学习引导组合来防止侧通道攻击。我们在许多不同的数据平面上实现了 Securitas：Tofino 交换机、AMD/Xilinx FPGA、eBPF 和 BMv2。实验表明，Securitas 将攻击准确率降低了 95.89%，同时消耗的带宽比之前的防御减少了 42.69 倍。真实世界的互联网测试证实对性能的影响最小，例如，网页加载时间增加 0.15 秒。

items.title: FalconFS: Distributed File System for Large-Scale Deep Learning Pipeline.
items.abstract: Client-side metadata caching has long been considered an effective method for accelerating metadata operations in distributed file systems (DFSs). However, we have found that client-side state (e.g., caching) is not only ineffective but also consumes valuable memory resources in the deep learning pipelines. We thus propose FalconFS, a DFS optimized for deep learning pipelines with the stateless-client architecture. Specifically, instead of performing client-side path resolution and caching, FalconFS efficiently resolves paths on the server side using hybrid metadata indexing and lazy namespace replication . FalconFS also boosts server concurrency with concurrent request merging and provides easy deployment with VFS shortcut . Evaluations against CephFS and Lustre show that FalconFS achieves up to 5.72× throughput for small file read/write and up to 12.81× throughput for deep learning model training. FalconFS has been running in Huawei autonomous driving system's production environment with 10,000 NPUs for one year and has been open-sourced.
items.abstract_zh: 客户端元数据缓存长期以来一直被认为是加速分布式文件系统（DFS）中元数据操作的有效方法。然而，我们发现客户端状态（例如缓存）不仅无效，而且还会消耗深度学习管道中宝贵的内存资源。因此，我们提出了 FalconFS，这是一种针对具有无状态客户端架构的深度学习管道进行优化的 DFS。具体来说，FalconFS 不是执行客户端路径解析和缓存，而是使用混合元数据索引和惰性命名空间复制在服务器端有效解析路径。 FalconFS 还通过并发请求合并提高服务器并发性，并通过 VFS 快捷方式提供轻松部署。针对 CephFS 和 Lustre 的评估表明，FalconFS 在小文件读写方面实现了高达 5.72 倍的吞吐量，在深度学习模型训练方面实现了高达 12.81 倍的吞吐量。 FalconFS已在华为自动驾驶系统1万个NPU的生产环境中运行一年，并已开源。

items.title: MuxTune: Efficient Multi-Task LLM Fine-Tuning in Multi-Tenant Datacenters via Spatial-Temporal Backbone Multiplexing.
items.abstract: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) is widely applied as the backend of fine-tuning APIs for large language model (LLM) customization in datacenters. Service providers deploy separate instances for individual PEFT tasks, giving rise to prominent resource inefficiencies, including (1) GPU underutilization from small-scale, PEFT-native operators and (2) device stalls from communication delays and data dependencies in parallelized execution. To address these issues, this paper presents MuxTune, a fine-tuning system that enables resource-efficient concurrent execution of multiple PEFT tasks. The key idea is to multiplex the backbone across independent tasks in a spatial-temporal manner for improved utilization and reduced stalls. Building on flexible, modularized backbone sharing via unified PEFT representations, MuxTune proposes hierarchical co-scheduling scheme with task, operator, and data-level optimizations. Specifically, it fuses tasks through a hybrid of spatial and temporal multiplexing, and orchestrates multi-task operator execution in two-tiered hybrid parallelism. Additionally, MuxTune employs chunk-based data alignment to mitigate inter-task ineffective tokens. Experimental results demonstrate that MuxTune achieves up to 2.33× higher throughput and 5.29× memory reduction compared to three state-of-the-art baselines.
items.abstract_zh: 参数高效微调 (PEFT) 被广泛用作数据中心大型语言模型 (LLM) 定制微调 API 的后端。服务提供商为各个 PEFT 任务部署单独的实例，导致显着的资源效率低下，包括 (1) 小规模、PEFT 原生运营商的 GPU 利用率不足，以及 (2) 由于并行执行中的通信延迟和数据依赖性而导致设备停顿。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了 MuxTune，这是一种微调系统，可以实现多个 PEFT 任务的资源高效并发执行。关键思想是以时空方式跨独立任务复用主干，以提高利用率并减少停顿。 MuxTune 通过统一的 PEFT 表示建立在灵活、模块化的主干共享基础上，提出了具有任务、操作员和数据级优化的分层协同调度方案。具体来说，它通过空间和时间复用的混合来融合任务，并以两层混合并行方式协调多任务运算符的执行。此外，MuxTune 采用基于块的数据对齐来减少任务间的无效令牌。实验结果表明，与三个最先进的基准相比，MuxTune 的吞吐量提高了 2.33 倍，内存减少了 5.29 倍。

items.title: KeepON: Supporting Deterministic Traffic on Standard NICs.
items.abstract: Networked mission-critical applications (e.g., avionics control and industrial automation) demand deterministic packet transmissions to meet stringent sensing and control timing requirements. While specialized infrastructures such as TimeTriggered Ethernet and Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) ensure deterministic data delivery across switches, end devices still require specialized NICs (e.g., TSN NICs or NVIDIA Mellanox) to eliminate endpoint indeterminism. However, deploying such NICs at every endpoint is costly and hinders compatibility with legacy systems. To address this challenge, we propose KeepON, a novel software-based driver model that enables deterministic packet transmission on commodity NICs. The core idea is to continuously transmit fixed-size placeholder packets, establishing a predictable transmission pattern. Mission-critical packets are then precisely inserted into this stream by replacing placeholders at their scheduled transmission slots, ensuring timing accuracy. The placeholder packets are efficiently dropped at the first-hop switch, avoiding negative impacts on network performance. We prototype KeepON by modifying the standard NIC driver of a Raspberry Pi, and integrate it into a real-world TSN testbed. Experimental results show that KeepON achieves up to 130× improvement in scheduling accuracy compared to the default driver, and 2.1× improvement over a hardware-based solution.
