items.abstract_zh: 网络关键任务应用（例如航空电子控制和工业自动化）需要确定性数据包传输，以满足严格的传感和控制时序要求。虽然时间触发以太网和时间敏感网络 (TSN) 等专用基础设施可确保跨交换机的确定性数据传输，但终端设备仍然需要专用 NIC（例如 TSN NIC 或 NVIDIA Mellanox）来消除端点不确定性。然而，在每个端点部署此类 NIC 成本高昂，并且会妨碍与遗留系统的兼容性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 KeepON，这是一种基于软件的新型驱动程序模型，可在商用 NIC 上实现确定性数据包传输。其核心思想是连续传输固定大小的占位符数据包，建立可预测的传输模式。然后，通过替换预定传输时隙中的占位符，将关键任务数据包精确地插入到该流中，从而确保定时准确性。占位符数据包在第一跳交换机处被有效丢弃，避免对网络性能产生负面影响。我们通过修改 Raspberry Pi 的标准 NIC 驱动程序对 KeepON 进行原型设计，并将其集成到现实世界的 TSN 测试台中。实验结果表明，与默认驱动程序相比，KeepON 的调度精度提高了 130 倍，比基于硬件的解决方案提高了 2.1 倍。

items.title: MORP4: A Dynamic Network Telescope.
items.abstract: A network telescope passively monitors traffic reaching Internet address space that is not assigned to any hosts but is advertised to the global routing system. This traffic is by definition unsolicited . For more than two decades, network telescopes have enabled research breakthroughs by allowing global visibility into a wide range of Internet phenomena. However, telescopes are afflicted by two main issues: progressive erosion, due to the increasing scarcity and commercial value of address space, and blacklisting. To overcome these issues, we propose MORP4, a programmable data-plane framework implementing a “dynamic” network telescope. MORP4 accurately and adaptively tracks unused space of an organization’s network with configurable time and space granularity and captures only traffic directed towards unused addresses at line rate. We provide an implementation in P4 and Python/C++, and deploy it on a Tofino switch. We show that it can detect unused IPv4 address space at the finest granularity (/32) while operating at line rate as well as providing an effective approach for operating a telescope in the IPv6 domain.
items.abstract_zh: 网络望远镜被动地监视到达互联网地址空间的流量，该地址空间未分配给任何主机，而是通告给全球路由系统。根据定义，这种流量是未经请求的。二十多年来，网络望远镜通过让全球了解各种互联网现象实现了研究突破。然而，望远镜受到两个主要问题的困扰：由于地址空间的稀缺性和商业价值的日益增加而逐渐受到侵蚀，以及列入黑名单。为了克服这些问题，我们提出了 MORP4，这是一种实现“动态”网络望远镜的可编程数据平面框架。 MORP4 以可配置的时间和空间粒度准确、自适应地跟踪组织网络的未使用空间，并仅捕获以线速指向未使用地址的流量。我们提供了 P4 和 Python/C++ 的实现，并将其部署在 Tofino 交换机上。我们证明，它可以以最细粒度 (/32) 检测未使用的 IPv4 地址空间，同时以线速运行，并为在 IPv6 域中操作望远镜提供有效的方法。

items.title: AVA: Towards Agentic Video Analytics with Vision Language Models.
items.abstract:
AI-driven video analytics has become increasingly important across diverse domains. However, existing systems are often constrained to specific, predefined tasks, limiting their adaptability in open-ended analytical scenarios. The recent emergence of Vision Language Models (VLMs) as transformative technologies offers significant potential for enabling open-ended video understanding, reasoning, and analytics. Nevertheless, their limited context windows present challenges when processing ultra-long video content, which is prevalent in real-world applications. To address this, we introduce AVA, a VLM-powered system designed for open-ended, advanced video analytics. AVA incorporates two key innovations: (1) the near real-time construction of Event Knowledge Graphs (EKGs) for efficient indexing of long or continuous video streams, and (2) an agentic retrieval-generation mechanism that leverages EKGs to handle complex and diverse queries. Comprehensive evaluations on public benchmarks, LVBench and VideoMME-Long, demonstrate that AVA achieves state-of-the-art performance, attaining 62.3% and 64.1% accuracy, respectively, significantly surpassing existing VLM and video Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Furthermore, to evaluate video analytics in ultra-long and open-world video scenarios, we introduce a new benchmark, AVA-100. This benchmark comprises 8 videos, each exceeding 10 hours in duration, along with 120 manually annotated, diverse, and complex question-answer pairs. On AVA-100, AVA achieves top-tier performance with an accuracy of 75.8%.

The source code of AVA is available at https://github.com/I-ESC/Project-Ava . The AVA-100 benchmark could be accessed at https://huggingface.co/datasets/iesc/Ava-100 .
items.abstract_zh:
人工智能驱动的视频分析在不同领域变得越来越重要。然而，现有系统通常仅限于特定的预定义任务，限制了它们在开放式分析场景中的适应性。最近出现的视觉语言模型 (VLM) 作为变革性技术，为实现开放式视频理解、推理和分析提供了巨大的潜力。然而，在处理现实应用中普遍存在的超长视频内容时，它们有限的上下文窗口带来了挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们推出了 AVA，这是一种由 VLM 驱动的系统，专为开放式高级视频分析而设计。 AVA 包含两项关键创新：(1) 近实时构建事件知识图 (EKG)，用于对长或连续视频流进行高效索引；(2) 代理检索生成机制，利用 EKG 处理复杂多样的查询。对公共基准、LVBench 和 VideoMME-Long 的综合评估表明，AVA 实现了最先进的性能，分别达到 62.3% 和 64.1% 的准确率，显着超越现有的 VLM 和视频检索增强生成 (RAG) 系统。此外，为了评估超长和开放世界视频场景中的视频分析，我们引入了新的基准 AVA-100。该基准测试包括 8 个视频，每个视频时长超过 10 小时，以及 120 个手动注释的多样化且复杂的问答对。在 AVA-100 上，AVA 达到了顶级性能，准确率达到 75.8%。

AVA 的源代码可在 https://github.com/I-ESC/Project-Ava 获取。 AVA-100 基准测试可通过 https://huggingface.co/datasets/iesc/Ava-100 访问。

items.title: Diagnosing and Repairing Distributed Routing Configurations Using Selective Symbolic Simulation.
items.abstract: Although substantial progress has been made in automatically verifying whether distributed routing configurations comply with certain intents, diagnosing and repairing configuration errors remains manual and time-consuming. To fill this gap, we propose S2Sim, a novel system for automatic routing configuration diagnosis and repair. Our key insight is that by deriving a set of contracts that guarantees an intent-compliant variant of the erroneous configuration, we can systematically check for all contract violations in the configuration via symbolic simulation to pinpoint and repair the errors. S2Sim also introduces a series of extensions to support complex configurations (e.g., ACL, route aggregation and multi-path routing), networks (e.g., underlay and overlay networks), and intents (e.g., k-link failure tolerance). We fully implement S2Sim and evaluate its performance using real configurations from two major providers and synthesized configurations composed from their real errors and real-world topologies with different scales O(10) to O(1000). Results show that S2Sim accurately and efficiently diagnoses and repairs real configuration errors (i.e., up to 20 seconds in real networks of O(100) nodes and up to 15 minutes in synthesized networks of O(1000) nodes).
items.abstract_zh: 尽管在自动验证分布式路由配置是否符合某些意图方面已经取得了实质性进展，但诊断和修复配置错误仍然需要手动且耗时。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了 S2Sim，一种用于自动路由配置诊断和修复的新颖系统。我们的主要见解是，通过派生一组保证错误配置的符合意图的变体的合约，我们可以通过符号模拟系统地检查配置中的所有合约违规情况，以查明并修复错误。 S2Sim 还引入了一系列扩展来支持复杂的配置（例如 ACL、路由聚合和多路径路由）、网络（例如底层和覆盖网络）和意图（例如 k-link 容错）。我们完全实现 S2Sim 并使用来自两个主要提供商的真实配置以及由其真实错误和具有不同规模 O(10) 到 O(1000) 的真实世界拓扑组成的合成配置来评估其性能。结果表明，S2Sim 能够准确、高效地诊断和修复真实配置错误（即，在 O(100) 个节点的真实网络中最多需要 20 秒，在 O(1000) 个节点的合成网络中最多需要 15 分钟）。

items.title: DistVS: Large-scale Vector Search with Compute-Memory Disaggregation.
items.abstract: Similarity-based vector search, also known as ANNS, underlies many important applications such as content search, recommender system, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). However, vector search has a high storage demand due to large datasets and incurs costly IOs for its fine-grained access to the vectors and index. We observe that a compute-memory disaggregation architecture can tackle these challenges and design the DistVS system with a three-tier storage layout. In particular, the compute servers keep the small but low-precision compressed vectors, a more capacious memory server stores larger high-precision compressed vectors along with the index, while the full-precision exact vectors are kept on SSDs. The idea is to progressively prune the vector accesses along the low-high-full precisions from the compute servers to the SSDs, aligning with the storage hierarchy of memory-network-disk with gradually larger capacity but higher IO cost. To effectively utilize the three vector previsions, we design an algorithm called PRESS to conduct vector search. To improve performance, DistVS incorporates system optimizations including asynchronous execution, RDMA IO batching, and decoupled re-ranking. We compare DistVS with state-of-the-art disk-based and distributed vector search systems and show that DistVS consistently outperforms them and usually improves their query throughput by over 40%.
items.abstract_zh: 基于相似性的向量搜索（也称为 ANNS）是许多重要应用的基础，例如内容搜索、推荐系统和检索增强生成 (RAG)。然而，由于数据集较大，向量搜索具有很高的存储需求，并且对向量和索引的细粒度访问会产生昂贵的 IO。我们观察到计算内存分解架构可以解决这些挑战，并设计具有三层存储布局的 DistVS 系统。特别是，计算服务器保留小但低精度的压缩向量，容量更大的内存服务器存储更大的高精度压缩向量以及索引，而全精度精确向量则保存在 SSD 上。这个想法是沿着从计算服务器到SSD的低-高全精度逐步修剪向量访问，与容量逐渐增大但IO成本较高的内存-网络-磁盘的存储层次结构保持一致。为了有效地利用这三种向量预测，我们设计了一种称为 PRESS 的算法来进行向量搜索。为了提高性能，DistVS 结合了系统优化，包括异步执行、RDMA IO 批处理和解耦重排序。我们将 DistVS 与最先进的基于磁盘的分布式矢量搜索系统进行比较，结果表明，DistVS 始终优于它们，并且通常将其查询吞吐量提高 40% 以上。

items.title: HybridMesh: A Hardware-software Hybrid Approach for Accelerating Service Mesh Ingress.
items.abstract: Service meshes have become essential for enabling microservice communication in cloud environments. Despite their benefits, they impose significant network overhead. We identify the ingress gateway, a main entry point for external traffic, has emerged as a major performance bottleneck. This overhead stems from two key limitations of current ingress gateways: (1) CPU-intensive traffic analysis and (2) a complex packet forwarding path. Our analysis shows that these inefficiencies can reduce network throughput by up to 4× while substantially increasing CPU utilization. In response, we propose HybridMesh, a hardware-software hybrid ingress gateway that leverages a SmartNIC for high-performance traffic analysis and efficient traffic routing. This process is augmented by a lightweight CPU-side proxy that provides various traffic management features not suitable for SmartNIC execution. Evaluations show that HybridMesh outperforms existing ingress gateways, achieving a 4.4× increase in HTTP throughput. Furthermore, compared to software-only and hardware-only designs, our hybrid design delivers 2.3× higher cost-effectiveness and 2.8× better power-efficiency.
items.abstract_zh: 服务网格对于在云环境中实现微服务通信至关重要。尽管有这些好处，但它们也会带来巨大的网络开销。我们发现入口网关是外部流量的主要入口点，已成为主要的性能瓶颈。这种开销源于当前入口网关的两个关键限制：(1) CPU 密集型流量分析和 (2) 复杂的数据包转发路径。我们的分析表明，这些效率低下的情况会使网络吞吐量降低多达 4 倍，同时大幅提高 CPU 利用率。为此，我们提出了 HybridMesh，这是一种硬件软件混合入口网关，利用 SmartNIC 进行高性能流量分析和高效流量路由。此过程通过轻量级 CPU 端代理进行了增强，该代理提供了不适合 SmartNIC 执行的各种流量管理功能。评估表明，HybridMesh 的性能优于现有入口网关，HTTP 吞吐量提高了 4.4 倍。此外，与纯软件和纯硬件设计相比，我们的混合设计可提供 2.3 倍的成本效益和 2.8 倍的功效。

items.title: cc-pipe: Breaking Systemic Bottlenecks in RPKI Data Supply Chain with Concurrent and Conflict-Free Pipelines.
items.abstract:
While the Resource Public Key Infrastructure (RPKI) is essential for securing BGP, the high latency, limited scalability, and vulnerabilities in the data supply chain severely undermine its security guarantees and impede network operations. Within this supply chain, existing research identifies the Relying Party (RP) validation process as the primary performance bottleneck. This bottleneck originates from the standard monolithic architecture, which enforces strong consistency but incurs high latency. Previous work has pursued incremental optimizations within this architecture, yet achieving substantial gains remains difficult.

Based on extensive measurements, we identify inherent blocking within the paradigm as the root cause. To address this, we propose cc-pipe, a novel pipeline architecture that breaks the fundamental consistency—latency trade-off. By leveraging a predictive conflict graph, cc-pipe enables low-latency incremental data dissemination while preserving strong consistency guarantees. Evaluation with real-world deployment demonstrates that cc-pipe reduces average latency by up to 73.3% across all data with negligible router overhead. It also delivers significant scalability under projected future workloads, as well as robust resilience to misbehaving publication points.
items.abstract_zh:
虽然资源公钥基础设施 (RPKI) 对于保护 BGP 至关重要，但数据供应链中的高延迟、有限的可扩展性和漏洞严重破坏了其安全保障并阻碍网络运行。在该供应链中，现有研究将依赖方 (RP) 验证流程确定为主要性能瓶颈。这个瓶颈源于标准的整体架构，它强制要求强一致性，但会产生高延迟。之前的工作已经在该架构中追求增量优化，但实现实质性收益仍然很困难。

基于广泛的测量，我们将范式中固有的阻塞确定为根本原因。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 cc-pipe，这是一种新颖的管道架构，它打破了基本的一致性——延迟权衡。通过利用预测冲突图，cc-pipe 可以实现低延迟增量数据传播，同时保持强大的一致性保证。对实际部署的评估表明，cc-pipe 将所有数据的平均延迟降低了 73.3%，而路由器开销可以忽略不计。它还在预计的未来工作负载下提供了显着的可扩展性，以及对行为不当的发布点的强大弹性。

items.title: In Link We Trust: BFT at the Speed of CFT using Switches.
items.abstract: We introduce SwitchBFT , a novel BFT consensus protocol for data centers that matches the performance and fault tolerance guarantees of the fastest Crash Fault Tolerance (CFT) protocols. We take advantage of several unique properties of the trusted network that have emerged in modern data centers. SwitchBFT leverages packet source authentication to eliminate the overheads of cryptographic signatures, thus speeding up the fault-free scenario, and utilizes network switch programmability to enforce agreement decisions and to verify that safety is not violated, thereby offering robust performance even when some replicas are faulty. Designing a practical BFT that makes the most of these properties requires solving several challenges, such as packet losses and switch crash faults, all within the tight switch resource budget. We show that SwitchBFT outperforms state-of-the-art BFTs in scalability and performance, attaining the speed of NOPaxos, an in-switch CFT implementation.
items.abstract_zh: 我们推出 SwitchBFT，这是一种适用于数据中心的新型 BFT 共识协议，其性能和容错保证可与最快的崩溃容错 (CFT) 协议相匹配。我们利用现代数据中心中出现的可信网络的几个独特属性。 SwitchBFT 利用数据包源身份验证来消除加密签名的开销，从而加快无故障场景的速度，并利用网络交换机可编程性来强制执行协议决策并验证安全性未被违反，从而即使在某些副本出现故障时也能提供强大的性能。设计一个能够充分利用这些特性的实用 BFT 需要解决一些挑战，例如数据包丢失和交换机崩溃故障，所有这些都在紧张的交换机资源预算范围内。我们证明 SwitchBFT 在可扩展性和性能方面优于最先进的 BFT，达到了交换机内 CFT 实现 NOPaxos 的速度。

items.title: Enabling SLO-Aware 5G Multi-Access Edge Computing with SMEC.
items.abstract: 5G Multi-access edge computing (MEC) promises to enable latency-critical applications by bringing computational power closer to mobile devices, but our measurements on commercial MEC deployments reveal frequent SLO violations due to high tail latencies. We identify resource contention at the RAN and the edge server as the root cause, compounded by SLO-unaware schedulers. Existing SLO-aware MEC schedulers require RAN-edge coordination, making them impractical for deployment and prone to poor performance due to coordination delays, limited heterogeneous application support, and ignoring edge resource contention. This paper introduces MEC, a practical, SLO-aware resource management framework that facilitates deadline-aware scheduling through fully decoupled operations at the RAN and edge servers. Our key insight is that standard 5G protocols and application behaviors naturally provide information exploitable for SLO-aware management without extensive infrastructure or application changes. Evaluation on our 5G testbed shows that MEC achieves 90–96% SLO satisfaction versus under 6% for existing approaches, while reducing tail latency by up to 122×.
items.abstract_zh: 5G 多接入边缘计算 (MEC) 有望通过使计算能力更接近移动设备来支持延迟关键型应用程序，但我们对商业 MEC 部署的测量表明，由于高尾延迟，经常出现 SLO 违规。我们将 RAN 和边缘服务器上的资源争用视为根本原因，并且由不了解 SLO 的调度程序加剧。现有的 SLO 感知 MEC 调度程序需要 RAN 边缘协调，这使得它们部署不切实际，并且由于协调延迟、有限的异构应用程序支持和忽略边缘资源争用而容易导致性能不佳。本文介绍了 MEC，这是一种实用的、SLO 感知的资源管理框架，它通过 RAN 和边缘服务器上的完全解耦操作来促进截止时间感知的调度。我们的主要见解是，标准 5G 协议和应用程序行为自然会提供可用于 SLO 感知管理的信息，而无需进行大量基础设施或应用程序更改。对我们 5G 测试台的评估表明，MEC 实现了 90-96% 的 SLO 满意度，而现有方法的 SLO 满意度低于 6%，同时将尾部延迟降低了高达 122 倍。

items.title: PlanB: Efficient Software IPv6 Lookup with Linearized B+-Tree.
items.abstract:
IP lookup via Longest Prefix Match (LPM) is critical for packet forwarding. Unfortunately, conventional lookup algorithms are inefficient for IPv6 Forwarding Information Bases (FIBs), which are characterized by a set of long prefixes with diverse lengths. We observe that LPM inherently represents a two-dimensional (2D) search problem over both prefix values and prefix lengths, but existing algorithms mostly treat LPM as two separate levels of one-dimensional (1D) searches, causing poor lookup performance and high memory overhead.

This paper presents PlanB, a novel scheme for high-speed IPv6 lookup. We transform the 2D LPM into an equivalent 1D search problem over elementary intervals, unifying the search across prefix value and lengths. We then adapt the flat-array B-tree structure to the needs of LPM to propose linearized B+-tree , based on which we introduce an efficient search algorithm tailored to the properties of the transformed space. To maximize performance, we integrate PlanB with vectorization, batching, branch-free logic, and loop unrolling to fully exploit CPU parallelism. Extensive evaluation shows that PlanB achieves single-core performance of 390 Million Lookups Per Sec (MLPS) with real-world IPv6 FIBs on AMD processor, and scales to full-12-core performance of 3.4 Billion Lookups Per Sec (BLPS). This is 1.6×∼14× higher than state-of-the-art software-based schemes (PopTrie, CP-Trie, Neurotrie and HBS).
items.abstract_zh:
通过最长前缀匹配 (LPM) 进行 IP 查找对于数据包转发至关重要。不幸的是，传统的查找算法对于 IPv6 转发信息库 (FIB) 来说效率低下，因为 IPv6 转发信息库的特点是一组长度不同的长前缀。我们观察到，LPM 本质上代表了前缀值和前缀长度上的二维 (2D) 搜索问题，但现有算法大多将 LPM 视为两个独立级别的一维 (1D) 搜索，导致查找性能差和内存开销高。

本文提出了 PlanB，一种用于高速 IPv6 查找的新颖方案。我们将 2D LPM 转换为基本区间上的等效一维搜索问题，统一了前缀值和长度的搜索。然后，我们将平面数组 B 树结构适应 LPM 的需要，提出线性化 B+ 树，在此基础上，我们引入了一种针对变换空间属性的高效搜索算法。为了最大限度地提高性能，我们将 PlanB 与矢量化、批处理、无分支逻辑和循环展开相集成，以充分利用 CPU 并行性。广泛的评估表明，PlanB 在 AMD 处理器上通过实际 IPv6 FIB 实现了每秒 3.9 亿次查找 (MLPS) 的单核性能，并可扩展到每秒 34 亿次查找 (BLPS) 的全 12 核性能。这比最先进的基于软件的方案（PopTr​​ie、CP-Trie、Neurotrie 和 HBS）高 1.6×∼14×。

items.title: JITServe: SLO-aware LLM Serving with Imprecise Request Information.
items.abstract:
The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into applications ranging from interactive chatbots to multi-agent systems has introduced a wide spectrum of service-level objectives (SLOs) for responsiveness. These include latency-sensitive requests emphasizing per-token latency in streaming chat, deadline-sensitive requests requiring rapid full responses to trigger external tools, and compound requests with evolving dependencies across multiple LLM calls. Despite—or perhaps, because of—this workload diversity and unpredictable request information (e.g., response lengths and dependencies), existing request schedulers have focused on aggregate performance, unable to ensure application-level SLO needs.

This paper presents JITServe, the first SLO-aware LLM serving system designed to maximize service goodput (e.g., the number of tokens meeting request SLOs) across diverse workloads . JITServe novelly schedules requests using imprecise request information and gradually relaxes this conservatism by refining request information estimates as generation progresses. It applies a grouped margin goodput maximization algorithm to allocate just enough serving bandwidth to satisfy each request's SLO just-in-time (JIT), maximizing residual capacity for others, while deciding the composition of requests in a batch to maximize efficiency and goodput with provable guarantees. Our evaluation across diverse realistic workloads, including chat, deep research, and agentic pipelines, shows that JITServe improves service goodput by 1.4×–6.3×, alternatively achieving 28.5%–83.2% resource savings, compared to state-of-the-art designs.
items.abstract_zh:
将大型语言模型 (LLM) 集成到从交互式聊天机器人到多代理系统等应用程序中，引入了广泛的响应能力服务级别目标 (SLO)。其中包括强调流聊天中每个令牌延迟的延迟敏感请求、需要快速完整响应以触发外部工具的截止时间敏感请求，以及跨多个 LLM 调用不断变化的依赖关系的复合请求。尽管（或者可能由于）这种工作负载多样性和不可预测的请求信息（例如，响应长度和依赖性），现有的请求调度程序仍然专注于总体性能，无法确保应用程序级 SLO 需求。

本文介绍了 JITServe，这是第一个 SLO 感知的 LLM 服务系统，旨在最大限度地提高不同工作负载的服务吞吐量（例如，满足请求 SLO 的令牌数量）。 JITServe 新颖地使用不精确的请求信息来调度请求，并通过随着生成的进展而细化请求信息估计来逐渐放松这种保守性。它应用分组余量有效吞吐量最大化算法来分配足够的服务带宽以满足每个请求的 SLO 即时 (JIT)，最大化其他请求的剩余容量，同时决定批量请求的组成，以在可证明的保证下最大化效率和有效吞吐量。我们对各种实际工作负载（包括聊天、深入研究和代理管道）的评估表明，与最先进的设计相比，JITServe 将服务吞吐量提高了 1.4×–6.3×，或者实现了 28.5%–83.2% 的资源节省。

items.title: OSCAR: O(1)-Step Convergence and Readily-deployable Congestion Control.
items.abstract: Datacenter CCs typically target full bandwidth utilization and minimal queueing delay and strive to converge to these targets as quickly as possible. State-of-the-art CCs exhibit different convergence speeds, with the fastest ones converging in O (1) steps, which means reaching the target in constant time regardless of network conditions. However, their reliance on network features makes them not readily deployable. For instance, precise-INT-based CCs, such as HPCC and PowerTCP, achieve O (1)-step convergence through MIMD operations based on precise congestion information from the lengthy INT header, which is challenging to support for high-speed commodity hardware. Our key insight is that delay and delay gradient can exhibit precision comparable to INT, enabling O (1)-step convergence without specialized network features. Based on this insight, we propose OSCAR, the first O (1)-Step Convergence And Readily-deployable CC. OSCAR introduces novel techniques to accurately estimate the delay gradient with minimal overhead, eliminate overreaction in MIMD updates, and coordinate independent control loops to converge to one target. Testbed evaluations demonstrate OSCAR can rapidly converge to the fair share under real-world noise. In large-scale simulations with realistic workloads, OSCAR consistently outperforms precise-INT-based CCs by 12%-48% on average FCT and 40%-74% on tail FCT.
items.abstract_zh: 数据中心 CC 通常以充分利用带宽和最小排队延迟为目标，并努力尽快收敛到这些目标。最先进的 CC 表现出不同的收敛速度，最快的收敛速度为 O (1) 步，这意味着无论网络条件如何，都能在恒定时间内达到目标。然而，它们对网络功能的依赖使得它们不易部署。例如，基于精确INT的CC，如HPCC和PowerTCP，通过基于来自冗长INT标头的精确拥塞信息的MIMD操作来实现O(1)步收敛，这对于支持高速商用硬件来说是一个挑战。我们的主要见解是，延迟和延迟梯度可以表现出与 INT 相当的精度，无需专门的网络功能即可实现 O (1) 步收敛。基于这一见解，我们提出了 OSCAR，第一个 O (1) 步收敛和易于部署的 CC。 OSCAR 引入了新技术，以最小的开销准确估计延迟梯度，消除 MIMD 更新中的过度反应，并协调独立的控制环路以收敛到一个目标。测试台评估表明 OSCAR 可以在现实世界噪声下快速收敛到公平份额。在具有实际工作负载的大规模模拟中，OSCAR 的平均 FCT 性能始终优于基于精确 INT 的 CC 12%-48%，尾部 FCT 性能高 40%-74%。

items.title: Themis: Scheduling-Aware Buffer Management for HBM-Based Hybrid Buffers.
items.abstract:
Packet buffers are critical for absorbing congestion and sustaining throughput in high-speed routers. As link rates escalate, on-chip SRAM alone can no longer provide sufficient capacity. To address this, modern routers widely adopt hybrid buffer architectures that augment limited on-chip SRAM with large off-chip DRAM. Despite this architectural promise, existing hybrid Buffer Management (BM) schemes severely undermine router performance. They simply redirect packets that would otherwise be dropped into DRAM, which leads to priority inversion and head-of-line blocking: as packets buffered in DRAM age into the highest-priority packets, SRAM must stall until they are retrieved, wasting bandwidth and degrading throughput. Worse still, existing BM schemes ignore DRAM's access characteristics, further constraining its limited bandwidth and reducing overall performance dramatically.

We present Themis, a hybrid buffer management scheme that fully exploits SRAM's high bandwidth and DRAM's large capacity. Its core principle is scheduling-aware packet placement, which ensures packets with the earliest departure time are preferentially stored in SRAM to maximize its bandwidth utilization. To achieve this, Themis proactively migrates buffered packets between SRAM and DRAM, reserving SRAM space for imminent, high-priority traffic. Themis is compatible with diverse scheduling algorithms and supports dynamic changes to the scheduling policy. It also organizes DRAM storage according to scheduling order, mapping consecutively departing packets to contiguous addresses. This unlocks effective off-chip bandwidth, and accelerates packet migration. Themis is hardware-friendly and its FPGA and ASIC prototypes achieve low overhead and high frequency. Large-scale simulations show that Themis improves end-to-end performance by up to 2.8×.
items.abstract_zh:
数据包缓冲区对于吸收拥塞和维持高速路由器的吞吐量至关重要。随着链路速率的提升，仅片上 SRAM 已无法提供足够的容量。为了解决这个问题，现代路由器广泛采用混合缓冲区架构，用大型片外 DRAM 增强有限的片上 SRAM。尽管有这样的架构承诺，但现有的混合缓冲区管理 (BM) 方案严重损害了路由器的性能。它们只是将原本会被丢弃到 DRAM 中的数据包进行重定向，这会导致优先级反转和队头阻塞：当 DRAM 中缓冲的数据包老化为最高优先级数据包时，SRAM 必须停止运行，直到它们被检索，从而浪费带宽并降低吞吐量。更糟糕的是，现有的BM方案忽略了DRAM的访问特性，进一步限制了其有限的带宽并大幅降低了整体性能。

我们提出了 Themis，一种混合​​缓冲区管理方案，充分利用了 SRAM 的高带宽和 DRAM 的大容量。其核心原理是调度感知的数据包放置，确保最早出发时间的数据包优先存储在SRAM中，以最大化其带宽利用率。为了实现这一目标，Themis 主动在 SRAM 和 DRAM 之间迁移缓冲数据包，为即将到来的高优先级流量保留 SRAM 空间。 Themis兼容多种调度算法，支持动态改变调度策略。它还根据调度顺序组织 DRAM 存储，将连续离开的数据包映射到连续的地址。这释放了有效的片外带宽，并加速了数据包迁移。 Themis 硬件友好，其 FPGA 和 ASIC 原型实现了低开销和高频率。大规模模拟表明，Themis 将端到端性能提高了 2.8 倍。

items.title: ForestColl: Throughput-Optimal Collective Communications on Heterogeneous Network Fabrics.
items.abstract: As modern DNN models grow ever larger, collective communications between the accelerators (allreduce, etc.) emerge as a significant performance bottleneck. Designing efficient communication schedules is challenging, given today's heterogeneous and diverse network fabrics. We present ForestColl, a tool that generates throughput-optimal schedules for any network topology. ForestColl constructs broadcast/aggregation spanning trees as the communication schedule, achieving theoretical optimality. Its schedule generation runs in polynomial time and is highly scalable. ForestColl supports any network fabric, including both switching fabrics and direct accelerator connections. We evaluated ForestColl on AMD MI250 and NVIDIA DGX A100 & H100 clusters. ForestColl shows significant improvements over the vendors' own optimized communication libraries across various settings and in LLM training. ForestColl also outperforms other state-of-the-art schedule generation techniques with both more efficient generated schedules and substantially faster generation speed.
items.abstract_zh: 随着现代 DNN 模型变得越来越大，加速器（allreduce 等）之间的集体通信成为一个重要的性能瓶颈。鉴于当今异构且多样化的网络结构，设计高效的通信调度具有挑战性。我们推出了 ForestColl，这是一种可以为任何网络拓扑生成吞吐量最佳调度的工具。 ForestColl构建广播/聚合生成树作为通信调度，实现了理论上的最优。其调度生成在多项式时间内运行并且具有高度可扩展性。 ForestColl 支持任何网络结构，包括交换结构和直接加速器连接。我们在 AMD MI250 和 NVIDIA DGX A100 & H100 集群上评估了 ForestColl。 ForestColl 在各种设置和法学硕士培训中比供应商自己的优化通信库有了显着改进。 ForestColl 还优于其他最先进的时间表生成技术，生成的时间表更高效，生成速度也快得多。

items.title: SmartNIC-Enabled Live Migration for Storage-Optimized VMs with PYROCUMULUS.
items.abstract: Cloud providers offer storage-optimized VMs equipped with locally attached storage to meet the high performance requirements of cloud users. Live migration (LM) is crucial for such VMs to improve availability and manageability. However, providers do not enable LM for storage-optimized VMs. Host-managed LM suffers from high resource overheads and varied user performance, while offloading LM to SoC SmartNICs or disks cannot reliably accomplish LM in a reasonable time. The fundamental challenges are (1) consistency, demanding a high resource budget, and (2) network contention, preventing LM from converging. We propose Pyrocumulus , an LM approach on FPGA SmartNICs, enabling SLA-aware, fast, and low-overhead LM for storage-optimized VMs. We exploit hardware customizability and efficient network accessibility of the FPGA SmartNIC with LM protocol, architecture, and algorithm designs. Results from our FPGA SmartNIC prototype show that Pyrocumulus reduces user latency variances during LM up to 12.4×, lowers LM time by up to 19.6×, and saves cost up to 3×, while only taking 0.9%/3.8% compute/memory overhead of a mid-end FPGA SmartNIC.
items.abstract_zh: 云提供商提供配备本地连接存储的存储优化虚拟机，以满足云用户的高性能要求。实时迁移 (LM) 对于此类虚拟机提高可用性和可管理性至关重要。但是，提供商不会为存储优化的虚拟机启用 LM。主机管理的 LM 面临资源开销高和用户性能变化的问题，而将 LM 卸载到 SoC SmartNIC 或磁盘无法在合理的时间内可靠地完成 LM。根本挑战是 (1) 一致性，需要较高的资源预算，以及 (2) 网络争用，阻碍 LM 收敛。我们提出了 Pyrocumulus，这是一种基于 FPGA SmartNIC 的 LM 方法，可为存储优化的虚拟机提供 SLA 感知、快速且低开销的 LM。我们利用 FPGA SmartNIC 的硬件可定制性和高效网络可访问性以及 LM 协议、架构和算法设计。我们的 FPGA SmartNIC 原型的结果表明，Pyrocumulus 将 LM 期间的用户延迟差异降低了 12.4 倍，将 LM 时间缩短了 19.6 倍，并节省了 3 倍的成本，而仅占用中端 FPGA SmartNIC 的 0.9%/3.8% 的计算/内存开销。

items.title: Octopus: Enhancing CXL Memory Pods via Sparse Topology.
items.abstract:
The Compute Express Link (CXL) interconnect enables compute "pods" that pool memory across servers to reduce cost and improve efficiency. These pods also facilitate pairwise communication whose needs conflict with pooling. Importantly, existing pod designs are small or require indirection through expensive switches. These conventional designs implicitly assume that pods must fully connect all servers to all CXL pooling devices.

This paper breaks with this conventional wisdom by introducing Octopus pods. Octopus directly connects servers to low-port-count CXL pooling devices (e.g., 4 ports) yet scales to large pods without switches by constructing a sparse CXL topology in which each pooling device connects to a carefully chosen subset of servers. Octopus explicitly balances "overlap", where two servers connect to the same pooling device: overlap reduces pooling efficiency but enables low-latency communication. Octopus resolves this tension by grouping servers into "islands" with low-latency intra-island communication and interconnecting islands to favor pooling.

We build a three-server CXL pod prototype and simulate scaled pods with 96 servers under measured device characteristics and physical constraints (1.5m copper cables). On hardware, Octopus RPCs are 3.2× faster than in-rack RDMA and 2.4× faster than CXL switches. In simulation, Octopus achieves net server cost savings of 3–5.4% whereas CXL switches result in a net cost increase.
items.abstract_zh:
Compute Express Link (CXL) 互连支持跨服务器共享内存的计算“pod”，以降低成本并提高效率。这些 Pod 还促进了与池化需求相冲突的成对通信。重要的是，现有的 Pod 设计很小或者需要通过昂贵的交换机进行间接连接。这些传统设计隐含地假设 Pod 必须将所有服务器完全连接到所有 CXL 池设备。

本文通过介绍章鱼荚打破了这种传统观念。 Octopus 直接将服务器连接到低端口数 CXL 池设备（例如 4 个端口），但通过构建稀疏 CXL 拓扑（其中每个池设备连接到精心选择的服务器子集），无需交换机即可扩展到大型 Pod。 Octopus 明确平衡“重叠”，即两台服务器连接到同一池设备：重叠会降低池效率，但可实现低延迟通信。 Octopus 通过将服务器分组为具有低延迟岛内通信的“孤岛”，并将孤岛互连以利于池化，从而解决了这种紧张局势。

我们构建了一个三服务器 CXL Pod 原型，并在测量的设备特性和物理约束（1.5m 铜缆）下模拟具有 96 个服务器的扩展 Pod。在硬件上，Octopus RPC 比机架内 RDMA 快 3.2 倍，比 CXL 交换机快 2.4 倍。在模拟中，Octopus 实现了 3-5.4% 的净服务器成本节省，而 CXL 交换机则导致净成本增加。

items.title: AnyPro: Preference-Preserving Anycast Optimization based on Strategic AS-Path Prepending.
items.abstract: Operating large-scale anycast networks is challenging because client-to-site mappings often misalign with operator’s expectation due to opaque inter-domain routing. We present AnyPro, the first system to unlock the full potential of AS-path prepending (ASPP), efficiently deriving globally optimal configurations to steer clients toward performance-optimal sites at scale. AnyPro first employs an efficient polling mechanism to identify all clients sensitive to ASPP. By analyzing the routing changes during the process, the system derives a set of ASPP constraints that guide client traffic toward the desired sites. We then formulate the anycast optimization problem as a constraint-based program and compute optimal ASPP configurations. Extensive evaluation on a global testbed with 20 PoPs demonstrates the effectiveness of AnyPro: it reduces the 90th percentile latency by 37.7% compared to baseline configurations without ASPP. Furthermore, we show that AnyPro can be integrated with PoP-level anycast optimization techniques to achieve additional performance gains.
items.abstract_zh: 运营大规模任播网络具有挑战性，因为由于不透明的域间路由，客户端到站点的映射经常与运营商的期望不一致。我们推出 AnyPro，这是第一个释放 AS 路径预置 (ASPP) 全部潜力的系统，可有效导出全局最佳配置，以引导客户大规模实现性能最佳站点。 AnyPro 首先采用高效的轮询机制来识别所有对 ASPP 敏感的客户端。通过分析此过程中的路由变化，系统得出一组 ASPP 约束，将客户端流量引导至所需站点。然后，我们将选播优化问题表述为基于约束的程序并计算最佳 ASPP 配置。对具有 20 个 PoP 的全球测试台进行的广泛评估证明了 AnyPro 的有效性：与没有 ASPP 的基准配置相比，它将第 90 个百分点的延迟减少了 37.7%。此外，我们还表明 AnyPro 可以与 PoP 级选播优化技术集成，以实现额外的性能提升。

items.title: Starfish: A Topology-Routing Co-Design for Small-Scale Data Centers.
items.abstract:
Most data centers today operate at scales much smaller than hyperscalers, i.e., hosting only hundreds to a few thousand servers, yet their design has received disproportionately little attention in the literature. Leaf-spine is nearly ubiquitous in small-scale data centers, but presents a fundamental tradeoff: provisioning full non-blocking capacity is costly, while oversubscription reduces cost but under-serves bursty, skewed workloads. Recent expander-based designs could, in theory, offer better performance but face substantial deployment hurdles, including lacking a practical routing scheme.

We introduce Starfish, a topology-routing co-design tailored to small-scale data centers, that delivers high performance, fault tolerance, and ease of deployment. Starfish’s topology, DRing, increases per-server egress capacity by spreading servers across all switches, reduces latency–even under failure scenarios–by exposing diverse near-shortest paths, and eases deployment by organizing switches into uniform blocks. Starfish’s routing leverages structural properties of DRing and effectively adapts to traffic patterns using standard hardware and protocols. Notably, Starfish’s routing also generalizes to expander-based topologies.

Evaluation shows that Starfish supports 56% more traffic on average than leaf-spine built with the same equipment across real-world traces. This demonstrates that small-scale data centers today can realistically achieve higher performance with their existing equipment. Starfish’s routing also enables an expander-based design to support 52% more traffic on average than leaf-spine. More broadly, this work takes a first step towards a distinct design space for small-scale data centers.
items.abstract_zh:
如今，大多数数据中心的运营规模比超大规模数据中心小得多，即仅托管数百到数千台服务器，但其设计在文献中却很少受到关注。叶脊在小型数据中心中几乎无处不在，但存在一个基本的权衡：提供完整的非阻塞容量成本高昂，而超额订阅可以降低成本，但无法满足突发性、倾斜的工作负载的需求。理论上，最近基于扩展器的设计可以提供更好的性能，但面临巨大的部署障碍，包括缺乏实用的路由方案。

我们推出了 Starfish，这是一种专为小型数据中心量身定制的拓扑路由协同设计，可提供高性能、容错性和易于部署性。 Starfish 的拓扑 DRing 通过将服务器分布在所有交换机上来增加每台服务器的出口容量，通过公开不同的近最短路径来减少延迟（即使在故障情况下），并通过将交换机组织成统一的块来简化部署。 Starfish 的路由利用 DRing 的结构特性，并使用标准硬件和协议有效地适应流量模式。值得注意的是，Starfish 的路由也推广到基于扩展器的拓扑。

评估显示，与使用相同设备构建的 Leaf Spine 相比，Starfish 在现实世界中支持的流量平均多出 56%。这表明当今的小型数据中心实际上可以利用现有设备实现更高的性能。 Starfish 的路由还支持基于扩展器的设计，与 Leaf-Spine 相比，平均支持多 52% 的流量。更广泛地说，这项工作向小型数据中心的独特设计空间迈出了第一步。

items.title: Controlling Arbitrary Internet Queues with Titrate.
items.abstract:
Router buffers are critical to networks for absorbing short-lived congestion and allowing full throughput. However, excessive buffering can lead to high queuing delay, poor burst absorption, and even low throughput for queues sharing the buffer memory. Existing queue management schemes designed for Internet routers (e.g., CoDel, PIE) prevent such excessive buffering only under stringent assumptions about the queue composition (flows in the queue), while more recent approaches (e.g., L4S) require end-host collaboration. In this work, we revisit queue management for Internet routers from first principles and introduce Titrate, a closed-loop controller that senses queue dynamics and adjusts thresholds for any given queue to achieve high throughput, low latency and effective burst absorption. To balance convergence speed and stability, Titrate draws inspiration from TCP’s control loop, combining a multiplicative-increase-additive-decrease approach with an ssthresh-like variable.

We evaluate Titrate’s performance via simulation and Internet experiments. Across a wide range of realistic traffic mixes, Titrate increases minimum throughput by 39%, 14% compared to CoDel, PIE, while keeping 59% lower queuing latency compared to static-threshold baselines of on-par throughput. It also improves end-user quality of experience over static-threshold baselines. We further show that Titrate reacts swiftly to bandwidth and traffic changes and offers device-wide benefits.
items.abstract_zh:
路由器缓冲区对于网络吸收短暂拥塞并允许完全吞吐量至关重要。然而，过多的缓冲会导致队列延迟高、突发吸收差，甚至共享缓冲存储器的队列吞吐量低。为互联网路由器设计的现有队列管理方案（例如，CoDel、PIE）仅在对队列组成（队列中的流）进行严格假设的情况下才能防止这种过度缓冲，而最新的方法（例如，L4S）需要终端主机协作。在这项工作中，我们从第一原理重新审视互联网路由器的队列管理，并引入 Titrate，这是一种闭环控制器，可以感知队列动态并调整任何给定队列的阈值，以实现高吞吐量、低延迟和有效的突发吸收。为了平衡收敛速度和稳定性，Titrate 从 TCP 的控制循环中汲取灵感，将乘法-增加-加法-减少方法与类似 ssthresh 的变量相结合。

我们通过模拟和互联网实验来评估 Titrate 的性能。在各种实际流量混合中，Titrate 将最小吞吐量提高了 39%，与 CoDel、PIE 相比提高了 14%，同时与同等吞吐量的静态阈值基线相比，排队延迟降低了 59%。它还提高了最终用户在静态阈值基线上的体验质量。我们进一步表明，Titrate 对带宽和流量变化做出快速反应，并提供设备范围内的优势。

items.title: PrvTel: Lightweight Models for Private and Accurate Telemetry Data Retention.
items.abstract: Network operators rely on telemetry for performance and security analysis, but long-term retention at scale remains difficult due to privacy requirements, resource constraints, and the need for high-fidelity query answers. We present PrvTel, a framework for privacy-preserving telemetry retention. Instead of storing raw records, PrvTel learns a compact generative model using a domain-specialized variational autoencoder. It combines field-aware encodings for NetFlow and cloud telemetry with a correlation-aware objective to preserve cross-field dependencies. To enforce differential privacy (DP) without sacrificing utility, PrvTel injects structure-aware noise before training, rather than during gradient updates. We prove that PrvTel satisfies DP based on post-processing theorem. Across six real-world datasets and one synthetic workload, PrvTel improves query accuracy by up to 60% over prior DP-compliant generative baselines and reduces ownership cost by up to 50× compared to lossless retention.
items.abstract_zh: 网络运营商依靠遥测进行性能和安全分析，但由于隐私要求、资源限制以及对高保真查询答案的需求，大规模长期保留仍然很困难。我们提出了 PrvTel，一个用于保护隐私的遥测保留框架。 PrvTel 不存储原始记录，而是使用领域专用变分自动编码器学习紧凑的生成模型。它将 NetFlow 和云遥测的现场感知编码与相关感知目标相结合，以保留跨领域依赖性。为了在不牺牲实用性的情况下实施差分隐私 (DP)，PrvTel 在训练之前而不是在梯度更新期间注入结构感知噪声。我们根据后处理定理证明PrvTel满足DP。在六个真实数据集和一个合成工作负载中，PrvTel 的查询准确性比之前符合 DP 的生成基线提高了 60%，并且与无损保留相比，拥有成本降低了 50 倍。

items.title: DistRS: Disaggregated Reward Service for RLVR with Batch-Level Constraint.
items.abstract:
Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a key post-training paradigm for enhancing the capabilities of large language models (LLMs). As the complexity increases and resource consumption grows, reward computation is becoming a critical workload in the RLVR training process.

We present DistRS, a disaggregated reward service framework designed to provide resource-efficient reward computation for RLVR training. Through the analysis of a real RLVR training task, we observe that the reward service faces a highly dynamic workload, motivating the need for elasticity and multi-tenancy. DistRS leverages request-level flexibility from the request-in, batch-out characteristic of reward computation to design more resource-efficient scaling and scheduling policies. Specifically, DistRS establishes a batch-level constraint for each training task that relaxes latency requirements at the request level. Building on this foundation, we design a history-based resource scaling policy and a batch-level priority-based request scheduling policy. In addition, DistRS incorporates a timeout-aware mechanism to adjust resource allocation, thereby mitigating the impact of deviations between history and actual execution. We evaluate DistRS with real-world RLVR training tasks and the results demonstrate that DistRS reduces resource consumption by up to 3.79× while incurring minimal overhead on training progress.
items.abstract_zh:
具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为增强大型语言模型（LLM）能力的关键后训练范例。随着复杂性的增加和资源消耗的增加，奖励计算正成为 RLVR 训练过程中的关键工作负载。

我们提出了 DistRS，一个分类奖励服务框架，旨在为 RLVR 训练提供资源高效的奖励计算。通过对真实 RLVR 训练任务的分析，我们观察到奖励服务面临高度动态的工作负载，激发了对弹性和多租户的需求。 DistRS 利用奖励计算的请求输入、批量输出特性的请求级灵活性来设计更资源高效的扩展和调度策略。具体来说，DistRS 为每个训练任务建立了批处理级约束，放宽了请求级的延迟要求。在此基础上，我们设计了基于历史的资源扩展策略和基于批处理优先级的请求调度策略。此外，DistRS还采用了超时感知机制来调整资源分配，从而减轻历史执行与实际执行之间的偏差的影响。我们使用现实世界的 RLVR 训练任务来评估 DistRS，结果表明，DistRS 将资源消耗减少了高达 3.79 倍，同时训练进度的开销最小。

items.title: R-TCP: A Framework to Optimize TCP Performance Over Rate-Limiting Networks.
items.abstract: Many mobile operators provide subscription plans that include a data quota for full-speed access, beyond which the service will be throttled to a low data rate — rate-limited service. This is designed to control costs and to motivate users to upgrade. Our recent measurements in a country-scale service suggested that the proportion of TCP flows subjected to rate limiting can be as high as 28%. More importantly, TCP flows under rate limiting can exhibit excessive retransmission rates, exceeding 20% in many cases. The extra bandwidth costs incurred by the retransmissions for large service providers are very significant, not to mention bandwidth wastage. This work develops a novel R-TCP framework to mitigate the excessive retransmissions problems in various TCP designs (e.g., Cubic and BBR) under rate limiting networks. R-TCP is specifically designed and optimized for sender-side kernel implementation with minimal overheads. It has been implemented into Linux where extensive experiments in real-world networks and applications show that it can substantially reduce excessive retransmissions by up to 88% with negligible tradeoff in goodput and application-layer performance.
items.abstract_zh: 许多移动运营商提供的订阅计划包括全速访问的数据配额，超出该配额，服务将被限制为低数据速率——速率受限服务。此举旨在控制成本并激励用户升级。我们最近对国家级服务的测量表明，受到速率限制的 TCP 流量比例可能高达 28%。更重要的是，速率限制下的 TCP 流可能会出现过高的重传率，在许多情况下超过 20%。对于大型服务提供商来说，重传所产生的额外带宽成本非常巨大，更不用说带宽浪费了。这项工作开发了一种新颖的 R-TCP 框架，以减轻速率限制网络下各种 TCP 设计（例如 Cubic 和 BBR）中的过度重传问题。 R-TCP 专为发送方内核实现而设计和优化，开销最小。它已在 Linux 中实现，在现实网络和应用程序中进行的大量实验表明，它可以大幅减少高达 88% 的过度重传，而对吞吐量和应用层性能的影响可以忽略不计。

items.title: Detecting and Diagnosing Errors in Serving Archived Web Pages.
items.abstract:
Web archives crawl and save copies of pages from the web, enabling users to interact with web pages in the form they existed in the past. Prior to serving any archived page, an archive rewrites the page’s source so that users’ browsers fetch the page’s resources from the archive, not from the servers which originally hosted them. But, on many modern pages, an archive’s edits to crawled scripts result in a loss of fidelity, i.e., an archived copy fails to accurately mimic the original page even when the archive had crawled all resources on the page.

To help the developers of archival systems identify and fix the bugs which result in incorrect rewrites of crawled pages, we present FidEx. First, FidEx enables accurate identification of the pages on which an archive violates fidelity. It does so by tracking and comparing the execution of scripts between when a page is crawled and when its copy is loaded. In comparison to existing methods which compare the two loads using either screenshots or the errors reported by the browser, FidEx reduces the false positive rate from around 70% to less than 10%. Second, on every page on which it identifies a loss of fidelity, FidEx pinpoints which subset of the archive’s edits to the page are erroneous. Leveraging this input to fix bugs in the most widely used archival system, we reduced the fraction of archived pages which violate fidelity from 15% to 9%.
items.abstract_zh:
网络档案从网络上抓取并保存页面的副本，使用户能够以过去存在的形式与网页进行交互。在提供任何存档页面之前，存档会重写页面的源代码，以便用户的浏览器从存档中获取页面的资源，而不是从最初托管它们的服务器获取页面的资源。但是，在许多现代页面上，存档对爬网脚本的编辑会导致保真度损失，即，即使存档已爬网页面上的所有资源，存档副本也无法准确模仿原始页面。

为了帮助档案系统的开发人员识别并修复导致爬网页面错误重写的错误，我们推出了 FidEx。首先，FidEx 能够准确识别存档违反保真度的页面。它通过跟踪和比较页面爬行和加载其副本之间脚本的执行来实现这一点。与使用屏幕截图或浏览器报告的错误来比较两个负载的现有方法相比，FidEx 将误报率从 70% 左右降低到 10% 以下。其次，在识别出保真度损失的每个页面上，FidEx 都会查明存档对该页面的编辑的哪个子集是错误的。利用此输入来修复最广泛使用的归档系统中的错误，我们将违反保真度的归档页面比例从 15% 减少到 9%。
